cards.question: A laptop reports a SMART drive-health warning during startup. A filesystem check finds no errors. Which type of problem does the warning concern?
cards.answer: A. Drive health detected by SMART
cards.why: A clean filesystem does not clear a physical drive-health warning. Protect the data and check the drive with the maker's diagnostics.

cards.question: An office PC runs one app well but slows badly with several apps open. Monitoring shows RAM is nearly full and the system is paging heavily. Which supported upgrade best addresses this measured bottleneck?
cards.why: RAM holds active work. More RAM reduces the need to page working data to slower storage in this scenario.

cards.question: Which technology lets one managed switch contain several logically separate local broadcast domains?
cards.why: VLANs separate Layer 2 networks logically. A configured trunk can carry several VLANs between switches.

cards.question: A company has a dot matrix printer that uses carbon paper. The company reports that the first page is printing too light, although the following pages are still legible. Which of the following MOST likely needs to be fixed?

options.label: A
options.text: The print drum is worn and loose causing the printing to be l ight in places

options.label: B
options.text: The ribbon is low on ink or missing and must be replaced to g et proper output

options.label: C
options.text: The heating element has failed, and a new one needs to be ins talled for proper transfer

options.label: D
options.text: The wrong type of filement is loaded, preventing it from stic king correctly

options.label: E
options.text: The fuser assembly is not calibrated properly, causing it to impact the paper too hard

cards.answer: B. The ribbon is low on ink or missing and must be replaced to g et proper output
cards.why: Ribbon prints first sheet; pressure produces multipart copies. The ribbon supplies ink. Replacing a worn ribbon may improve the top sheet, while paper type and printhead gap also affect multipart output. A laser printer does not strike through a form stack.

cards.question: Every internal test page from a laser printer has thin vertical lines. The model's defect guide points to contamination on its serviceable drum. Which action best fits these findings?

options.label: A
options.text: Replace the printer paper with a new ream.

options.label: B
options.text: Clear the print spooler on each computer.

options.label: C
options.text: Reinstall the printer driver on each computer

cards.why: The internal test page rules out individual PC print drivers. Use the exact model's approved drum-cleaning procedure.

cards.question: A new PC powers on but fails POST with three beeps. Its service manual identifies that exact code as improperly seated memory. After disconnecting power and following ESD precautions, which action fits?
cards.why: The model-specific code supplies the missing evidence. Three beeps do not mean the same fault on every computer.

cards.question: An administrator plans to move on-premises VMs to rented cloud compute while continuing to manage their guest operating systems. Which service model fits?
cards.why: Infrastructure as a Service supplies virtual compute, storage and networking. It does not by itself provide the migration procedure.

cards.question: A classroom projector shuts down after 15 minutes and cannot restart until it cools. A heat warning appears and its serviceable air filter is clogged. After safe shutdown and cooling, what should the technician do?
cards.why: The heat warning and blocked filter support a cooling problem. Follow the manual's filter-cleaning procedure.

cards.question: A user's computer is not receiving a network connection. The technician confirms that the connection seems to be down and looks for the user's port on the patch panel. The port and patch panel are not labeled. Which of the following network tools should the technician use to identify the port?
cards.why: Trace an unlabeled copper run with compatible toner and probe. The generator puts a traceable signal on the cable; the probe detects it. Use tools rated for the circuit and follow instructions for live networks. Label both ends after identification. A toner does not certify Ethernet speed.

cards.question: A workstation's HDD slows application loading. Its motherboard supports an available PCIe/NVMe M.2 slot. The HDD must remain installed. Which addition best addresses the storage bottleneck?

options.label: A
options.text: A compatible M.2 NVMe SSD for the applications and active data

options.label: B
options.text: A SAS drive without a SAS controller

cards.answer: A. A compatible M.2 NVMe SSD for the applications and active data
cards.why: The supported SSD addresses storage latency while retaining the HDD. M.2 alone describes a form factor, not guaranteed speed.

cards.question: A user failed to gain access to a building's entrance after security measures at the entrance were upgraded last week. The company implemented the 13.56MHz frequency short band, and users can now utilize their mobile devices to authenticate. Which of the following has to be enabled for the mobile device to authenticate?
cards.why: NFC operates at 13.56 MHz and supports close-range credential exchange. Devices are normally brought within a small fraction of an inch to around an inch for a tap. NFC may exchange a small payload or start a Bluetooth connection; it is not the best choice for sustained large-file transfers.

cards.question: A tablet's touch pointer consistently lands beside the point being touched. The screen is intact, and this model supports touch calibration. Which adjustment should be tried?

options.label: D
options.text: The screen needs to be recalibrated.

cards.answer: D. The screen needs to be recalibrated.
cards.why: Calibration maps touch coordinates to display coordinates. It applies only to devices that support the procedure; random drifting can have other causes.

cards.question: A PC sends video to a projector through VGA, with no separate audio cable. Both devices support HDMI audio and the projector has working speakers. Which connection can carry both signals?

options.label: A
options.text: Changing the input on the projector to VGA

options.label: B
options.text: Changing the output on the PC to DVI

cards.why: HDMI can carry video and audio. Select the HDMI audio output and check volume after connecting it.

cards.question: An administrator is configuring a corporate-owned smartphone for a new manager. The company requires the ability to wipe the phone's data remotely in the event of loss or theft and the capability to approve applications installed on the phone. Which of the following tools would BEST meet this need?
cards.why: MDM supports policies, approved apps and remote wipe on enrolled devices. An organization can distribute settings and apps and enforce supported policies. Capabilities depend on device ownership, platform and enrollment type. Enrollment does not mean every personal detail becomes visible to IT.

cards.question: A site uses an internet modem on the same copper telephone pair as its analog POTS service. Both services fail together. Which access technology matches this setup?
cards.why: DSL uses telephone copper. POTS means Plain Old Telephone Service. A shared-line failure can affect both services.

cards.question: A supported application-testing hypervisor needs at least 16 GB RAM and 100 GB free storage for the host and planned guests. All four systems have supported CPUs. Which configuration meets both stated requirements?

options.label: A
options.text: 32 GB RAM and 500 GB free storage

options.label: B
options.text: 8 GB RAM and 500 GB free storage

options.label: C
options.text: 32 GB RAM and 50 GB free storage

options.label: D
options.text: 4 GB RAM and 50 GB free storage

cards.answer: A. 32 GB RAM and 500 GB free storage
cards.why: Only A meets both explicit resource requirements. The missing comparison exhibit is replaced with a complete text scenario.

cards.question: An online retailer would like to add capacity to support increased sales. Additional servers have been installed. Which of the following should be used to ensure each new server is being properly utilized?
cards.why: Distributes requests across backend servers; verify health and algorithm. This can improve capacity and availability. Health checks help avoid failed servers. A load balancer does not automatically add servers; scaling must be configured separately.

cards.question: A workstation reboots during GPU rendering. Its PSU supplies 200 W, but the measured component demand exceeds that output under load. The PSU supports the available 115 V AC input. Where should troubleshooting focus?

options.label: A
options.text: The UPS, as 115V is insufficient for the configuration and sh ould be increased to 220V

options.label: B
options.text: The power supply, as 200W is insufficient when the GPU is hea vily tasked

options.label: C
options.text: The graphics card, as it is the component that triggers the u nexpected reboots

options.label: D
options.text: The motherboard, as only standard PCI slots should be used fo r high-end graphics cards, not PCI Express slots

cards.answer: B. The power supply, as 200W is insufficient when the GPU is hea vily tasked
cards.why: The output wattage is inadequate for the measured load. A supported 115 V input is not itself the problem.

cards.question: Which of the following components enables the input on a mobile device's touch screen?
cards.why: Digitizer detects touch input; display produces image. The digitizer turns touches into location data. Check supported calibration, driver and settings first. Inspect hardware and connections if appropriate. A working image does not prove the touch layer works, and not every screen supports manual calibration.

cards.question: Which of the following describes metered utilization of cloud resources?

options.label: B
options.text: Resource usage is measured, often informing usage-based charges

options.label: C
options.text: Resources pooled to increase computing power

cards.answer: B. Resource usage is measured, often informing usage-based charges
cards.why: Measured service tracks consumption. The contract determines billing, which may also include fixed fees or commitments.

cards.question: An IT manager discovered that hundreds of pages of printed materials are being recycled each day because the materials are left on the printer tray instead of being picked up by users. Which of the following would BEST prevent this waste?

options.label: A
options.text: Send friendly reminders to not print unnecessarily.

options.label: B
options.text: Enable duplex printing to reduce paper utilization.

options.label: C
options.text: Bill each department for the excess material cost.

options.label: D
options.text: Require a code or badge before releasing a print job.

cards.answer: D. Require a code or badge before releasing a print job.
cards.why: Hold jobs until authenticated release to reduce abandoned prints. A PIN, badge or authenticated release can hold the job until the user arrives. This protects physical pickup; it does not automatically encrypt every network transfer or stored copy.

cards.question: A geostationary satellite connection has its expected throughput and its normal, stable high latency. No new fault is found. How should the technician explain the delay?

options.label: A
options.text: Restart the modem and run an online internet connection and s peed diagnostic tool.

options.label: B
options.text: Guide the customer on how to upgrade the internet plan with the provider in order to improve latency.

options.label: C
options.text: Explain to the customer this is not an issue; this situation is normal for this type of internet connection.

options.label: D
options.text: Replace the modem because it is not working correctly based o n the test result.

cards.answer: C. Explain to the customer this is not an issue; this situation is normal for this type of internet connection.
cards.why: The long signal path causes substantial propagation delay. A faster download plan or a modem restart cannot remove that distance; low-Earth-orbit service differs.

cards.question: Client-side virtualization guest machines have security requirements similar to physical machines, but they also need to ensure separation from other guest machines. Which of the following BEST describes this client-side guest security requirement?
cards.why: Guests require logical separation plus guest and host security. Limit shared folders, clipboard, device access and network connectivity for risky testing. A VM escape is a breach from guest to host. Do not assume running malware in any VM makes it harmless.

cards.question: While using a popular videoconferencing program, the user selects a webcam, but the software is unable to open the webcam. The webcam was working the previous day. Which of the following should be done to address this issue?

options.label: A
options.text: Close other video software and retry.

options.label: B
options.text: Adjust the conference software to a compatible resolution.

options.label: C
options.text: Switch the video from the webcam to "conference" mode.

cards.answer: A. Close other video software and retry.
cards.why: Another application may hold the camera; close it and retry. Also check any privacy shutter or switch. For an external webcam, confirm the USB connection. If every app fails, test the driver and hardware path. One app failure is not proof of a damaged camera.

cards.question: A developer is requesting permission to utilize client-side visualization. The developer would like to write code in a setting isolated from other infrastructure to avoid negative impacts of experimental code. Which of the following provides the BEST solution for the developer?
cards.why: Use isolated test environment; a VM alone is not a complete security boundary. Limit shared folders, clipboard, device access and network connectivity for risky testing. A VM escape is a breach from guest to host. Do not assume running malware in any VM makes it harmless.

cards.question: After a printer firmware update, its old server driver produces garbled output. The vendor documents a matching driver update, and internal test pages are normal. What should be done next?

options.label: A
options.text: Change the language settings on the printers

options.label: B
options.text: Reboot all the machines having the issues

options.label: D
options.text: Install an updated printer driver on the print server

cards.answer: D. Install an updated printer driver on the print server
cards.why: The firmware and old driver are incompatible in this stated case. Install the supported matching driver on the print server.

cards.question: A user submitted a ticket to report an issue with a new printer that is no longer accepting new print jobs. The technician verifies the printer is on and notices the printer LCD screen has the following error message: Paper Jam, Jam in fuser. Which of the following is the MOST efficient next step the technician should complete?

options.label: A
options.text: Apply a maintenance kit to the printer

options.label: B
options.text: Check the printer paper path to locate any obstructions.

options.label: C
options.text: Turn the printer on and off to see if the error clears.

cards.answer: B. Check the printer paper path to locate any obstructions.
cards.why: Inspect indicated paper path safely; allow hot fuser to cool and follow manual. Pull paper in the instructed direction to avoid damage. A manual-feed prompt may instead mean the job requests another tray or size. Do not bypass a sensor to make the warning disappear.

cards.question: A gigabit-capable PC links at only 100 Mbps. Its copper patch cable has a damaged pair. Which statement correctly guides replacement?

options.label: A
options.text: Use a sound four-pair cable; Cat 5 is not inherently limited to 100 Mbps

options.label: B
options.text: Cat 5e always limits links to 100 Mbps

options.label: D
options.text: Cat 6A always limits links to 100 Mbps

cards.answer: A. Use a sound four-pair cable; Cat 5 is not inherently limited to 100 Mbps
cards.why: 1000BASE-T uses all four pairs and was designed for suitable Category 5 cabling. Damage or negotiation can cause a slower link.

cards.question: A user contacts the help desk in reference to a failing thumbprint scanner. The user states the scanner was functioning correctly yesterday. Which of the following troubleshooting steps should be performed FIRST after the ticket has been filed?
cards.why: Ask what changed and establish symptoms before replacing hardware. A driver lets the OS communicate with hardware. Use the manufacturer or approved update source. A targeted rollback or supported update may help; replacing hardware without testing the software cause is premature.

cards.question: A laptop has been returned for a screen repair. The owner insists the screen is broken, but occasionally a faded image is able to be seen in very bright settings on the desktop. Which of the following steps should the repair technician take FIRST?

options.label: B
options.text: Replace the screen, as the customer insists.

options.label: C
options.text: Recommend the usage of an external display instead.

options.label: D
options.text: Ensure the backlight is functioning as expected.

cards.answer: D. Ensure the backlight is functioning as expected.
cards.why: A faint visible image with illumination failure points to backlight path. LCD means Liquid Crystal Display. Many current LCDs use LED backlighting; some older CCFL-backlit displays use an inverter. Do not prescribe an inverter replacement for every dim modern screen. Check brightness settings too.

cards.question: A technician powers on a PC and its monitor and sees the following error message: No input signal detected The display lights on the computer are on. Which of the following is a possible solution?

options.label: B
options.text: Changing the connector setting on the monitor

options.label: C
options.text: Checking the power plug on the monitor

options.label: D
options.text: Checking the power plug on the PC

cards.answer: B. Changing the connector setting on the monitor
cards.why: Select matching monitor input and verify video cable/path. The display can have power while receiving no usable signal. Test with a known-good cable or source to narrow the fault. A no-signal message alone does not prove a failed GPU.

cards.question: A laptop works with a large local database. Monitoring confirms heavy paging and a slow HDD bottleneck. The laptop supports RAM and SATA SSD upgrades. Which two changes address those findings? (Select TWO.)
cards.answer: D. Increase the RAM.; E. Migrate to a SSD.
cards.why: More RAM reduces paging; an SSD improves storage access. Neither change is justified by a database workload alone without checking the bottleneck.

cards.question: A user reports that a PC occasionally falls to boot. The user reboots the PC. but the performance is degrading. The technician hears a strange, repetitive, ticking noise coming from the PC. Which of the following should the technician do FIRST?
cards.why: Prioritize recoverable data; minimize use and escalate irreplaceable data to recovery specialists. Repeated unnecessary use can worsen some failures. Check connections too, but do not assume a filesystem repair fixes mechanical damage. A current tested backup reduces the impact.

cards.question: A company just bought a printer capable of automatically printing on both sides of the paper After installation, however, the technician can only print on both sides of the paper manually. Which of the following should the technician do to fix the issue?

options.label: A
options.text: Install the most recent firmware upgrade available for the printer.

options.label: B
options.text: Contact the vendor for a hardware replacement.

options.label: C
options.text: Reinstall the printer software and drivers, and then restart the printer.

options.label: D
options.text: Read the installation manual and configure duplex settings.

cards.answer: D. Read the installation manual and configure duplex settings.
cards.why: Enable automatic duplex in supported printer driver/settings. Automatic duplex hardware turns or routes the page internally; manual duplex asks the user to reinsert it. Choose the correct binding edge so the back side is not upside down.

cards.question: Which of the following concepts would be used by an online retailer to quickly add more web servers during peak sales times?
cards.why: Capacity grows and shrinks with demand. Multi-tenancy means multiple customers use shared underlying infrastructure with logical separation. Keeping unnecessary capacity permanently allocated is overprovisioning, not the definition of elasticity.

cards.question: An external USB webcam's app shows no image. The camera's USB plug is loose, and the privacy shutter is open. Which action should be tried first?
cards.why: A loose USB connection interrupts the camera's data or power path. Check the simple physical fault before software changes.

cards.question: Which of the following BEST describes the main function of a web server?

options.label: A
options.text: Storing files and controlling user access

options.label: B
options.text: Setting up personal mailboxes and calendars

options.label: C
options.text: Providing IP addresses and printing services

options.label: D
options.text: Hosting home pages and business portals

cards.answer: D. Hosting home pages and business portals
cards.why: Web server responds to HTTP/HTTPS requests. HTTP means Hypertext Transfer Protocol. TLS means Transport Layer Security. HTTPS protects the connection; it does not prove that a site's claims are honest. HTTP/3 uses QUIC over UDP, commonly on 443.

cards.question: Office Wi-Fi becomes slow near a running microwave, while wired clients remain normal. A survey shows interference on the affected 2.4 GHz channel. Which cause fits?
cards.why: The measured interference and timing point to radio interference, not the internet provider or a hidden network name.

cards.question: A technician is commissioning a workstation that is required to have mirrored storage, utilizing two 4TB drives that support one failure. Which of the following BEST meets these requirements?
cards.why: Two mirrored 4 TB disks give about 4 TB usable and survive one disk loss; not a backup. Usable capacity is limited to roughly one member's capacity, assuming equal drives and ignoring overhead. Mirroring also copies unwanted changes, so a separate backup is still necessary.

cards.question: Which of the following standards supports MIMO technology?
cards.why: 802.11n introduced MIMO among listed standards; later Wi-Fi also supports it. Both ends must support the relevant features. MU-MIMO means Multi-User MIMO. Antenna count, channel width and stream count influence the link; they do not guarantee internet speed.

cards.question: Several keys on a laptop miss keystrokes. An external keyboard works normally, and debris is visible around the affected keys. Which supported action should be tried first?

options.label: C
options.text: Reset the BIOS settings to default.

cards.why: Debris can obstruct key movement. Clean using the manufacturer's procedure; continued failures may require keyboard service.

cards.question: A technician is setting up a new desktop computer and will be installing the hard drive directly on the motherboard without using cables to connect it. Which of the following will the technician be installing?
cards.why: M.2 SSD plugs into motherboard slot; verify SATA/NVMe support. Match the electrical interface, keying and supported card length. M.2 2280 is about 0.87 by 3.15 inches; the name retains the standard's size code. A physically fitting drive may still be unsupported.

cards.question: Which of the following would MOST likely be used to obtain electronic images of a large number of printed documents?
cards.why: ADF feeds multiple sheets; flatbed suits single or bound originals. It handles input pages. It is not the same as a printer's output duplexer. Check whether the particular ADF supports scanning both sides.

cards.question: A traveler needs internet at remote camps without reliable cellular coverage. The destinations permit a portable satellite terminal and offer power and an unobstructed sky view. Which option fits best?
cards.why: Satellite can serve remote locations without a wired last-mile connection. Coverage, local rules and suitable terminal placement remain necessary.

cards.question: Which device can keep a virtualization host running through a brief loss of utility power or give it time to shut down safely?
cards.why: A UPS supplies temporary battery power. It is one part of availability planning, not a guarantee of maximum uptime.

cards.question: Large spreadsheets perform poorly when opened together. Monitoring confirms memory pressure and heavy paging; the workstation supports more RAM. Which upgrade addresses this bottleneck?

options.label: B
options.text: Upgrade the CPU in the workstation.

options.label: C
options.text: Upgrade the power supply in the workstation.

options.label: D
options.text: Upgrade the RAM in the workstation.

cards.answer: D. Upgrade the RAM in the workstation.
cards.why: The measured memory shortage justifies the RAM upgrade. File size or slow performance alone would not prove the cause.

cards.question: A 275 ft copper Ethernet run intermittently loses its link. The NIC manual confirms its indicator reports link errors. What is the best first physical inspection?

options.label: A
options.text: Check the RJ45 end connectors, the jacks, and the ends of the run of the Cat 5 UTP cable for loose connections, pinched bends, and visible damage.

options.label: B
options.text: Install a powered hub as close as possible to the halfway poi nt in the Cat 5 UTP cable run.

options.label: C
options.text: Replace the entire run of Cat 5 UTP cable with Cat 5 STP cabl e.

options.label: D
options.text: Upgrade the entire cable run to multimode fiber.

cards.answer: A. Check the RJ45 end connectors, the jacks, and the ends of the run of the Cat 5 UTP cable for loose connections, pinched bends, and visible damage.
cards.why: Inspect terminations and visible damage before replacing the entire run. This length is below the usual 328 ft channel limit; LED colors are model-specific.

cards.question: A wireless device cannot select a channel that appears quiet in a spectrum scan. What should the technician verify first?

options.label: A
options.text: Whether the channel is supported and permitted under the correct regional settings

options.label: B
options.text: Whether changing to any foreign country code bypasses the restriction

options.label: C
options.text: Whether every quiet frequency is automatically unlicensed

options.label: D
options.text: Whether higher transmit power unlocks every channel

cards.answer: A. Whether the channel is supported and permitted under the correct regional settings
cards.why: Quiet spectrum is not necessarily legal or supported spectrum. Hardware, regulatory rules and features such as radar detection affect channel availability.

cards.question: Which of the following is a valid use for PaaS?

options.label: C
options.text: A virtual server installation and configuration model

options.label: D
options.text: A web application for asset management

cards.why: Managed runtime/development platform supports deploying app code. It supplies an application platform so developers can focus on code and data. The exact responsibility boundary depends on the service; it is different from renting a bare VM to administer yourself.

cards.question: An Intel-based Mac supports a hypervisor, a licensed Windows guest and the required Windows-only application. Which solution runs that application locally in a separate guest OS?
cards.why: A compatible Windows VM can run the application. Guest architecture, licensing and hardware support must match; this is not guaranteed for every Mac or application.

cards.question: A technician needs to add storage to a workstation. The workstation does not have room to add any internal storage, so the technician plans to add an external storage device. Which of the following connection types should the technician MOST likely use?
cards.why: eSATA is an external SATA interface; retained as explicitly listed legacy hardware knowledge. NVMe is designed for efficient access to nonvolatile storage such as SSDs. An M.2 SATA SSD does not become NVMe because it is small. Match the host interface and enclosure.

cards.question: Which of the following utilizes TCP ports 20/21 and transfers data in cleartext?
cards.why: FTP control uses TCP 21; active-mode data traditionally TCP 20; unencrypted without TLS. Passive mode uses a server-selected data port. Plain FTP does not encrypt credentials or files. SFTP is a different protocol carried over SSH, normally TCP 22.

cards.question: Upon booting a workstation, a technician hears a distinct clicking sound after power is applied to the motherboard. Which of the following would MOST likely be the cause?
cards.why: Mechanical HDD can click; SSD has no moving parts. Repeated unnecessary use can worsen some failures. Check connections too, but do not assume a filesystem repair fixes mechanical damage. A current tested backup reduces the impact.

cards.question: A user reports issues with a smartphone after dropping it. The icons on the screen all look normal, but when the user touches the email icon, for example, nothing happens. Which of the following is MOST likely the cause?
cards.why: Normal picture with lost touch points to input path, subject to further diagnosis. The digitizer turns touches into location data. Check supported calibration, driver and settings first. Inspect hardware and connections if appropriate. A working image does not prove the touch layer works, and not every screen supports manual calibration.

cards.question: A laser printer produces repeated ghost images. The manufacturer's defect-spacing guide identifies the fuser, and its maintenance interval is overdue. Which component should be serviced?
cards.why: The model-specific diagnostic evidence identifies the fuser. Ghosting alone can also involve other imaging components.

cards.question: How do an ordinary Ethernet hub and a switch handle a unicast frame whose destination is already in the switch's MAC table?

options.label: A
options.text: The switch forwards it to the learned destination port; the hub repeats the signal to its other ports

options.label: B
options.text: The switch compresses it; the hub does not

options.label: C
options.text: The switch always floods every frame to every port

options.label: D
options.text: The switch encrypts every frame automatically

cards.answer: A. The switch forwards it to the learned destination port; the hub repeats the signal to its other ports
cards.why: The qualification 'known destination' matters. Switches still flood broadcasts and unknown unicast frames within the applicable VLAN.

cards.question: A phone becomes abnormally hot while charging, loses capacity rapidly, and its battery-health test reports a battery fault. Which component is implicated?
cards.why: The battery-health result supplies direct evidence. Stop charging and arrange safe service; heat or slowness alone would not identify the part.

cards.question: A remote user reports connectivity issues with the local internet provider. Even after a technician reboots the modem supplied by the ISP. the issue persists. Which of the following would BEST establish the connection in minimal time?
cards.why: Authorized cellular hotspot can provide temporary connectivity where coverage permits. A hotspot commonly shares cellular service over Wi-Fi; tethering is the broader sharing idea. A compatible cellular modem is another option. Carrier plans, coverage and data allowances still apply.

cards.question: A technician is upgrading a faulty motherboard that was ordered by an end user for an old, high-end desktop computer. However, the technician is unable to install the CPU into the socket. Upon closer inspection, the technician notices the pins on the CPU do not line up with the socket. Which of the following would be the best course of action for the technician to take NEXT?

options.label: A
options.text: Try to set as many pins as possible.

options.label: B
options.text: Install an adaptor to create a universal socket.

options.label: C
options.text: Verify the socket type and manufacturer.

options.label: D
options.text: Find a compatible motherboard for the CPU.

cards.answer: C. Verify the socket type and manufacturer.
cards.why: Verify CPU socket, chipset and firmware support; never force a CPU. A socket is the physical CPU connection. Check the motherboard's supported CPU list and required firmware version. Avoid forcing a processor or relying only on a family name such as Core i7.

cards.question: A direct-thermal receipt printer produces overly dark receipts on approved media. The head is clean, but its heat/density setting exceeds the media specification. Which adjustment fits?

options.label: A
options.text: The ribbon is jammed and is rubbing on the paper. Clear the b ad ribbon and feed it through properly.

options.label: B
options.text: The printhead is too hot. Adjust the temperature down and ret ry printing.

options.label: C
options.text: The printer is loaded with the wrong type of paper. Replace the receipt paper with carbon paper.

options.label: D
options.text: The blue ink cartridge was loaded with black ink. Put in the correct ink and clean the printhead.

cards.answer: B. The printhead is too hot. Adjust the temperature down and ret ry printing.
cards.why: Excess heat darkens heat-sensitive media. Use the approved setting; this printer does not use an ink cartridge or ink ribbon.

cards.question: A copper Ethernet patch cord fails when its damaged modular plug moves. Which two items are needed to replace a plug designed for crimp termination? (Select TWO.)
cards.why: Use a compatible RJ45-style plug and the correct crimper. A wall jack may instead use a punchdown or tool-less termination.

cards.question: Which of the following describes the main difference between T568Aand T568B cabling standards?

options.label: A
options.text: The T568B data transfer rate is higher than T568A.

options.label: B
options.text: The green and the orange cables are interchanged.

options.label: C
options.text: T568A is used in blue cables, and T568B is used in green cabl es.

options.label: D
options.text: The standards use different cable connectors.

cards.answer: B. The green and the orange cables are interchanged.
cards.why: T568A and T568B swap orange and green pair positions, not throughput. A straight-through cable uses the same scheme at both ends. A and B swap the orange and green pair positions. Keep each pair correctly twisted and follow the connector's wiring guide.

cards.question: A desktop repeatedly loses its date and time after it is unplugged. Diagnostics report a weak replaceable RTC coin-cell battery. Which action fits?

options.label: D
options.text: Restore the BIOS to factory default settings.

cards.why: The backup battery maintains the real-time clock without external power. Follow the model's replacement procedure.

cards.question: Which listed device normally routes between separate IP networks and does not forward ordinary Layer 2 broadcasts between them?

options.label: A
options.text: An unmanaged switch with one VLAN

options.label: B
options.text: A wireless access point bridging one LAN

cards.why: Routing separates networks. A managed switch can also create broadcast domains with VLANs, so 'switches never separate broadcasts' would be wrong.

cards.question: A smartphone shares a short-range Bluetooth network connection with a nearby laptop. What network category best describes this personal-device link?
cards.why: A Personal Area Network connects a person's nearby devices. A cable used only for charging would not create a network.

cards.question: A fast-food restaurant has been using a printer to create sales receipts on a PoS kiosk. The restaurant recently purchased a new brand of receipt paper rolls. After installing one of the new rolls, the printer outputs blank paper. Which of the following is the MOST likely cause of the issue?
cards.why: Direct thermal printing needs compatible heat-sensitive paper with correct orientation. A direct thermal printer does not require an ink ribbon. Wrong media, heat settings or a dirty head can affect output. Choose the method and approved media for the label's required durability.

cards.question: An older laptop misses keystrokes, while an external keyboard works. Debris obstructs several built-in keys. Which manufacturer-approved action should be tried first?

options.label: C
options.text: Reset the BIOS settings to default

cards.why: The external keyboard narrows the fault to the built-in input path, and visible debris supports cleaning before replacement.

cards.question: A company's IT department frequently needs to work on several machines at once. The department wants to increase productivity by allowing a single mouse, keyboard, and monitor to instantly shift between one of eight computers on a workbench. Which of the following would BEST facilitate this approach?
cards.why: Keyboard/video/mouse switch shares peripherals between computers. A KVM switch changes which computer receives those input/output devices. It does not combine the computers' CPU power or act as a general network switch.

cards.question: A laptop's SATA HDD clicks loudly and needs replacement. The laptop accepts a 2.5-inch SATA drive but has no SAS controller. Which listed storage option avoids moving parts and fits its interface?
cards.why: A SATA SSD fits the stated interface and has no spinning mechanism. A 15,000 rpm HDD is still mechanical, and a SAS SSD needs SAS support.

cards.question: A technician needs to convert an existing workstation to host several virtual test computers and servers. Which of the following must be installed and configured on the workstation before any virtual computers can be installed?
cards.why: Hypervisor creates/manages VMs and allocates host resources. A VM presents virtual hardware to a guest OS. A management interface that looks like a desktop app does not by itself determine the hypervisor type.

cards.question: Three nearby 2.4 GHz access points in a US office interfere with each other. Which change best addresses co-channel and overlapping-channel use?

options.label: A
options.text: Increase every AP's transmit power to maximum

options.label: B
options.text: Put every AP in a different IP subnet

options.label: C
options.text: Give every AP several extra SSIDs

options.label: D
options.text: Plan nonoverlapping 20 MHz channels, commonly 1, 6 and 11

cards.answer: D. Plan nonoverlapping 20 MHz channels, commonly 1, 6 and 11
cards.why: Channel planning addresses radio contention. Merely choosing different channel numbers is insufficient if those channels overlap.

cards.question: An IT manager is requesting that the company buy new cables to be used with F-type connectors that are already in-house. Which of the following cables should the company buy?
cards.why: F connectors terminate coaxial cable. Plenum describes a fire/smoke rating, not a connector geometry.

cards.question: A technician deployed a new computer and patched the unit to the data jack. However, no Ethernet connection is detected. The technician suspects the patch panel is incorrectly numbered. Which of the following tools will the technician MOST likely use to locate the jack on the patch panel?

options.label: B
options.text: A tone generator and a probe

cards.answer: B. A tone generator and a probe
cards.why: A tone generator and probe help trace this unlabeled run to its patch-panel termination. A loopback plug tests an interface instead.

cards.question: A gaming PC already has a suitable CPU, motherboard and PSU with built-in networking. Its parts list still needs working memory, a discrete graphics processor and fast local storage. Which three listed parts fill those roles? (Select THREE.)
cards.answer: A. NVMe drive; E. Graphics processing unit; F. RAM
cards.why: RAM supplies working memory, the GPU handles graphics, and an NVMe drive supplies fast storage when supported. Accessories do not fill these missing roles.

cards.question: A technician for a cable provider is setting up high-speed Internet service at a residential customer's home. The type of cabling the technician will use to connect from the outside pole into the customer's home is MOST likely:
cards.why: Traditional cable internet commonly uses coax for the final connection; access networks vary. WAN means Wide Area Network; LAN means Local Area Network. An analog phone needs a working phone service or compatible voice port, not an ordinary Ethernet jack.

cards.question: Which of the following cloud computing concepts provides the ability to scale services as needed to accommodate changes?
cards.why: Rapid elasticity lets capacity expand or contract as demand changes. Measured service tracks usage rather than adjusting capacity.

cards.question: A traveler forgot the laptop charger. Bluetooth accessories are not needed. Which two listed actions are most useful for reducing power use? (Select TWO.)
cards.answer: B. Dim the screen's brightness.; D. Turn off Bluetooth.
cards.why: Dimming the display reduces a major power load. Turning off an unused radio can also save power; turning radios on does not.

cards.question: A printer needs manually configured IPv4 connectivity both within its subnet and to a remote subnet. Which three network values must be set for that routing? (Select THREE.)
cards.answer: C. Gateway; D. Subnet mask; G. IP address
cards.why: The IP address identifies the printer, the mask defines its subnet, and the default gateway reaches other networks. A driver is installed on a client or server, not one of these IP values.

cards.question: A user is performing an ipconfig but does not see the expected IP address. The user wants to perform a release and renew of the IP to see if that will fix the issue. Which of the following is the user utilizing?
cards.why: Release/renew requests DHCP lease configuration. The client needs an address and network settings before it can communicate normally. DNS resolves names; DHCP supplies configuration. They perform different jobs even when one server runs both.

cards.question: An office wants a USB-only printer available to coworkers only while its sharing PC is powered on and connected. Which two configurations achieve this? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: Configure the printer on WiFi in Joe's office.

options.label: B
options.text: Enable file and printer sharing on Joe's computer.

options.label: C
options.text: Enable cloud printing on the printer using Joe's email accoun t.

options.label: D
options.text: Disable point spooling on all other users' computers.

options.label: E
options.text: Install the printer via USB to Joe's computer.

options.label: F
options.text: Connect the printer through Ethernet at Joe's desk.

cards.answer: B. Enable file and printer sharing on Joe's computer.; E. Install the printer via USB to Joe's computer.
cards.why: Connect the printer to that PC by USB and enable authorized printer sharing. The setup depends on host availability; it does not sense whether the manager is physically present.

cards.question: Which network device learns MAC addresses and forwards Ethernet frames to known destination ports?
cards.why: An Ethernet switch uses its MAC table for Layer 2 forwarding. This differs from routing IP packets between networks.

cards.question: A statically configured laptop reaches a server by IP address, but a lookup of the server's hostname fails. Which configured service should be investigated?
cards.why: DNS resolves the hostname. Test the hostname itself; ping does not accept a full UNC share path as a host name.

cards.question: A user wants to hear game audio, talk to other players and control a game without a keyboard. The user does not want a VR display. Which two listed accessories meet these needs? (Select TWO.)
cards.why: A headset combines headphones and a microphone. A supported game controller provides game input without a keyboard.

cards.question: Three 2.4 GHz access points in the United States use 20 MHz channels. Which channel plan avoids conventional overlap?
cards.why: Channels 1, 6 and 11 are the conventional nonoverlapping set for this stated band and region.

cards.question: Which of the following cloud computing concepts allows a provider to bill a client for the amount of resources the client uses?
cards.why: Measured service records resource consumption so the provider can apply the contract's usage charges.

cards.question: A technician wants DHCP to supply centrally tracked, predictable IPv4 addresses to specified clients. Which method fits best?

options.label: A
options.text: Set up a DHCP pool for the entire subnet and exclusions for e ach static IP address that is needed.

options.label: B
options.text: Create a spreadsheet and record each IP address and the devic e to which it is assigned.

options.label: C
options.text: Set up DHCP reservations for all static IP addresses that nee d to be assigned.

options.label: D
options.text: Create a separate subnet for each device type on the network that needs an IP address.

cards.answer: C. Set up DHCP reservations for all static IP addresses that nee d to be assigned.
cards.why: A reservation associates a client identifier with a lease address. This differs from typing a manual static address on each device.

cards.question: Which of the following connector types does not require a specific orientation?
cards.why: USB-C connector is reversible; shape alone does not specify features or speed. USB 2.0 is up to 480 Mbps; USB 3.2 modes include 5, 10 and 20 Gbps. Mbps and Gbps mean millions and billions of bits per second. The slowest supported link capability limits operation.

cards.question: A VM has no external connectivity while its host is online. The VM's adapter is connected only to a host-only network. Which change can provide ordinary external access?

options.label: A
options.text: Attach the virtual adapter to a correctly configured NAT or bridged network

options.label: B
options.text: Add a hosts-file entry without changing the network

cards.answer: A. Attach the virtual adapter to a correctly configured NAT or bridged network
cards.why: Host-only networking normally lacks an external route. Configure the appropriate virtual network and guest addressing; bridged mode does not inherently require a static IP.

cards.question: Which device typically forwards traffic between a small office's LAN and its internet connection?
cards.why: A router joins IP networks. A combined home gateway may also contain an access point and modem.

cards.question: Joe, a user, recently purchased a new multifunction printer and attempted to install it himself. He informed a technician that the printer is on his list of printers, but he is unable to print. The technician sees that the printer is listed as a generic printer under Devices and Printers. Which of the following should the technician do NEXT?

options.label: A
options.text: Reboot the computer into safe mode and try to print a test pa ge

options.label: B
options.text: Download the correct drivers from the manufacturer's website and install them

options.label: C
options.text: Unplug the USB cable from the printer and try another USB slo t on the PC

options.label: D
options.text: Set the printer as the default within the device properties

cards.answer: B. Download the correct drivers from the manufacturer's website and install them
cards.why: Install model/OS-compatible vendor driver; generic driver may lack needed support. A driver translates print jobs into a format the printer understands. PCL means Printer Command Language. Different operating systems may need different supported drivers or driverless printing support.

cards.question: Which of the following is the MOST likely cause for a network PC to have an APIPA address?
cards.why: IPv4 link-local address commonly indicates no DHCP reply on an auto-configured client. APIPA means Automatic Private IP Addressing. It permits local-link communication without a DHCP lease. Routers do not forward it. Check the cable or Wi-Fi connection and DHCP service; it does not by itself prove the server is broken.

cards.question: Several users cannot print through one shared queue. The printer's own test page succeeds, but a failed job blocks that queue. Which action targets the identified problem?

options.label: B
options.text: Reinstall the drivers on users' PCs.

cards.why: Clear the affected stuck job or queue using the authorized procedure. A successful internal page makes a blanket printer hardware replacement premature.

cards.question: A projector's image begins to flicker during a presentation. The laptop display does not produce this issue. When a technician changes the resolution on the laptop, the issue persists. Which of the following is the NEXT step the technician should take?

options.label: A
options.text: Check the connectivity of the VGA cable.

options.label: B
options.text: Check the connectivity of the power cable.

options.label: C
options.text: Change the aspect ratio on the laptop.

options.label: D
options.text: Change the settings of the projector.

cards.answer: A. Check the connectivity of the VGA cable.
cards.why: Check signal cable and connections before replacing display components. The display can have power while receiving no usable signal. Test with a known-good cable or source to narrow the fault. A no-signal message alone does not prove a failed GPU.

cards.question: A phone can read mail through IMAP but cannot send it. The SMTP server and credentials are correct, but the server requires TLS and the client has encryption disabled. What should be changed?

options.label: A
options.text: Configure the email account as a POP3 connection

options.label: B
options.text: Ensure the SSL/TLS option is being used

options.label: C
options.text: Check that the account password is still valid

options.label: D
options.text: Make sure the smartphone is not in airplane mode

cards.answer: B. Ensure the SSL/TLS option is being used
cards.why: SMTP sends mail; IMAP reads it. Enable the required transport encryption rather than changing the mailbox retrieval protocol.

cards.question: After a wireless router is added to an existing LAN, some clients receive leases from an unauthorized DHCP service with the wrong network options. Which issue fits?

options.label: A
options.text: There are conflicting DHCP servers on the network

options.label: C
options.text: There are conflicting gateways on the network

cards.answer: A. There are conflicting DHCP servers on the network
cards.why: Two DHCP services are supplying conflicting configurations. Identify and correct the unauthorized service rather than assuming DNS is the cause.

cards.question: A laptop's dock and monitor are compatible and connected, but Windows is set to 'PC screen only.' Which change enables a separate external workspace?
cards.why: Extended display mode enables the external screen as additional desktop space. Working USB ports alone would not prove video compatibility.

cards.question: A thermostat supports current Wi-Fi security and an online account with optional two-factor authentication. Which two choices directly strengthen these access paths? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: Use the latest encryption standard on the wireless network an d set a strong password.

options.label: B
options.text: Enable two-factor authentication for the IoT device's cloud a ccount, if it is available.

options.label: C
options.text: Separate the IoT thermostat by segregating it in a DMZ networ k.

options.label: D
options.text: Disable wireless access on the thermostat to make it unshakab le.

options.label: E
options.text: Upgrade the customer's router to the latest version to improv e network security.

options.label: F
options.text: Upgrade the customer's wireless network encryption to WPA.

cards.answer: A. Use the latest encryption standard on the wireless network an d set a strong password.; B. Enable two-factor authentication for the IoT device's cloud a ccount, if it is available.
cards.why: Use a supported modern wireless security mode and strong passphrase, plus two-factor authentication for the cloud account. Original WPA is obsolete protection.

cards.question: A new laptop and old desktop use the same manually assigned IP address. The banking application must retain that address on the desktop; the laptop may use DHCP. Which action resolves the conflict while preserving the requirement?

options.label: A
options.text: Remove the static IP configuration from the desktop.

options.label: B
options.text: Set the laptop configuration to DHCP to prevent conflicts.

options.label: C
options.text: Replace the network card in the laptop, as it may be defectiv e.

options.label: D
options.text: Bridge the LAN connection between the laptop and the desktop.

cards.answer: B. Set the laptop configuration to DHCP to prevent conflicts.
cards.why: Leave the required address on the desktop and give the laptop a unique DHCP lease. Confirm the static address is excluded from the DHCP pool.

cards.question: Which of the following is the main purpose of the +5VSB output of a power supply?

options.label: A
options.text: It supplies selected standby and wake circuits while AC remains connected

options.label: B
options.text: It supplies only the audio board

options.label: C
options.text: It is the sole main power rail for the CPU

options.label: D
options.text: It fully powers every expansion card and external hub

cards.answer: A. It supplies selected standby and wake circuits while AC remains connected
cards.why: The +5 V standby rail remains available for supported standby functions. A shut-down but plugged-in computer can still have energized circuits.

cards.question: Which of the following is used to connect a headset to a laptop?
cards.why: USB can carry headset audio and microphone data. HDMI means High-Definition Multimedia Interface and can carry audio and video. The OS may still send sound to another output. A supported USB audio device is another sound interface, not a video-cable repair.

cards.question: Which two listed 802.11 standards operate only in the 5 GHz band? (Select TWO.)
cards.why: Both 802.11a and 802.11ac use 5 GHz. The original single-answer key omitted ac; 802.11b and g use 2.4 GHz.

cards.question: A video editor has adequate CPU, GPU and RAM but needs faster local project access and more desktop workspace. Which two additions directly address those needs? (Select TWO.)
cards.why: An SSD improves local storage access; a second monitor adds visual workspace. Neither substitutes for adequate processing resources.

cards.question: A business wants one supported laptop accessory that supplies charging, a wired LAN connection and several peripheral ports. Which device best fits?
cards.why: A compatible docking station combines these connections. Verify that the host port, cable and dock support every required feature.

cards.question: A PC is slow even though CPU, RAM and network utilization are normal. An authorized antivirus test did not change performance, and protection is re-enabled. Which listed check investigates a remaining storage cause?

options.label: A
options.text: Check to see if insufficient hard drive space is causing the issue

options.label: B
options.text: Update the operating system, drivers, and firmware on the PC

options.label: C
options.text: Log into the PC with another user profile and test performanc e

options.label: D
options.text: Shut down the PC, unplug the power for 30 seconds, and then b oot the PC

cards.answer: A. Check to see if insufficient hard drive space is causing the issue
cards.why: Low free space and storage activity deserve inspection. The normal readings do not prove storage is healthy or justify leaving protection disabled.

cards.question: A customer accidentally drops a laptop while it is charging. The next day, the customer notices the laptop will not turn on and calls a technician to investigate. The technician confirms the laptop will not turn on and calls a technician to investigate. The technician confirms the laptop will not turn on even though it is connected to the power adapter. Which of the following components is the MOST likely cause of this behavior?
cards.why: Drop while plugged in can damage charging connector or board; inspect safely. Test a compatible known-good cable and charger. Follow approved cleaning instructions; do not force metal objects into the port. A damaged port may need service, but the symptom alone does not identify the failed part.

cards.question: An employee's mobile device no longer charges, and the employee believes the battery is bad. A technician tests the mobile device and finds it will charge on a wireless charging pad but not when it is connected to a charging cable. Other devices charge without issue when the cable is used. Which of the following should the technician perform FIRST to resolve the issue?

options.label: A
options.text: Clean out the charging port on the device

options.label: C
options.text: Issue a new charging cable to the employee

options.label: D
options.text: Send the device for service and give the employee a loaner

cards.answer: A. Clean out the charging port on the device
cards.why: Wireless success with known-good wired charger points to wired charging path; inspect debris/damage safely.

cards.question: A graphics card works in its original computer. In another PC, gaming causes shutdowns; temperatures are normal and the PSU's available output is below the card and system requirements. Which issue fits?
cards.why: The stated power deficit supports an inadequate PSU. GPU load alone would not rule out overheating or other faults.

cards.question: A new PC produces a repeating beep pattern before any image appears. Its monitor displays 'No source.' What should the technician consult first?

options.label: A
options.text: A universal list claiming all beep codes are identical

options.label: D
options.text: The exact computer model's POST-code documentation

cards.answer: D. The exact computer model's POST-code documentation
cards.why: POST codes vary by model. Interpret the observed pattern before choosing a replacement component.

cards.question: A desktop's mechanical HDD clicks repeatedly during file access. The data is still readable, and a current backup is missing. Which listed action best protects the data before further repair?
cards.answer: D. Perform a full data backup.
cards.why: Protect recoverable data first. If the data is irreplaceable or the drive becomes unreadable, stop unnecessary use and consider professional recovery.

cards.question: A laptop does not need cellular service or Bluetooth accessories during a task. Disabling which two listed radios may extend battery runtime? (Select TWO.)
cards.why: Turn off unused cellular and Bluetooth radios. Savings depend on hardware and workload, so no fixed improvement is guaranteed.

cards.question: A company integrates its private cloud with a public cloud so workloads can use both environments. What deployment model is this?
cards.why: A hybrid cloud combines distinct cloud infrastructures. Merely keeping some ordinary local files and some cloud files would not establish this model.

cards.question: A printer stops working in the billing department and cannot be repaired. A new printer has been ordered and a technician is tasked with allowing other users to print to the billing manager's printer until the new printer arrives. The manager's printer is currently used via USB connection, and there are no network jacks available for use. Which of the following is the BEST way for the technician to allow access to the printer?

options.label: A
options.text: Create a share on the manager's computer and give the users r ights to the share.

options.label: B
options.text: Install the printer on the users' desktops and point it to th e IP address of the manager's computer.

options.label: C
options.text: Purchase a wireless printer so the users can access the print er via network.

options.label: D
options.text: Provide flash drives to the users so they can transfer data t o the manager's computer for printing.

cards.answer: A. Create a share on the manager's computer and give the users r ights to the share.
cards.why: Share the existing USB printer through the manager's computer and grant authorized users access. The host must remain available.

cards.question: After a phone OS update, the car pairing is still saved, but the phone's Bluetooth radio is disabled. What should the technician do next?

options.label: A
options.text: Connect the smartphone to the automobile via USB

options.label: C
options.text: Perform a rollback of the smartphone's OS

options.label: D
options.text: Pair the smartphone with the automobile

cards.answer: B. Reenable the smartphone's Bluetooth radio
cards.why: Enable Bluetooth so the saved pairing can connect. If the pairing itself were lost, re-pairing would be a different repair.

cards.question: A test VM's virtual NIC is attached to the wrong virtual switch and cannot reach its required network. The host is online. Which setting should be corrected?
cards.why: The virtual switch connects the guest's adapter to the intended network. Changing virtual RAM or CPU does not repair this path.

cards.question: Which of the following IEEE 802.11 standards includes the use of MIMO technology?
cards.why: Of these choices, 802.11n supports MIMO. Later Wi-Fi generations also support it.

cards.question: Which of the following cloud computing concepts allows scalable services to be provided to the client?
cards.why: Rapid elasticity expands or contracts resources with demand. Resource pooling describes shared underlying resources, not the scaling action itself.

cards.question: Which evidence most directly supports a diagnosis of faulty RAM?

options.label: A
options.text: A model-specific diagnostic test reports reproducible memory errors

options.label: B
options.text: The clock is wrong after power removal

options.label: C
options.text: The printer is out of paper

cards.answer: A. A model-specific diagnostic test reports reproducible memory errors
cards.why: Memory-test errors are stronger evidence than generic crashes. POST codes must be interpreted using the model's documentation.

cards.question: A cloud-sync app shows files locally as placeholders and downloads their contents when opened. Which feature does this describe?
cards.why: An online-only placeholder represents a cloud file without storing all its contents locally. Accessing it generally requires a download.

cards.question: A user brings in a smartphone for repair. The device is unable to send/receive calls or connect to WiFi. All applications on the device are working unless they require connectivity. Which of the following is MOST likely causing the problem?
cards.why: Airplane mode may disable cellular and Wi-Fi; many devices allow Wi-Fi to be re-enabled. Airplane mode controls radios, but some systems let Wi-Fi or Bluetooth be turned back on separately. Verify actual radio settings. A phone may use cellular data when Wi-Fi is unavailable, depending on settings.

cards.question: Ann, a user, needs to attend several day-long conferences and wants to ensure her mobile device will have enough power for these events. She is concerned about wall outlet availability at the conferences and needs to continuously use her device for important updates. Which of the following should a technician recommend to BEST accommodate Ann's needs?
cards.why: Compatible charged battery pack/case extends runtime without wall power. W means watts, a power unit. A low-power charger or power bank may charge slowly or fail under load. USB Power Delivery negotiates supported power; the cable also needs the correct rating.

cards.question: A technician suspects name resolution is preventing internet access. Which test best checks that theory?

options.label: A
options.text: Compare a DNS lookup with connectivity to the known destination IP

options.label: D
options.text: Document a confirmed DNS failure without testing

cards.answer: A. Compare a DNS lookup with connectivity to the known destination IP
cards.why: Separate name lookup from connectivity. Browsing an HTTPS site by raw IP can fail for certificate or virtual-host reasons even when DNS is not the problem.

cards.question: A user reports that a laptop is not connecting to the corporate wireless network. A technician confirms a with a smartphone that the corporate wireless network is available and can be accessed. the technician observes that the Ethernet connection to the corporate network is working. The technician disconnects the Ethernet cable. Which of the following should the technician do NEXT to troubleshoot this problem?

options.label: A
options.text: Confirm that the laptop wireless card is turned on.

options.label: B
options.text: Confirm that the laptop is in range for the access point.

options.label: C
options.text: Confirm that the correct wireless network is selected.

options.label: D
options.text: Confirm the user's network login ID and password.

cards.answer: A. Confirm that the laptop wireless card is turned on.
cards.why: Check adapter enabled and hardware/airplane-mode controls. Airplane mode controls radios, but some systems let Wi-Fi or Bluetooth be turned back on separately. Verify actual radio settings. A phone may use cellular data when Wi-Fi is unavailable, depending on settings.

cards.question: Which of the following connector types is used to terminate household telephone cabling?
cards.why: RJ11-style connector commonly used for telephone line connections. WAN means Wide Area Network; LAN means Local Area Network. An analog phone needs a working phone service or compatible voice port, not an ordinary Ethernet jack.

cards.question: A USB-only printer is attached to a workgroup PC on the office LAN. The office will use that PC as the sharing host. What should be enabled so authorized coworkers can print through it?

options.label: A
options.text: Printer sharing on the host PC

options.label: D
options.text: A cloud service unrelated to printing

cards.answer: A. Printer sharing on the host PC
cards.why: The host shares its locally attached printer over the LAN. It must stay powered on and reachable.

cards.question: A technician receives a cellular from a manager. The technician is instructed to download a service manual directly from the Internet to a laptop. However, there is no WiFi signal or wired Ethernet. Which of the following would be the MOST appropriate connections for the technician to use?
cards.why: A phone hotspot can share cellular data with the laptop when authorized and supported. NFC and a VPN do not supply an internet connection by themselves.

cards.question: Which connector commonly terminates the coaxial drop used for residential cable internet?
cards.why: An F connector terminates coax. RG-59 and RG-6 name cable types, not connectors.

cards.question: A technician manually configured the wireless connection on the Chief Information Officer's (ClO's) new laptop so it can communicate with the network at the office The CIO now is having trouble connecting to a guest WiFi hotspot While the device has a gateway address and says it is connected, the CIO cannot access company email Which of the following would BEST resolve the issue?

options.label: A
options.text: Move the ClO's laptop closer to the access point to obtain a better RF signal

options.label: B
options.text: Restart the wireless connection to obtain a self-assigned API PA address

options.label: C
options.text: Assign a different IP address to the device in conflict with the ClO's laptop

options.label: D
options.text: Set the network connection to use DHCP instead of a static ad dress

options.label: E
options.text: Change the network's SSID to a mobile hotspot to access compa ny email

cards.answer: D. Set the network connection to use DHCP instead of a static ad dress
cards.why: A static configuration from another subnet can prevent guest-network access; use authorized DHCP settings.

cards.question: An application server needs a standard layout that stripes across mirrored drive pairs. At least four drives are available. Which RAID level fits?
cards.why: RAID 10 combines striping and mirroring. It does not promise zero downtime, and backups remain necessary.

cards.question: A systems administrator is configuring a server to host several virtual machines. The administrator configures the server and is ready to begin provisioning the virtual machines. Which of the following features should the administrator utilize to complete the task?
cards.why: The hypervisor provisions and manages virtual machines on the host. Disk Management alone does not create a complete VM environment.

cards.question: An office has a network that has all computers connected to two switches. The switches are connected with a fiber cable. The computers and switches are all located in the same building. Which of the following network types does this describe?
cards.why: Local network within building is LAN; fiber does not make it WAN. A LAN serves a local site. A PAN links a person's nearby devices. A MAN spans a metropolitan area. A SAN provides networked storage access, commonly block storage; it is not merely a large office LAN.

cards.question: A computer prompts for an unknown firmware password before startup. The owner authorizes recovery. What should the technician do?

options.label: B
options.text: Replace the disk to bypass the password

options.label: C
options.text: Follow the manufacturer's authorized password-recovery process

options.label: D
options.text: Assume removing the coin cell always clears the password

cards.answer: C. Follow the manufacturer's authorized password-recovery process
cards.why: Password storage and recovery differ by model. Removing the RTC battery is not a reliable universal firmware-password reset.

cards.question: Which service automatically leases IP addresses and supplies network settings to supported clients?
cards.why: DHCP supplies configuration. Clients still need a working link and any required access authorization.

cards.question: Which default TCP port should be blocked to prevent Telnet connections to a server?
cards.why: Telnet normally uses TCP 23. Blocking TCP 21 targets FTP control, not Telnet; other remote-access services need their own policy.

cards.question: Which two ports are commonly associated with SSH and HTTPS, respectively? (Select TWO.)
cards.why: SSH commonly uses TCP 22 and HTTPS TCP 443. Secure operation still depends on the actual service and configuration.

cards.question: After random firmware changes, a PC tries PXE network boot instead of its installed UEFI operating system. What should the technician check first?

options.label: D
options.text: Drive detection, UEFI boot mode and the intended boot entry/order

cards.answer: D. Drive detection, UEFI boot mode and the intended boot entry/order
cards.why: PXE is a network-boot path. Restore the intended local boot configuration after verifying the drive rather than inventing a PXE server address.

cards.question: Which of the following technologies can be used for wireless payments?
cards.why: Near Field Communication supports close-range contactless payment. The payment system still needs a supported device and credentials.

cards.question: An application stops connecting after firewall changes. Before altering security rules, which listed action helps establish the scope of the failure?

options.label: A
options.text: See if the same application fails on another workstation

options.label: B
options.text: Go into the firewall and open the port

options.label: C
options.text: Verify system functionality on the user's workstation

options.label: D
options.text: Document the issue for future reference

cards.answer: A. See if the same application fails on another workstation
cards.why: Reproduce the failure on another workstation, then inspect relevant traffic and firewall logs. Do not blindly open ports.

cards.question: A technician must replace a laptop screen but lacks the model-specific service instructions. What should be done before disassembly?

options.label: A
options.text: Obtain the vendor service procedure, then document cables and screws during authorized work

options.label: B
options.text: Force the case open using a similar model's layout

options.label: D
options.text: Remove every visible screw while the laptop is powered

cards.answer: A. Obtain the vendor service procedure, then document cables and screws during authorized work
cards.why: The correct service procedure identifies power isolation, cable routing and safe disassembly. Labeling alone cannot replace missing instructions.

cards.question: A customer lost a RAID 0 volume after one HDD failed. The replacement design should use four drives in mirrored pairs with data striped across those pairs. Which configuration fits?

options.label: A
options.text: RAID 1 configuration that will utilize new SSD.

options.label: B
options.text: RAID 2 configuration that will allow the loss of a hard drive without failure.

options.label: C
options.text: RAID 6 configuration that will allow the loss of two hard dri ves without failure.

cards.why: RAID 10 adds mirrored redundancy to striping. It does not guarantee faster performance than every RAID 0 system.

cards.question: A workstation was just moved to a new work location without a surge protector. It was working the day before, but now the PC will not power on, the fans will not spin, and there are no signs of activity. Which of the following should the technician do FIRST?

options.label: B
options.text: Check the voltage of the PSU with a tester

cards.answer: A. Check the power cable connection
cards.why: Check power source, cable and switch first before internal replacement. PSU means Power Supply Unit. Verify simple external causes before opening the chassis. A dark system can have several causes; it is not automatic proof of a failed motherboard.

cards.question: A technician has been informed that multiple users are receiving duplicate IP address warnings on their workstations, and they are unable to browse the Internet. Which of the following server types should the technician log in to in order to resolve the problem?
cards.why: Check DHCP scope/reservations/exclusions and static assignments for collisions. Each host needs a unique address on that subnet. Find which assignment is wrong, correct it, and keep manually assigned addresses out of the DHCP pool. Do not change a server's address without considering services that depend on it.

cards.question: Which listed peripheral is normally used to point, click and select items in a graphical desktop?
cards.why: A mouse provides pointing input. A webcam captures images, which is a different kind of input.

cards.question: A server's specification requires DDR4 ECC DIMMs. Which replacement choice is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: Any SODIMM that physically fits another laptop

options.label: B
options.text: Supported DDR4 ECC DIMMs with the required capacity and population rules

options.label: D
options.text: DDR5 modules because they are newer

cards.answer: B. Supported DDR4 ECC DIMMs with the required capacity and population rules
cards.why: DDR generation, module form factor and ECC capability must all match. ECC is not an alternative generation to DDR4.

cards.question: A user wants to print a large job on both the front and back sides of the paper. Which of the following settings should the technician advise the user to change in the printer settings?
cards.why: Duplex printing uses both sides of a sheet. Collating controls the order of copies, not which side receives printing.

cards.question: Which of the following is an APIPA address?
cards.why: 169.254.1.1 is IPv4 link-local; normally not routed off-link. APIPA means Automatic Private IP Addressing. It permits local-link communication without a DHCP lease. Routers do not forward it. Check the cable or Wi-Fi connection and DHCP service; it does not by itself prove the server is broken.

cards.question: A PC has a confirmed stale DNS-cache entry, while direct queries to the correct DNS server return the updated record. Which command clears the local cache?
cards.why: ipconfig /flushdns clears cached name-resolution entries. It does not repair every DNS server or routing problem.

cards.question: A virtualization host has CPU, storage and network headroom, but insufficient free memory for several planned guests. Which resource should be upgraded if supported?
cards.why: The identified constraint is RAM. Guest workloads and host overhead determine the required amount.

cards.question: A company offers several out-of-the-box computer configurations to its clients. A client requests several new computers for its newest location, which will be used by guests to check in upon arrival and fill out contact information. Which of the following configurations would BEST fit this customer's needs?
cards.why: Touchscreen can accept check-in input; protect kiosk appropriately. IoT means Internet of Things: network-connected physical devices such as sensors. A touchscreen can be a peripheral within a kiosk; the terms describe different aspects of the setup.

cards.question: An analyst asks a technician to recommend a solution for a customer in the software development industry, where the customer can test a variety of OS's running the various applications that the customer produces. The customer wants to minimize the investment in hardware. Which of the following solutions should the technician recommended to BEST meet the customer's requirement?

options.label: A
options.text: Purchase a number of low-cost devices, installing the require d Oss and applications on each one. Use separate machines for each testing environment.

options.label: B
options.text: Purchase a high-end system meeting the hardware requirements for all of the individual Oss and applications. Configure a VM for each testing environment.

options.label: C
options.text: Purchase one computer and create images for each computer con figuration and OS. Re-image the machine for each testing environment.

options.label: D
options.text: Purchase a number of computers, installing a VM on each one. Configure each VM with an OS for the testing environment.

cards.answer: B. Purchase a high-end system meeting the hardware requirements for all of the individual Oss and applications. Configure a VM for each testing environment.
cards.why: Multiple compatible guests can share one adequately sized host for testing. Check guest support, licensing, hardware dependencies and security. A VM does not automatically make an old OS secure or make software for a different CPU architecture run natively.
