cards.question: A new cable must support a gigabit link for an application targeting 600 Mbps. Available prices are Cat 3 at $2, Cat 5e at $4 and Cat 6 at $7. Which adequate option costs least?
cards.why: A compliant Cat 5e channel supports 1000BASE-T. The explicit prices make the cost comparison valid; Cat 5 is not inherently restricted to 100 Mbps.

cards.question: A printer prints simple text normally but reports insufficient printer memory on complex graphics jobs. Which listed resource may need a supported upgrade or workload reduction?

options.label: B
options.text: The print server is timing out

options.label: C
options.text: The users are not printing in post-script mode

options.label: D
options.text: The printer network connection is set to half duplex

cards.answer: A. The printer needs more RAM
cards.why: The device's memory error points to its page-processing capacity. Network speed does not supply printer RAM.

cards.question: Which service can resolve the hostname portion of a UNC path such as \\fileserver\share to an IP address?
cards.why: DNS resolves the server name; it does not resolve the full share path as one DNS name.

cards.question: A laser printer smears toner on approved heavy cardstock but prints plain paper normally. Its driver is still set to plain paper. What should be tried next?

options.label: A
options.text: Select the supported cardstock media profile

options.label: B
options.text: Set an arbitrary maximum fuser temperature

cards.answer: A. Select the supported cardstock media profile
cards.why: The media profile lets the printer choose supported feed and fusing conditions. Do not manually overheat the fuser.

cards.question: Three offices within one city each need an internal network and a metropolitan link between sites, all supporting at least 1 Gbps. Which two network categories describe those scopes? (Select TWO.)
cards.why: Each office uses a LAN. The city-wide interconnection is a MAN; these names describe scope rather than guaranteeing speed.

cards.question: A user wants to build a computer with a high-end CPU, plenty of RAM, and a high-end graphics card for online gaming. The user wants to verify that the graphics card is compatible with the motherboard. Which of the following connection types would the user MOST likely utilize to connect the video card to the motherboard?
cards.why: Modern discrete graphics typically uses PCIe; verify slot, power, dimensions and firmware. A physical x16 slot may be wired for fewer lanes. Bandwidth also depends on the PCIe generation and both devices' support. Check the motherboard's lane-sharing rules.

cards.question: Which connection carries data between a conventional internal SATA drive and its motherboard?
cards.why: The SATA data connector carries storage traffic; the separate power connector supplies electricity.

cards.question: A customer reports being unable to access email on desktop workstation, however, other office application are working. A technician determines the computer has an IP address of 169.254.1.10. The technician learns from the customer that the computer recently was moved across the room. Which of the following troubleshooting steps should technician take NEXT?
cards.why: The link-local address suggests the client did not receive a DHCP lease. Because the PC was moved, first check its Ethernet connection and patching.

cards.question: Which channel is commonly used for a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network in the United States?
cards.why: Channel 6 is a standard 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi channel. For 20 MHz channels, 1, 6 and 11 are commonly used to avoid overlap.

cards.question: A cloud-sync client saturates an office connection while uploading files. The user wants to limit this application's upload rate using its own controls. Which settings should be adjusted?
cards.why: Use the sync application's bandwidth limit or schedule. Router QoS is a separate network-wide control, not the app's own setting.

cards.question: A technician is setting up a new wireless network at a branch office that previously had only wired connectivity with statically assigned IP addresses. After setting up the network, the technician configures a server to provide IP addresses to wireless clients. During testing, the technician is unable to access the Internet or named network resources. The technician receives a valid IP address from the DHCP server and can ping the default gateway. Which of the following should be technician check NEXT to resolve this issue?

options.label: A
options.text: Ensure the options are configured to provide a DNS server.

options.label: B
options.text: Verify the Windows Firewall is turned off.

options.label: C
options.text: Configure the wireless network's SSID to be hidden.

options.label: D
options.text: Enable file and printer sharing in the OS.

cards.answer: A. Ensure the options are configured to provide a DNS server.
cards.why: DHCP must provide valid DNS resolver settings for name resolution. The client needs an address and network settings before it can communicate normally. DNS resolves names; DHCP supplies configuration. They perform different jobs even when one server runs both.

cards.question: Several clients on one wireless AP lose network access together, while wired clients remain normal. Which nearby shared component should be checked next?

options.label: A
options.text: Check the closest AP for the area.

cards.answer: A. Check the closest AP for the area.
cards.why: The common AP, its power, radio and uplink are a sensible next focus. Wired connectivity alone does not prove every DHCP or wireless path works.

cards.question: An administrator has configured a server to host virtualizes instances. The requirements of each VM must be able to scale automatically depending on peak and off-peak usage. Which of the following terms BEST describes this type of cloud concept?
cards.why: Rapid elasticity adjusts capacity with demand. Overprovisioning means allocating extra capacity and does not describe automatic scaling.

cards.question: Company management wants to be able to give users the ability to work remotely during periods of bad weather. Which of the following should be enabled to allow the workforce to do this?
cards.why: Authorized VPN gives remote access to private network resources over untrusted networks. An encrypted remote-access VPN can protect traffic between a user and the VPN endpoint. It does not automatically protect traffic after that endpoint or make an unsafe device trustworthy.

cards.question: Which listed device is designed to detect suspicious network traffic and actively block it inline?
cards.why: An Intrusion Prevention System can enforce blocking. An IDS primarily detects and alerts; neither catches every attack.

cards.question: Liquid spills on a laptop. Which two actions should precede a repair estimate? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: Safely stop use and disconnect power

options.label: B
options.text: Follow the model's service procedure to inspect damage and document findings

options.label: C
options.text: Keep charging it to see whether it improves

options.label: D
options.text: Use a hair dryer on high heat

cards.answer: A. Safely stop use and disconnect power; B. Follow the model's service procedure to inspect damage and document findings
cards.why: Power isolation reduces further damage. A supported inspection is needed before determining repairability or cost.

cards.question: A technician is determining the specifications for a desktop computer that will be used at trade shows all over the world. The computer will have the maximum amount of RAM. The CPU, GPU, and storage will be typical of a business workstation. Which of the following system parameters is the MOST important for the technician to consider when choosing a power supply?
cards.why: Verify AC input range and local plug/cable suitability; never assume universal voltage. AC is alternating current; DC is direct current. Efficiency is not the percentage of labeled wattage you may use. A 750 W PSU is not reduced to 600 W merely because it is 80% efficient. Check the unit's label rather than assuming every PSU needs a manual voltage switch.

cards.question: An end user has signed up to use a web-based calendar application. Which of the following solutions has the user purchased?
cards.why: Provider-hosted calendar application is SaaS. Users consume an application instead of maintaining its underlying server platform. They still manage their accounts, access choices and data responsibilities.

cards.question: Two office buildings are about 2,640 ft apart and need a 1 Gbps link. Which medium is best suited when paired with correctly rated transceivers?
cards.why: Suitable optical fiber and optics can span this distance. An ordinary 328 ft copper Ethernet channel cannot bridge it directly.

cards.question: Which listed device commonly supports configuring several VLANs?
cards.why: A managed switch can define VLANs. Isolation also depends on routing and access controls, so VLANs alone are not a complete security policy.

cards.question: A RAID 5 controller identifies physical disk 2 as failed. This system does not support hot-swap. After checking backups and the service procedure, which action fits?

options.label: A
options.text: Arrange shutdown, replace the identified disk with a compatible one, then rebuild and verify health

options.label: B
options.text: Pull the disk while the unsupported system is running

options.label: C
options.text: Delete the logical volume and erase the remaining drives

options.label: D
options.text: Convert to RAID 0 to restore redundancy

cards.answer: A. Arrange shutdown, replace the identified disk with a compatible one, then rebuild and verify health
cards.why: Replace the identified member using the supported procedure. Rebuilding restores protection; deleting the volume destroys the existing layout.

cards.question: A new GPU is correctly seated, but its documented power requirement exceeds the workstation PSU's available output. What must be corrected?
cards.why: The stated power requirement, not unspecified beep sounds, establishes the PSU mismatch. Verify connectors and total system demand too.

cards.question: A technician is troubleshooting a Windows CAD workstation that is running slow. The computer uses RAID 10 and has dual GPU cards. The user states that the same application runs faster on an identical workstation. Which of the following should the technician perform FIRST to troubleshoot the problem?

options.label: B
options.text: Check the event log any cache issues.

options.label: C
options.text: Clear the RAID configuration file and restart the PC.

options.label: D
options.text: Replace the RAID controller write cache module.

cards.answer: B. Check the event log any cache issues.
cards.why: Check controller/event health and cache status before hardware replacement or destructive array changes.

cards.question: A wearable and phone support Bluetooth sync but have never been paired. Both are powered and discoverable. Which action establishes their connection?

options.label: C
options.text: Update the smart wearable device firmware

cards.why: Pair the devices using their supported process. Changing a Wi-Fi SSID does not establish Bluetooth pairing.

cards.question: A PC's manual IPv4 address matches another host on the same subnet. What configuration error explains the duplicate-address warning?

options.label: B
options.text: A manually assigned address is already in use

cards.answer: B. A manually assigned address is already in use
cards.why: Addresses must be unique on the subnet. A static address is not inherently wrong; the duplicated value is the fault.

cards.question: One user cannot print a document, while other users can print it to the intended device. The user's app may target another queue. What should be checked before restarting shared services?

options.label: A
options.text: Stop and restart the PC print spooler service.

options.label: B
options.text: Verify the user is sending the document to the correct printe r queue.

options.label: C
options.text: Have each user send the same document to the correct printer queue.

options.label: D
options.text: Stop and restart the print server queues, and then have the u ser resend the document.

cards.answer: B. Verify the user is sending the document to the correct printe r queue.
cards.why: Verify the chosen printer and queue on the affected client. Avoid disrupting every user before confirming where this job was sent.

cards.question: A Windows touchscreen is unresponsive. Where can a technician inspect the touch device's driver and enabled/disabled status?
cards.why: Device Manager exposes the device and driver state. Calibration is not a substitute for checking a missing or disabled input device.

cards.question: Which legacy device repeats incoming Ethernet signals to its other ports rather than forwarding known unicast frames using a MAC table?
cards.why: A hub repeats signals. A switch learns MAC addresses and can forward known unicast traffic selectively.

cards.question: A battery-powered laptop shuts off when moved. Inspection finds an intermittent battery connector despite earlier reseating. Which issue explains the movement-related power loss?
cards.why: The connector can interrupt power when moved. Reseating a battery does not rule out a damaged socket or contact.

cards.question: Joe, a user, has purchased a new mobile device that uses a different OS than his previous one. Joe wants to copy his contacts and appointments from his corporate account without entering them manually. Which of the following would be the BEST way for a technician to assist Joe?

options.label: A
options.text: Log into the same email provider on the new device, and resto re the contacts and dates.

options.label: B
options.text: Create a Bluetooth connection between Joe's devices, and copy his contacts and calendar.

options.label: C
options.text: Back up the old mobile device to a PC, and import the contact s and schedule from the PC.

options.label: D
options.text: Use NFC to transfer all compatible data from one device to th e other.

cards.answer: A. Log into the same email provider on the new device, and resto re the contacts and dates.
cards.why: Sign in to authorized supported account and enable contacts/calendar synchronization. Large photos and files can consume bandwidth and storage. Check which account and folders are selected and whether cellular sync is allowed. Deletions may synchronize too, so sync alone is not a separate backup.

cards.question: A cable must pass through a building air-handling plenum where local rules require CMP-rated communications cable. Which rating should the technician select?
cards.why: Use plenum-rated cable for the stated requirement. A crawl space is not automatically a plenum merely because of its location.

cards.question: An older CCFL-backlit laptop has a faint image. Its lamp tests good, but the inverter supplies no required lamp voltage. Which component needs service?
cards.why: The inverter powers the fluorescent backlight in this older design. LED-backlit displays use different circuitry.

cards.question: An end user wants to have a second monitor installed on a laptop. Which of the following would allow a technician to configure the laptop to show both screens once the cable is connected?

options.label: A
options.text: Plug an external monitor into the USB port.

options.label: B
options.text: Use the Fn and function key combination

cards.answer: C. Adjust the monitor display settings.
cards.why: Choose extend/duplicate using OS display controls; verify compatible connection. The comparison helps isolate the problem but does not prove one component. Follow the service manual and power-down procedure before inspecting a display cable. Persistent physical panel damage generally requires replacement.

cards.question: A PC has valid settings for its office subnet. It can reach a local peer, but the configured gateway and remote numeric IP addresses fail to respond. What path should be investigated first?

options.label: A
options.text: There is a problem with a router in the office

options.label: B
options.text: There is a problem with a DNS server in the office

options.label: C
options.text: The users are not getting correct IP addresses from the DHCP server

options.label: D
options.text: The wireless access point in the area is down

cards.answer: A. There is a problem with a router in the office
cards.why: The router/gateway path deserves investigation. DNS cannot explain failure to reach numeric IP addresses; also consider permitted ICMP filtering.

cards.question: A user tries to add files to an already finalized write-once optical disc. Why does the new write fail?

options.label: A
options.text: The disk has already been finalized

options.label: C
options.text: There is a corrupt file on the hard drive

options.label: D
options.text: The files are not compatible with the type of disk used

cards.answer: A. The disk has already been finalized
cards.why: Finalization closed the disc to further recording in this scenario. Use suitable writable media and a supported recording format.

cards.question: A company laptop cannot reach a printer on an isolated guest Wi-Fi network. Policy permits the printer on the corporate network. Which change restores the intended reachability?

options.label: A
options.text: Set up the user's computer to act as a print server.

options.label: B
options.text: Configure the printer to use the Internet printing protocol.

options.label: C
options.text: Ensure the user's computer is set to DHCP.

options.label: D
options.text: Connect the printer to the company wireless network.

cards.answer: D. Connect the printer to the company wireless network.
cards.why: Move the printer to the authorized reachable network. Installing software does not bypass guest-network isolation.

cards.question: Which of the following peripherals would a company use to take inventory quickly and update price tags for products? (Choose two.)
cards.answer: A. Barcode scanner; B. Label printer
cards.why: A barcode scanner reads inventory codes, while a label printer creates replacement price labels. A magnetic-stripe reader does not print tags.

cards.question: An engineer is working at a remote site that does not have Internet access. Which of the following features should the engineer use to connect a laptop to the Internet if hotspot functionality is unavailable?
cards.why: USB or Bluetooth tethering can share supported cellular data without Wi-Fi hotspot. A hotspot commonly shares cellular service over Wi-Fi; tethering is the broader sharing idea. A compatible cellular modem is another option. Carrier plans, coverage and data allowances still apply.

cards.question: Which of the following BEST describes the purpose of an IPv4 subnet mask?

options.label: A
options.text: It defines where network and host bits exist

options.label: B
options.text: It is used to find the default gateway on a LAN

options.label: C
options.text: It gives users the ability to send and receive data.

options.label: D
options.text: It allows the ability, when needed, to bridge subnets.

cards.answer: A. It defines where network and host bits exist
cards.why: IPv4 mask distinguishes network prefix bits from host bits. The mask helps a host decide whether a destination is local or needs a router. /32 has valid uses elsewhere; it is a mismatch in this stated LAN scenario.

cards.question: Company management wants to give users the ability to work from home during periods of bad weather. Which of the following would enable the workforce to do this?
cards.why: Authorized VPN gives remote access to private network resources over untrusted networks. An encrypted remote-access VPN can protect traffic between a user and the VPN endpoint. It does not automatically protect traffic after that endpoint or make an unsafe device trustworthy.

cards.question: A cloud-sync client has adequate CPU, RAM and local storage speed, but uploads saturate its internet connection. Which resource is limiting this transfer?
cards.why: Available network I/O bandwidth limits the upload in this stated case. No one resource dominates every sync workload.

cards.question: During laptop LCD replacement, the service manual warns that the plastic frame around the display has fragile clips. What is that frame called?
cards.why: The bezel is the frame around the panel. Follow the manual to avoid breaking clips or nearby cables.

cards.question: Which dedicated device primarily enforces allow/deny policy on traffic crossing a network boundary?
cards.why: A firewall is designed for traffic-policy enforcement. Managed switches can also implement some controls, but that is not the dedicated role asked here.

cards.question: A user wants a second monitor installed on a laptop. The VGA/DVI or HDMI cables have already been connected. Which of the following should the technician do to configure the laptop to show both screens?

options.label: B
options.text: Plug in the monitor to the USB port.

cards.answer: C. Adjust the monitor display settings.
cards.why: Choose extend/duplicate using OS display controls; verify compatible connection. The comparison helps isolate the problem but does not prove one component. Follow the service manual and power-down procedure before inspecting a display cable. Persistent physical panel damage generally requires replacement.

cards.question: A copper Ethernet run suffers confirmed EMI. Properly grounded shielded Cat 6 is compatible with the installation and costs less than a fiber conversion. Which listed choice meets the stated budget and interference goal?
cards.why: Shielding can reduce electrical interference when installed correctly. A plenum rating concerns fire and smoke, not EMI protection.

cards.question: Laser toner rubs off approved paper despite correct media settings. Diagnostics confirm the fusing unit has failed. Which part should be replaced?
cards.why: The fuser bonds toner using heat and pressure. The additional diagnostics distinguish it from media-setting problems.

cards.question: A laptop supports both SATA SSDs and PCIe/NVMe M.2 SSDs. The listed NVMe model has higher tested throughput for the workload. Which choice provides that faster storage?
cards.why: Choose the supported NVMe SSD for the stated performance comparison. M.2 shape alone does not guarantee its protocol or speed.

cards.question: A user creates a support ticket to report a conference room projector that does not work. The user says that even though the provided cables are being used, the projector screen shows the following error message: No signal input Which of the following describes the FIRST action that should be taken?

options.label: A
options.text: Verify that the projector is turned on.

options.label: B
options.text: Verify that the user is using an approved OS.

options.label: D
options.text: Check the video cable and replace it if necessary.

cards.answer: D. Check the video cable and replace it if necessary.
cards.why: Verify correct input, cable and output mode for no-signal condition. The display can have power while receiving no usable signal. Test with a known-good cable or source to narrow the fault. A no-signal message alone does not prove a failed GPU.

cards.question: Which of the following would be BEST reason to use a virtual machine as a sandbox?

options.label: A
options.text: To test new software in a safe environment

options.label: B
options.text: To increase the efficient use of computing resources

options.label: C
options.text: To run multiple machines on the same hardware

options.label: D
options.text: To have dedicated hardware for a single system

cards.answer: A. To test new software in a safe environment
cards.why: Limit shared folders, clipboard, device access and network connectivity for risky testing. A VM escape is a breach from guest to host. Do not assume running malware in any VM makes it harmless.

cards.question: A technician is inspecting a projector that is displaying fuzzy images. Which of the following actions would provide the BEST solution?
cards.why: Focus lens and confirm supported resolution/placement for soft image. A dirty lens or excessive digital keystone correction can reduce clarity. Keystone distortion is a trapezoid-shaped image caused by projection geometry; it is different from simple blur.

cards.question: Which of the following network types would be used in a server room to connect virtual servers lo high- speed storage?
cards.why: Storage area network provides storage connectivity, commonly block-level. A LAN serves a local site. A PAN links a person's nearby devices. A MAN spans a metropolitan area. A SAN provides networked storage access, commonly block storage; it is not merely a large office LAN.

cards.question: A technician installs a new printer for a workstation and tries to print a test page, but the page does not print. The technician looks at the print queue and notices that the printer is called 'Generic Printer." Which of the following BEST describes what the technician should do to fix this issue?

options.label: A
options.text: Connect the printer with a USB cable rather than over the net work.

options.label: B
options.text: Install the appropriate printer drivers for the OS.

options.label: C
options.text: Install the correct toner in the printer.

options.label: D
options.text: Set the printer trays to allow duplex printing

cards.answer: B. Install the appropriate printer drivers for the OS.
cards.why: A driver translates print jobs into a format the printer understands. PCL means Printer Command Language. Different operating systems may need different supported drivers or driverless printing support.

cards.question: A mobile payment device cannot detect a nearby contactless payment card. Which function should the technician check?
cards.why: Near-field communication (NFC) exchanges data over a very short distance for contactless payments. Check that the required NFC function is enabled and supported.

cards.question: Planned workstation upgrades need 800 W of rated PSU output including headroom, plus appropriate GPU connectors. Which listed device can satisfy that PSU requirement?
cards.why: A suitable 1000 W PSU exceeds the stated requirement. A surge protector or UPS is not a replacement internal PSU; confirm connectors and fit.

cards.question: A phone's navigation app loses live maps when cellular service disappears, but its GPS receiver still reports coordinates. Which explanation is correct?

options.label: B
options.text: The app lost its map-data connection, not necessarily GPS reception

options.label: C
options.text: GPS signals require an active cellular subscription

options.label: D
options.text: A Bluetooth headset supplies GPS satellite signals

cards.answer: B. The app lost its map-data connection, not necessarily GPS reception
cards.why: GPS reception and downloading maps are separate functions. Offline maps may allow navigation without cellular data.

cards.question: Recently, an organization received a number of spam emails that passed through the spam gateway. The emails contained generally the same information, but the sending domains were different. Which of the following solutions would BEST help mitigate the issue?
cards.why: Content/keyword filtering can detect repeated spam across varying sender domains; review false positives.

cards.question: After a router replacement, office PCs have 169.254.x.x addresses and no internet access. The new router is intended to assign addresses, but its address-leasing service is disabled. Which service should be enabled?
cards.why: Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) leases addresses and supplies network settings. A 169.254 address is link-local and is not routed to the internet.

cards.question: Which of the following commonly uses NFC?
cards.why: NFC supports compatible contactless payment. Devices are normally brought within a small fraction of an inch to around an inch for a tap. NFC may exchange a small payload or start a Bluetooth connection; it is not the best choice for sustained large-file transfers.

cards.question: Which three conditions can increase a phone's temperature? (Select THREE.)

options.label: A
options.text: Using the device as a Wi-Fi hotspot

options.label: D
options.text: Less than 15% free storage space on the phone

options.label: F
options.text: Recurring prompts to install OS updates

options.label: G
options.text: Granting too many application camera permissions

cards.answer: A. Using the device as a Wi-Fi hotspot; C. A failing battery; H. Too many open applications
cards.why: Hotspot activity and demanding running apps increase workload; a failing battery can also produce abnormal heat. Heat alone does not identify which cause applies.

cards.question: Which listed laptop port can use a Thunderbolt 3 cable for supported high-speed data and display functions?
cards.why: Thunderbolt 3 uses USB-C, but a plain USB-C port need not support Thunderbolt. Support depends on the device, not its brand.

cards.question: A technician needs to copy traffic from a wired link to a packet analyzer. Which listed tool supplies that traffic copy?
cards.why: A network TAP provides traffic to monitoring equipment. The analyzer interprets it; a TAP is not a spectrum analyzer.

cards.question: A printer strikes pins through an ink ribbon onto multipart forms. What type is it?
cards.why: An impact printer mechanically strikes the ribbon. Some thermal-transfer printers also use ribbons, but do not use this impact mechanism.

cards.question: A Wi-Fi mesh network has been optimized to eliminate poor coverage areas, yet users still experience decreased bandwidth and connectivity issues. Which of the following actions should the technician take NEXT?

options.label: A
options.text: Relocate any large, dense, solid, and metal objects, such as mirrors and file cabinets, in the mesh network coverage area to the perimeter so that wireless reflections, absorptions, and occlusions are minimized.

options.label: B
options.text: Use a Wi-Fi analyzer to determine whether the channel in use is overcrowded and to identify which channel the mesh network should use for best performance.

options.label: C
options.text: Use the signal strength indicator on a mobile device to roam the coverage area and generate a heat map to isolate zones with weak signals.

options.label: D
options.text: Turn off broadcasting of the SSID on the mesh network so that other networks cannot see it.

cards.answer: B. Use a Wi-Fi analyzer to determine whether the channel in use is overcrowded and to identify which channel the mesh network should use for best performance.
cards.why: Analyze channel congestion/interference after coverage checks. A Wi-Fi analyzer helps inspect nearby networks and channels. Walls and mounting position affect coverage. Use a site survey; a stronger signal alone does not rule out a congested channel or bad uplink.

cards.question: A motherboard manual says to install two matching DIMMs in specified paired slots to activate two memory channels. Which configuration is this?
cards.why: Dual-channel describes the memory-controller configuration. Slot color alone is not a universal population rule.

cards.question: A phone's calendar stopped syncing after the corporate password changed. Its calendar app reports an authentication error. Which action addresses that evidence?

options.label: A
options.text: Checking that the ringer volume on the device is high enough to be audible

options.label: B
options.text: Ensuring the corporate password is saved correctly in the cal endar application

options.label: C
options.text: Installing a third-party calendar application and synchronizi ng it with the corporate calendar

options.label: D
options.text: Remotely wiping the mobile device and reinstalling all applications

cards.answer: B. Ensuring the corporate password is saved correctly in the cal endar application
cards.why: Update or reauthorize the account using the supported login process. Ringer volume does not fix missing synchronized events.

cards.question: Which of the following cables replaced the Apple 30-pin connector and is also reversible?
cards.why: Lightning is reversible and succeeded Apple's 30-pin connector; newer devices may use USB-C. Charging alone does not prove a working data connection. Some older Apple devices use Lightning; newer models may use USB-C. Choose the connector and data support for the actual model.

cards.question: A user visits the desk to report that a smartphone takes more than a day to fully charge. The user has already tested multiple wall outlets and swapped the charging cable, but the results are the same. Which of the following should the technician do FIRST?

options.label: A
options.text: Verify the power rating of the charger.

options.label: B
options.text: Ensure all unnecessary connectivity features are disabled.

options.label: C
options.text: Check that all missing smartphone OS updates are applied.

options.label: D
options.text: Complete a factory reset of the phone

cards.answer: A. Verify the power rating of the charger.
cards.why: Check compatible charger output/power-delivery support and cable before resets. W means watts, a power unit. A low-power charger or power bank may charge slowly or fail under load. USB Power Delivery negotiates supported power; the cable also needs the correct rating.

cards.question: An administrator must allow SMTP server-to-server mail transfer through a firewall. Which TCP port is standard?
cards.why: Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) uses TCP port 25 for server-to-server mail transfer. Client submission commonly uses a different port.

cards.question: Company policy allows only the assigned user to sign in to each laptop. How should fingerprint enrollment follow that policy?

options.label: A
options.text: Grant all registered employees access to each machine.

options.label: B
options.text: Restrict device access to only the user to whom the laptop is assigned.

options.label: C
options.text: Limit device access to departments and guest users.

options.label: D
options.text: Give each team member a USB drive that bypasses the reader to allow guest users lo log in.

cards.answer: B. Restrict device access to only the user to whom the laptop is assigned.
cards.why: Enroll only authorized users for the device and maintain approved fallback credentials. A fingerprint reader alone does not establish the entire access policy.

cards.question: A workstation shuts down during a load test. Monitoring confirms the CPU reaches its thermal shutdown threshold. Which cause fits?
cards.why: The temperature reading establishes overheating. Inspect cooling rather than inferring the cause solely from a shutdown.

cards.question: A company wants cloud infrastructure reserved exclusively for that one organization. Which deployment model fits?
cards.why: Private cloud describes exclusive use. The operating contract determines who manages it and where it is hosted.

cards.question: Which listed 802.11 standard supports operation in either 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz?
cards.why: 802.11n can use either band. The original option '802.11c' did not supply the intended answer.

cards.question: A Windows touch device is present and enabled, but touch input is mapped to the wrong display. Which supported settings should be checked?
cards.why: Tablet/PC touch setup can associate supported touch input with the intended display. An absent driver would need a different check.

cards.question: Which dedicated security device is designed to permit or block traffic according to network policy?
cards.why: A firewall enforces traffic rules. It is not a repeater or simply a connectivity gateway.

cards.question: A laser printer produces ghost images. Its model-specific guide recommends an approved cleaning procedure for accessible imaging components before replacement. Which listed action follows that guide?

options.label: D
options.text: Clean the toner drums and rollers

cards.answer: D. Clean the toner drums and rollers
cards.why: Follow the approved cleaning procedure. Ghosting can have multiple causes, so this recommendation is based on the model's diagnostic guide.

cards.question: A projector's input is correctly selected and its cable works, but the source may be sending an unsupported video mode. What should be tested next?
cards.why: Verify a supported output resolution and timing. A valid cable signal is not necessarily a mode the projector accepts.

cards.question: An Android tablet supports USB-C host mode and Bluetooth keyboards. Which two connection types can attach a compatible external keyboard? (Select TWO.)
cards.why: Supported USB-C host mode accepts a wired keyboard; Bluetooth permits wireless pairing. Connector shape and platform support still matter.

cards.question: Several DHCP-configured laptops have IPv4 link-local addresses and no normal routed connectivity. Their wireless links are up. Which service/path should be checked?
cards.why: Check whether DHCP requests reach an authorized server and replies return. The address is a clue, not proof that the server itself is broken.

cards.question: A laptop configured for DHCP reports IPv4 169.254.254.1 with mask 255.255.0.0 and no default gateway. Which condition best explains its limited connectivity?
cards.why: It has a link-local address rather than a usable normal lease. Investigate DHCP reachability and the underlying link.

cards.question: An IP phone requires standard PoE. Its Ethernet switch has no PoE, and no separate phone power adapter is available. Which compatible addition can supply power?

options.label: A
options.text: Upgrade the Ethernet cable to the latest specification.

cards.why: A correctly rated PoE injector adds power to the supported Ethernet link. Match the phone's standard and power budget.

cards.question: A user submits a help desk ticket regarding a smartphone that will no longer accept its charging cable. The assigned technician notices the phone does not have a protective case, and the user constantly transport the phone in a pocket. The technician attempts to use a secondary charger, but the cable falls out of the phone. Which of the following is the MOST likely cause of the issue?

options.label: A
options.text: The phone requires a firmware update to address charging issu es.

options.label: B
options.text: The charge port contains foreign objects, such as lint.

options.label: C
options.text: The phone's battery has swelled, preventing the utilization o f the charge port.

options.label: D
options.text: The phone has experienced water damage, thus the battery is n ot charring.

cards.answer: B. The charge port contains foreign objects, such as lint.
cards.why: Lint or damaged connector can prevent seating; inspect and clean using safe vendor procedure. Test a compatible known-good cable and charger. Follow approved cleaning instructions; do not force metal objects into the port. A damaged port may need service, but the symptom alone does not identify the failed part.

cards.question: A technician is replacing a computer with a connected point-of-sale system using a 9-pin serial adapter. The new computer does not have a 9-pin serial port. Which of the following ports can an adapter be installed on in order to connect to the point-of-sale system?
cards.why: Compatible USB-to-serial adapter can provide legacy DE-9 serial connection with correct driver/pinout.

cards.question: A four-drive workstation needs striping across mirrored pairs for storage performance and redundancy. Which RAID level fits?
cards.why: RAID 10 matches that arrangement and uses about half the raw capacity. RAID 5 has a different parity-based layout.

cards.question: A job expected to print on both sides prints only on the front, using twice as many sheets. Which setting should be enabled?
cards.why: Duplex printing uses both sides. Collation changes copy order rather than enabling the reverse side.

cards.question: Paper is stuck around an abnormally hot laser-printer fuser. What should the technician do next?

options.label: A
options.text: Take the printer out of service, disconnect power as directed, and let it cool before safe inspection

options.label: B
options.text: Reach into the hot fuser immediately

options.label: C
options.text: Pull paper out while the mechanism is running

options.label: D
options.text: Use thicker paper to force the jam through

cards.answer: A. Take the printer out of service, disconnect power as directed, and let it cool before safe inspection
cards.why: The fuser can cause burns. Cool the unit and follow the manufacturer's repair procedure before clearing it.

cards.question: A known-good protected video source and HDMI cable work on another display. A projector reports an HDCP incompatibility error. Which cause best fits?

options.label: A
options.text: The HDMI cannot carry the signal from the DVD to the projecto r.

options.label: B
options.text: The user needs to switch from HDMI to a cable standard such a s DisplayPort.

options.label: C
options.text: The projector does not support the necessary HDCP protocol.

options.label: D
options.text: The user needs to enable cony-protected sources in the projec tor's settings.

cards.answer: C. The projector does not support the necessary HDCP protocol.
cards.why: The projector may not support the required High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection version. The protected playback chain must be compatible.

cards.question: A technician is tasked with upgrading a laptop's RAM. Which of the following steps should the technician lake FIRST?

options.label: A
options.text: Confirm that both the current and new memory are from the sam e brand.

options.label: B
options.text: Run a diagnostic test on the current memory.

options.label: C
options.text: Verify the memory requirements of the motherboard.

cards.answer: C. Verify the memory requirements of the motherboard.
cards.why: Verify supported generation, form factor, capacity and population; use ESD precautions during installation.

cards.question: Which method creates an encrypted tunnel from a remote laptop into a corporate network?
cards.why: A virtual private network (VPN) creates a protected connection into the private network over an untrusted network.

cards.question: A sluggish PC cannot finish updates. Storage inspection shows its system volume has virtually no free space. Which listed finding explains the storage constraint?

options.label: A
options.text: The hard disk drivers have been corrupted

options.label: D
options.text: The HDD has no free space.

cards.answer: D. The HDD has no free space.
cards.why: A full volume lacks working space for updates and temporary files. Check drive health too; disk activity alone would not prove this diagnosis.

cards.question: A company needs rented cloud VMs and storage but will manage guest operating systems and applications itself. Which model best fits?
cards.why: IaaS supplies infrastructure without requiring the customer to own the underlying hardware. Guest software administration remains with the customer.

cards.question: A required application supports only an older Windows version. A licensed, isolated guest is supported and organizational policy permits it. Which option lets a newer host run that application?

options.label: A
options.text: Do not upgrade any workstations within the organization.

options.label: B
options.text: Upgrade all workstations and provide a virtual environment fo r the legacy software.

options.label: C
options.text: Upgrade all workstations except those used by the engineering department.

options.label: D
options.text: Purchase new workstations for the engineering department.

cards.answer: B. Upgrade all workstations and provide a virtual environment fo r the legacy software.
cards.why: A compatible VM provides the required guest OS. It does not make unsupported software automatically secure.

cards.question: A weather app's frequent background location checks are draining a phone battery. The user still wants periodic location-aware forecasts. Which change reduces unnecessary work?

options.label: C
options.text: Reduce the app's background location-check frequency

cards.answer: C. Reduce the app's background location-check frequency
cards.why: Less frequent polling reduces unnecessary activity. The effect depends on the app and device, not a blanket claim about cellular versus GPS positioning.

cards.question: A laser printer has vertical streaks. Inspection using its defect guide confirms damage on the imaging drum. Which component is responsible?
cards.why: The observed drum damage establishes the cause. Streaks alone are not unique to the drum on every printer.

cards.question: An organization must prevent users from booting a shared PC from removable media. Which configuration directly addresses that requirement?

options.label: A
options.text: Enable a TPM without changing boot settings

options.label: B
options.text: Disable unauthorized external boot paths and protect firmware settings

options.label: C
options.text: Assume any signed Linux loader is blocked by Secure Boot

cards.answer: B. Disable unauthorized external boot paths and protect firmware settings
cards.why: Restrict boot paths and protect their configuration. Secure Boot checks trusted signatures and can allow signed Linux loaders.

cards.question: Which of the following are default ports for HTTP and HTTPS traffic? (Select TWO).
cards.why: Default HTTP 80 and HTTPS 443; explicitly distinguish conventional TCP use from HTTP/3 over QUIC. HTTP means Hypertext Transfer Protocol. TLS means Transport Layer Security. HTTPS protects the connection; it does not prove that a site's claims are honest. HTTP/3 uses QUIC over UDP, commonly on 443.

cards.question: Which of the following network services allows a networked device to always be assigned the same IP address based on the device's MAC address?
cards.why: A DHCP reservation uses a client identifier, commonly the MAC address, to supply a consistent lease address.

cards.question: A projector shows “No source found.” Known-good cables and the correct projector input have been checked. The laptop has not enabled its external display. What should the user do next?

options.label: B
options.text: Set the laptop display to Extend or Duplicate.

cards.answer: B. Set the laptop display to Extend or Duplicate.
cards.why: Extend and Duplicate enable output to an external display. A working input and cable cannot show a signal that the laptop is not sending.

cards.question: A startup company is outgrowing its current office space and is requiring employees to work remotely. The company must comply with government-enforced requirements to safeguard all aspects of data, so the IT department plans to maintain complete control over users' operating systems. Which of the following should the IT department implement?
cards.why: VDI hosts managed desktops centrally for remote clients; security still needs policy and access controls.

cards.question: A virtual environment supplies guest RAM from shared host resources. Which listed concept describes sharing that underlying capacity?
cards.why: Resource pooling makes physical capacity available to multiple consumers. The hypervisor performs the actual memory allocation.

cards.question: A user calls the help desk lot assistance configuring an Android phone with a new NFC- enabled speaker that will be used for an upcoming conference call. The user was unable to direct the phone's audio to the NFC speaker. Which of the following sequences should the help desk technician walk the customer through to accomplish this task?

options.label: A
options.text: Enable NFC on the speaker. Ensure the speaker is less than 33 ft (10m) from the Android phone. On the phone's Bluetooth settings menu for Connected Devices, select Pair New Device. Tap to accept the connection to the speaker when the prompt is displayed on the phone's screen.

options.label: B
options.text: Enable NFC and Bluetooth on the Android phone. From the Andro id phone's Bluetooth settings menu for Connected Devices, select the Previously Connected Devices option.Select a listed device that most closely matches the speaker. Tap lo accept the connection lo the speaker when the prompt is displayed on the phone's screen.

options.label: C
options.text: Enable NFC and Bluetooth on the Android phone. Tap and hold the Android phone to the spot on the speaker where the NFC logo is displayed. Accept the connection to the speaker when the prompt is displayed on the phone's screen.

options.label: D
options.text: Enable Wi-Fi on the speaker. Enable Wi-Fi on the Android phon e. Tap and hold the Android phone to the spot on the speaker where the NFC logo is displayed. Accept the connection to the speaker when the prompt is displayed on the phone's screen.

cards.answer: C. Enable NFC and Bluetooth on the Android phone. Tap and hold the Android phone to the spot on the speaker where the NFC logo is displayed. Accept the connection to the speaker when the prompt is displayed on the phone's screen.
cards.why: NFC tap can initiate Bluetooth pairing; Bluetooth then carries audio. Devices are normally brought within a small fraction of an inch to around an inch for a tap. NFC may exchange a small payload or start a Bluetooth connection; it is not the best choice for sustained large-file transfers.

cards.question: Which of the following is the PRIMARY security concern with virtual machine escape?

options.label: D
options.text: Rogue virtual machines installed on the hypervisor

cards.why: Escape breaches guest isolation toward host/hypervisor; patch and harden both layers. Limit shared folders, clipboard, device access and network connectivity for risky testing. A VM escape is a breach from guest to host. Do not assume running malware in any VM makes it harmless.

cards.question: In which of the following places is a laptop's wireless antenna MOST likely located?

options.label: D
options.text: In the bezel of the lid

cards.answer: D. In the bezel of the lid
cards.why: Laptop antennas often run around display bezel; route replacements per service manual. Use the model's service manual and power-down procedure. A disconnected antenna can reduce signal greatly while the adapter still appears in the operating system.

cards.question: A PC is near its PSU limit. Two planned changes add a high-power GPU and an internal optical drive. Which listed changes increase its power requirement? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: Replacing the HDD with an SSD

cards.answer: C. Adding an optical drive; F. Upgrading the graphics card
cards.why: The GPU and added drive increase load in this scenario. Other component changes can also affect power, so calculate the complete configuration.

cards.question: A company wants provider-managed email and document applications that users consume without administering the underlying servers. Which model fits?
cards.why: SaaS delivers complete applications. Renting bare VMs instead would be IaaS.

cards.question: A powered direct-thermal receipt printer feeds blank paper after a roll change. Which first check fits?

options.label: A
options.text: Verify the correct type of paper is loaded.

options.label: C
options.text: Check to see if the default printer has been changed.

options.label: D
options.text: Ensure the printer is connected to power.

cards.answer: A. Verify the correct type of paper is loaded.
cards.why: Verify heat-sensitive media and its orientation. Direct-thermal printing does not use ink cartridges.

cards.question: An entry-level server has hot-swappable drives, but its manual requires power removal for RAM service. What should be done before replacing RAM?

options.label: A
options.text: Replace the RAM while the server is at a cool temperature

options.label: B
options.text: Replace the RAM while the server is running

options.label: C
options.text: Power down the server completely and then replace the RAM

options.label: D
options.text: Verify that the OS supports hot swapping the RAM

cards.answer: C. Power down the server completely and then replace the RAM
cards.why: Hot-swap support for drives does not extend automatically to memory. Follow the explicit RAM power-down procedure.

cards.question: A home user has purchased a subscription for a service that blocks malicious sites by preventing them from resolving correctly. Which of the following settings MOST likely needs to be changed on the user's router to enable this functionally?
cards.why: Filtering resolver can block lookup of flagged domains; not complete traffic protection. A proxy may enforce access rules, cache content or inspect supported traffic. DNS filtering acts at name lookup and is not the same as inspecting every packet or website page.

cards.question: After a motherboard replacement, an encrypted drive requests recovery because the original TPM is gone. What should the authorized technician use?

options.label: A
options.text: An approved recovery key and the platform's recovery procedure

options.label: B
options.text: A RAID rebuild unrelated to the encryption

options.label: C
options.text: A new TPM that automatically recreates the old secret

options.label: D
options.text: Formatting the drive to preserve its data

cards.answer: A. An approved recovery key and the platform's recovery procedure
cards.why: A replacement TPM does not reproduce the original protected keys. Recovery requires the appropriate saved recovery material.

cards.question: What is the maximum power supplied at the source port by standard 802.3at PoE+?
cards.why: The source limit is 30 W. The powered device receives up to about 25.5 W after allowed cable losses.

cards.question: A technician is preparing to set up a gaming computer with the following components: 1. Discrete, high-end graphics card 2. Video capture card 3. High-end processor 4. Multiple hard drives 5. USB 3.0 hub 6. Sound card Which of the following options is the MOST important for the technician to consider before building the gaming computer?
cards.why: Match wattage, connectors and actual sustained/transient load. AC is alternating current; DC is direct current. Efficiency is not the percentage of labeled wattage you may use. A 750 W PSU is not reduced to 600 W merely because it is 80% efficient. Check the unit's label rather than assuming every PSU needs a manual voltage switch.

cards.question: An older desktop randomly powers off. With all power safely disconnected, which listed inspection can reveal visibly damaged motherboard power components?

options.label: B
options.text: Verify all case fans are operational.

options.label: C
options.text: Check that the BIOS version supports the installed CPU.

options.label: D
options.text: Compare the software requirements with the installed RAM.

cards.answer: A. Visually inspect the motherboard capacitors.
cards.why: Bulging or leaking capacitors indicate damage. Do not open the PSU enclosure or touch hazardous stored-energy components.

cards.question: A VGA-connected monitor has a pink tint. Another known-good cable restores normal colors. Which cause fits?
cards.why: An analog cable or pin fault can lose a color channel. The successful cable substitution identifies the path.

cards.question: A technician is troubleshooting a computer that is not completing POST and gets stuck at the manufacturer logo screen. All internal, removable parts have been disconnected and only the minimum parts necessary to POST were reconnected. However, the symptoms remain the same. Which of the following should the technician try NEXT?

options.label: A
options.text: Test the RAM in different slots, one at a time.

options.label: B
options.text: Remove and test the power supply.

cards.answer: A. Test the RAM in different slots, one at a time.
cards.why: Use supported minimal RAM configuration and isolate module/slot per manual. Crashes and freezes have many causes. A reproducible test failure is stronger evidence than a symptom alone. Disconnect power and use electrostatic-discharge precautions before touching modules.

cards.question: A laptop needs a vendor-supported dock providing charging, wired networking, audio and two displays. Which listed accessory explicitly matches this requirement?
cards.why: A compatible docking station can combine these features. Verify host, cable and display support rather than relying on the port's shape.

cards.question: A short, correctly installed copper channel is certified for 10GBASE-T. Which is the lowest category among these choices that can support it over limited distances?
cards.why: Cat 6 can support 10-gigabit service over shorter qualified runs, often up to about 180 ft. Cat 6A supports a full 328 ft channel.

cards.question: An older CCFL-backlit laptop shows a faint image under a flashlight. Tests confirm the lamp is good but its inverter has failed. Which issue fits?
cards.why: The inverter powers the older fluorescent backlight. A faint image alone would not distinguish the lamp from its power circuitry.

cards.question: A customer called the help desk to request information about how to increase the volume on a laptop using only a keyboard. Which of the following keys would MOST likely allow this to be done?
cards.why: Many laptops use Fn plus marked media key; layout and Fn-lock vary. A layout mismatch can change symbols without hardware damage. For sticky or failed keys, use the manufacturer's cleaning and service procedure. Do not spray liquid directly into the keyboard.

cards.question: Which listed DNS-based policy identifies hosts authorized to send mail using a domain in SMTP envelope identities?
cards.why: Sender Policy Framework publishes authorized sending hosts. It does not by itself authenticate the visible From header or encrypt mail.

cards.question: Which of the following allows a switch to be divided into separate logical networks?
cards.why: Logical network segmentation on managed switches. One physical switch can contain several VLANs. A trunk can carry multiple VLANs. Routing and access rules determine whether devices in separate VLANs can reach each other.

cards.question: A server has redundant PSUs but does not support live RAM replacement. What is the safe preparation for replacing RAM?

options.label: C
options.text: Shut down, disconnect every power source and follow ESD/service precautions

options.label: D
options.text: Replace RAM while the server runs

cards.answer: C. Shut down, disconnect every power source and follow ESD/service precautions
cards.why: Redundant supplies mean more than one power feed must be isolated. An ESD strap alone does not make powered memory service safe.

cards.question: Which feature can use storage to support virtual memory without adding physical RAM?
cards.why: Paging extends virtual-memory backing using storage. It does not increase installed RAM and may be much slower.

cards.question: A company wants to give third-party developers access to the corporate network through desktop environments that the company can control. Which of the following can BEST achieve these requirements?
cards.why: VDI hosts managed desktops centrally for remote clients; security still needs policy and access controls.

cards.question: A PC will receive an M.2 PCIe/NVMe SSD. Which two listed capabilities must its intended slot support? (Select TWO.)
cards.why: The slot must accept the M.2 card and support its PCIe/NVMe interface. NVMe also exists in other physical formats, so M.2 is not universal to every NVMe drive.

cards.question: A user is unable to plug a USB 3.0 device into a USB port. Upon inspection, a technician notices the USB 3.0 port appears to be shallower than the other USB ports, preventing a solid connection. Which of the following is the most likely cause?

options.label: A
options.text: A foreign object Is stuck Inside the port

options.label: B
options.text: The cable connection utilized the wrong orientation.

options.label: C
options.text: The USB cable is physically damaged.

options.label: D
options.text: The USB port belongs to a different form factor.

cards.answer: A. A foreign object Is stuck Inside the port
cards.why: Inspect obstruction or damage; never force connector or use conductive tools on powered port. Test a compatible known-good cable and charger. Follow approved cleaning instructions; do not force metal objects into the port. A damaged port may need service, but the symptom alone does not identify the failed part.

cards.question: A user's touch-screen tablet is having an issue with the screen orientation. Which of the following is MOST likely causing this issue?

options.label: B
options.text: The screen protector on the tablet is damaged

cards.answer: A. The screen rotation is locked
cards.why: Orientation lock can prevent automatic rotation; check setting before hardware replacement. Some apps lock their orientation. If supported apps still fail with rotation unlocked, test the sensor and device software. One screen staying upright is not enough to diagnose failed hardware.

cards.question: A critical server supports two power supplies, each capable of carrying its workload. Which arrangement lets it continue after one PSU fails?
cards.why: Proper PSU redundancy tolerates one supply failure. It does not prevent every outage or replace broader availability planning.

cards.question: A VM host's specification requires memory that provides supported system-level error correction. Which feature should its compatible DIMMs include?
cards.why: ECC provides error detection and correction supported by the platform. DDR4 identifies a generation and can coexist with ECC.

cards.question: A technician must seat telephone conductors in a compatible 110-style block at the demarcation point. Which tool fits?
cards.why: A punchdown tool seats conductors in insulation-displacement contacts. Use the correct blade and connector procedure.

cards.question: A network technician has been tasked with creating a patch cable. The RJ45 connectors will not slay attached to the cable. Which of the following tools Is needed to fix this Issue?
cards.why: Crimper secures compatible modular plug contacts and strain relief. A patch panel organizes cable terminations; it does not switch traffic. Match the tool to the connector design. Some jacks are tool-less, and fiber needs its own connector-specific procedure.

cards.question: A technician set up a new access point and has noticed significant latency on the selected channel. Which of the following tools can assist with locating the BEST channel to use?
cards.why: Measure channel use and signal conditions. A Wi-Fi analyzer helps inspect nearby networks and channels. Walls and mounting position affect coverage. Use a site survey; a stronger signal alone does not rule out a congested channel or bad uplink.

cards.question: New RAM is not detected after an upgrade. What should the administrator check before assuming a special BIOS setting will fix it?

options.label: A
options.text: Supported module type/capacity, seating, slot population and firmware requirements

options.label: C
options.text: An obsolete boot.ini edit on every machine

cards.answer: A. Supported module type/capacity, seating, slot population and firmware requirements
cards.why: Memory detection depends on compatibility and proper installation. There is no universal firmware toggle for all missing RAM.

cards.question: Which two statements correctly compare common 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Wi-Fi deployments? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: 5 GHz is always immune to interference

options.label: B
options.text: At comparable conditions, 2.4 GHz often penetrates obstacles better

options.label: C
options.text: Band frequency alone determines every connection's throughput

options.label: E
options.text: 5 GHz commonly offers more usable channel capacity, while lower-frequency 2.4 GHz often reaches farther

options.label: F
options.text: Every 2.4 GHz device can use 5 GHz after changing its SSID

cards.answer: B. At comparable conditions, 2.4 GHz often penetrates obstacles better; E. 5 GHz commonly offers more usable channel capacity, while lower-frequency 2.4 GHz often reaches farther
cards.why: Propagation, channel availability and supported channel width affect the tradeoff. Actual throughput also depends on the standard, interference and client capability.

cards.question: An insurance company wants to implement cloud computing and would like a cloud solution in which the infrastructure is shared with businesses in the same industry. Which of the following cloud models BEST addresses the company's need?
cards.why: Cloud reserved for organizations with shared requirements or concerns. A private cloud connected with a public cloud can form a hybrid design. Community members might share mission or compliance needs. These are deployment models, not the IaaS/PaaS/SaaS service models.

cards.question: A soundbar expects TV audio through HDMI ARC. Both devices support ARC, but the cable is plugged into a non-ARC TV port. Why does the soundbar receive no return audio?

options.label: A
options.text: The volume on the TV needs to be turned up

options.label: B
options.text: The conference call needs to be unmuted for audio.

options.label: C
options.text: An incorrect HDMI cable is being used.

options.label: D
options.text: The TV's HDMI-ARC port is not being used.

cards.answer: D. The TV's HDMI-ARC port is not being used.
cards.why: Audio Return Channel requires the compatible labeled ports and settings. Ordinary HDMI input alone may not send TV audio back to the bar.

cards.question: A laptop supports 1 TB SATA and PCIe/NVMe SSDs. The NVMe option has the highest tested storage throughput for the intended workload. Which listed upgrade fits that goal?
cards.why: Choose the compatible 1 TB NVMe SSD. An SSD is not a spinning HDD, and actual workload performance must be checked.

cards.question: A new desktop supports all listed valid interfaces. For this workload, the chosen PCIe/NVMe SSD outperforms the SATA options. Which device matches that specification?
cards.why: The supported NVMe SSD uses PCIe for storage traffic. M.2 is its physical form factor, not a speed guarantee by itself.

cards.question: Copies have vertical lines, while direct print jobs are clean. Inspection finds a scratch on the scanner glass at the same position. Which component explains the defect?
cards.why: The copy-only defect and matching scratch identify the scanning path. Toner or fuser faults would normally also affect direct prints.

cards.question: A desktop has HDMI video output and a monitor has a compatible digital DVI input. Which listed cable can carry the digital video between them?
cards.why: A compatible HDMI-to-DVI cable carries digital video. It does not convert arbitrary analog signals or guarantee audio.

cards.question: During a WAN outage, which deployment could still serve local users if its on-site hosts, LAN and dependencies remain available?

options.label: A
options.text: An on-premises private cloud reachable entirely through the LAN

options.label: B
options.text: An external SaaS service requiring that WAN path

options.label: C
options.text: A remote community cloud requiring that WAN path

options.label: D
options.text: A remote public cloud requiring that WAN path

cards.answer: A. An on-premises private cloud reachable entirely through the LAN
cards.why: The reachable local hosting path matters. A private cloud hosted off-site could also become unreachable during the outage.

cards.question: To control costs a company provides a limited number or users with company phones One of these users opens a support ticket because the phone no longer allows internet Drowsing over a cellular connection The user acknowledges that the phone worked before the user's child streamed several movies using the device Which of the following describes why the phone cannot browse the Internet?

options.label: A
options.text: The child accidentally connected to a neighbor's WLAN

options.label: B
options.text: The company's group policy disabled the device

options.label: C
options.text: The device has a data cap and has reached that limit

options.label: D
options.text: The device's plan has been unpaid

cards.answer: C. The device has a data cap and has reached that limit
cards.why: Plan limit can block or throttle cellular data; verify usage and carrier policy. A metered setting can limit some background downloads. It does not change the carrier's billing rules or guarantee that every application stops transferring data.

cards.question: A laptop's encryption design requires a trusted component to protect keys and support PIN-gated release. Which component fits?
cards.why: A TPM protects cryptographic operations and keys. Describing it simply as a storage box for the user's login PIN would be misleading.

cards.question: The owner of a restaurant reports that wireless network connections are lost intermittently throughout the day. Which of the following steps should a technician take to troubleshoot the issue? (Select TWO).

options.label: A
options.text: Identify the location of devices that utilize 2.4GHz.

options.label: B
options.text: Check to see if the phones are IJTP or STP lines.

options.label: C
options.text: Test to see if the copper electrical Wires are causing interf erence.

options.label: D
options.text: Map all of the wireless signals in the restaurant.

options.label: E
options.text: Verify T568B is being used in the wiring closet patch panel.

options.label: F
options.text: Schedule timed router reboots throughout the day.

cards.answer: A. Identify the location of devices that utilize 2.4GHz.; D. Map all of the wireless signals in the restaurant.
cards.why: Map signals and inspect interfering 2.4 GHz devices. Nearby Wi-Fi and devices such as microwave ovens can interfere. Measure local conditions and use 20 MHz channels where appropriate. These channel numbers are not the plan for 5 or 6 GHz.

cards.question: Which of the following connectors can be plugged into a Thunderbolt 3 port on a laptop?
cards.why: Thunderbolt 3 uses USB-C connector; USB-C shape does not guarantee Thunderbolt support. Connector shape alone does not promise Thunderbolt, display output or full charging power. Thunderbolt 4 also uses USB-C with a 40 Gbps baseline; check actual port and cable capabilities.

cards.question: A laptop touchpad stops working after its marked enable/disable shortcut is pressed. Which action restores it?
cards.why: Use the supported function-key shortcut to re-enable the touchpad. Driver reinstallation is unnecessary when the setting is the cause.

cards.question: Which network device distributes application traffic among several servers according to a configured policy?
cards.why: A load balancer distributes requests among available servers. Its policy may consider server health, capacity or existing connections.

cards.question: A VM hosts a web app that listens on its LAN interface and permits client traffic. The guest must appear directly on the physical LAN. Which virtual-network mode fits?
cards.why: Bridged networking connects the guest to the external LAN. Application binding, addressing and firewall rules must also be correct.

cards.question: A company phone works over Wi-Fi but has no activated SIM or eSIM subscription. Which issue explains its lack of cellular data?

options.label: A
options.text: MDM was never properly set up on the device.

options.label: B
options.text: S/MIME certificates were corrupted and needed to be reloaded.

options.label: C
options.text: Bluetooth on the device was disabled by mistake.

options.label: D
options.text: The device never had a proper SIM card installed.

cards.answer: D. The device never had a proper SIM card installed.
cards.why: The device needs properly provisioned cellular service. Working Wi-Fi alone would not prove whether a SIM is missing or coverage is poor.

cards.question: A technician is on site troubleshooting a customer's laptop. The technician needs to download a software update but the company's proxy is blocking updates. Which of the following would be the MOST appropriate action for the technician to take to get the update?
cards.why: Proxy mediates traffic; request authorized exception instead of bypassing policy. A proxy may enforce access rules, cache content or inspect supported traffic. DNS filtering acts at name lookup and is not the same as inspecting every packet or website page.

cards.question: Which of the following devices performs forwarding decisions based on MAC addresses?
cards.why: Switch learns MAC-to-port entries for forwarding. A switch learns source MAC addresses. It floods broadcasts and unknown unicast traffic within the applicable VLAN, except the arrival port. This differs from a hub, which repeats incoming signals to its other ports.

cards.question: Which of the following cable types should be used to connect a cable modem to a SOHO router?
cards.why: Typical separate cable modem connects to router WAN Ethernet port; coax is access-provider side. A home gateway may combine a router, modem, switch and access point in one box. Combined hardware does not make those functions identical.

cards.question: A technician needs to call a user's cellular provider to troubleshoot a network speed issue with the user's mobile device. Which of the following technologies is the technician troubleshooting?
cards.why: LTE means Long-Term Evolution, a cellular radio technology family. A SIM or eSIM supplies subscription identity information. It is not the phone's general photo-storage card. A compatible modem, active plan and supported network are also required.

cards.question: An office Wi-Fi network uses obsolete protection and may have unauthorized users. Which listed change most directly improves its wireless security?
cards.why: Use a supported modern mode such as WPA3 or required WPA2-AES compatibility, with strong credentials. MAC filtering is spoofable and does not replace authentication and encryption.

cards.question: A laptop uses extended display mode with a projector. The projector reports an unsupported input resolution, and the image appears distorted. Which setting should the technician check?
cards.why: Set the external display to a resolution and refresh rate supported by the projector. The laptop and projector can use different settings in extended mode.

cards.question: A phone hotspot slows after its plan's high-speed allowance is exhausted. The carrier confirms a reduced-speed policy. Which condition explains the change?

options.label: B
options.text: There is a low RFID signal.

cards.why: The service is throttled under the stated plan. Signal and congestion can also affect speed, but the carrier evidence identifies this case.

cards.question: Several VMs share RAM supplied from one host's physical capacity. Which listed concept describes that shared resource base?
cards.why: Resource pooling makes host resources available across guests. The hypervisor manages allocations and contention.

cards.question: Which of the following charging and data ports has a non-directional connector?
cards.why: USB-C connector is reversible. USB 2.0 is up to 480 Mbps; USB 3.2 modes include 5, 10 and 20 Gbps. Mbps and Gbps mean millions and billions of bits per second. The slowest supported link capability limits operation.

cards.question: A tablet restarts and charges poorly despite a known-good adapter and cable. Diagnostics identify a failed battery. Which component should receive approved service?
cards.why: The diagnostic result identifies the battery. Charging symptoms alone would not rule out port or board faults.

cards.question: After a RAM upgrade, a PC reports 'The amount of system memory has changed.' What is the correct interpretation?

options.label: C
options.text: Verify the detected memory against the intended configuration; the message alone does not prove failure

cards.answer: C. Verify the detected memory against the intended configuration; the message alone does not prove failure
cards.why: A memory-change warning can be expected after an upgrade. Check capacity, seating and compatibility if the reported amount is wrong.

cards.question: A customer brings a phone top a repair shop because it is experiencing extreme slowness and applications are crashing. A technician attempts to install a diagnostic application. but the installation fails. Which of the following should the technician do FIRST to troubleshoot the issue?
cards.why: Low free storage can prevent app installation and degrade operation; inspect storage first. Review storage usage and safely remove or move unnecessary data. Confirm backups before deleting personal files. Extra RAM does not increase the phone's file-storage capacity.

cards.question: A help desk technician receives a ticket stating a printer has jammed several times today. The technician removes the jammed paper and notices the paper supply is low and the paper in the tray is wrinkled. Which of the following MOST likely caused the paper jams?
cards.why: Damaged/wrinkled media and misfeeds can jam printer; load supported fresh paper and guides correctly.

cards.question: A desktop's approved encryption deployment explicitly requires TPM-backed key protection. Which component must be enabled and configured?
cards.why: The TPM is required for this specified deployment. Other encryption designs can work without a TPM.

cards.question: Which of the following frequency bands do 802.11b and 802.11g operate in?
cards.why: 802.11b and g use 2.4 GHz. A dual-band router may offer 2.4 GHz using another standard alongside ac. GHz means gigahertz, a frequency unit; it is not the same as a data rate in Gbps.

cards.question: A bank wants to leverage cloud computing but would like a cloud solution in which infrastructure is isolated from other businesses. Which of the following cloud models would BEST address the bank's need?
cards.why: Private cloud serves one organization exclusively; isolation depends on implementation. Private describes exclusive use, not necessarily location or ownership. A private cloud can be run off-site by a third party. Public cloud does not mean every customer's stored files are public.

cards.question: Which of the following is an unsecure remote access protocol?
cards.why: Telnet provides unencrypted remote terminal service. SSH means Secure Shell. IMAP means Internet Message Access Protocol; POP3 means Post Office Protocol version 3. Telnet sends ordinary session data without encryption; choose a supported secure alternative.

cards.question: A hot laptop no longer sits flat. Inspection shows a swollen battery deforming the lower case. Which diagnosis fits?

options.label: A
options.text: The docking station is improperly installed.

options.label: C
options.text: The CPU fan is too powerful.

cards.why: The battery is damaged. Stop using and charging the device and follow the manufacturer's safe service process.

cards.question: Which of the following components houses the MX record?
cards.why: MX is DNS mail-exchanger record naming destination mail servers. DNS means Domain Name System. It stores several kinds of records, not just website addresses. An MX record names a mail server; it does not directly contain the destination's IP address.

cards.question: A four-drive RAID 10 array has two mirrored pairs. Which statement correctly describes its drive-failure tolerance?
