options.label: A
options.text: It tolerates every possible two-drive failure

options.label: C
options.text: It survives only if no drive ever fails

options.label: D
options.text: It can survive one failed drive in each pair, but not both drives in the same pair

cards.answer: D. It can survive one failed drive in each pair, but not both drives in the same pair
cards.why: Redundancy is per mirror pair. RAID 10 does not guarantee survival of any arbitrary two failed members.

cards.question: A PC is close to its PSU's output limit. The next upgrades add an optical drive and a substantially higher-power GPU. Which two listed changes add that demand? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: Replacing the HDD with an SSD

cards.answer: C. Adding an optical drive; F. Upgrading the graphics card
cards.why: The added drive and higher-power graphics card increase load. Calculate total requirements; other upgrades can affect power too.

cards.question: An end user needs to upgrade the hard drive on a laptop and wants one that is fast and shock resistant. Which of the following is the BEST option for this end user?
cards.why: SSDs lack moving mechanical parts and resist operational shock better; verify compatible NVMe support.

cards.question: Some laser print jobs request 8.5 by 14 inch Legal paper and are clipped when sent to one tray. What should the technician verify next?

options.label: A
options.text: Verify that the printing trays are correctly set.

options.label: B
options.text: Swap printer trays until the print jobs complete as expected.

options.label: C
options.text: Replace the tray rollers to ensure proper alignment.

options.label: D
options.text: Reset the default to use 8.5in x 11in (216mm x 279mm) paper

cards.answer: A. Verify that the printing trays are correctly set.
cards.why: Match the job's requested size, the actual paper and the tray configuration. Legal and 8.5 by 11 inch Letter are different sizes.

cards.question: A technician is troubleshooting a laptop that is unable to browse the internet when connected to the company's wireless network. The technician has verified network connectivity is functional when using an Ethernet cable. Which of the following should the technician use to check if the laptop's wireless NIC is functional?
cards.why: Testing against an authorized known-good hotspot helps distinguish laptop radio from original network issue.

cards.question: Which statement correctly describes an OLED display compared with a conventional backlit LCD?

options.label: A
options.text: It can never age or burn in

options.label: B
options.text: Its pixels emit their own light and can turn off for deep blacks

options.label: C
options.text: It always uses less power regardless of content

options.label: D
options.text: It requires a separate fluorescent backlight

cards.answer: B. Its pixels emit their own light and can turn off for deep blacks
cards.why: OLED is self-emissive. Its power use depends on image content and brightness, so a blanket lower-power claim is incorrect.

cards.question: A laser printer still streaks after correct media and supplies are verified. The manufacturer's tests identify damaged fusing hardware. Which listed component should be checked?
cards.why: The specific diagnostic finding identifies the fuser. Replacing toner alone would not prove this cause.

cards.question: A user wants RAID to be configured on a desktop to allow the fastest speed and maximum storage capacity. Which of the following RAID types should a technician configure to accommodate this request?
cards.why: Striping uses combined capacity without redundancy; losing a member loses the array. RAID means Redundant Array of Independent Disks, although RAID 0 has no redundancy. If one member fails, the striped volume can be lost. RAID 0 is not a backup.

cards.question: A laptop's mechanical storage device clicks repeatedly, and drive diagnostics confirm failure. After protecting recoverable data, which component should be replaced?
cards.why: The failed storage device explains the mechanical noise and access problems. Preserve important data before routine replacement.

cards.question: A RAID 5 server boots in degraded mode after one member fails. After identifying the member and checking backups, what recovery action is needed?

options.label: B
options.text: Replace the failed member as directed and rebuild the array

cards.answer: B. Replace the failed member as directed and rebuild the array
cards.why: A rebuild restores redundancy onto a supported replacement. Rebooting alone does not repair a failed member.

cards.question: A streaming device cannot sign in through a hotel's captive portal. The user's phone has a permitted cellular hotspot plan with sufficient data. Which option can give the streaming device internet access?

options.label: A
options.text: Connecting to the hotspot on the user's device

options.label: B
options.text: Disabling the Wi-Fi security on the device

options.label: C
options.text: Asking the hotel to disable the captive portal on the Wi-Fi

options.label: D
options.text: Adjusting the date and time stamps on the device to reflect another country

cards.answer: A. Connecting to the hotspot on the user's device
cards.why: A phone hotspot shares its cellular data connection over Wi-Fi. It provides an alternative connection when the streaming device cannot use the hotel's web sign-in page.

cards.question: Which of the following wireless technologies is used by mobile devices to process payments at kiosks?
cards.why: Contactless payment uses NFC on supported devices. Devices are normally brought within a small fraction of an inch to around an inch for a tap. NFC may exchange a small payload or start a Bluetooth connection; it is not the best choice for sustained large-file transfers.

cards.question: Auser is unable to perform contactless payments with a phone. Which of the following functions is MOST likely causing the issue?
cards.why: Contactless payment uses NFC on supported devices. Devices are normally brought within a small fraction of an inch to around an inch for a tap. NFC may exchange a small payload or start a Bluetooth connection; it is not the best choice for sustained large-file transfers.

cards.question: A projector shuts down after 15 minutes with an overheating warning. Its filter is visibly clogged. After shutdown and cooling, which action fits?
cards.why: Clean the filter using the manual's procedure to restore airflow. A timed shutdown without these clues could have other causes.

cards.question: A technician is installing a USB Wi-Fi card. Which of the following would be the MOST appropriate way for the technician to receive the latest official drivers for the device?

options.label: A
options.text: Download the drivers from the vendor's website.

options.label: B
options.text: Allow the OS to install the drivers automatically.

cards.answer: A. Download the drivers from the vendor's website.
cards.why: Obtain model/OS-compatible drivers from manufacturer or trusted OS update service. A driver lets the OS communicate with hardware. Use the manufacturer or approved update source. A targeted rollback or supported update may help; replacing hardware without testing the software cause is premature.

cards.question: A technician is setting up three web servers foe a retail company that takes online orders for its products. Which of the following network host services should the technician use to ensure the servers' resources will be utilized efficiently?
cards.why: Balance requests across healthy backend web servers. This can improve capacity and availability. Health checks help avoid failed servers. A load balancer does not automatically add servers; scaling must be configured separately.

cards.question: A user submitted a help desk ticket to report that the Wi-Fi connection drops every time the microwave is used. A technician suspects the issue is related to interference. Which of the following should the technician do to provide the BEST long-term solution for the issue?

options.label: C
options.text: Increase the power output of the AP.

cards.answer: B. Configure the Wi-Fi AP to 5GHz.
cards.why: Move compatible clients to 5 GHz to avoid 2.4 GHz microwave interference; check coverage. Nearby Wi-Fi and devices such as microwave ovens can interfere. Measure local conditions and use 20 MHz channels where appropriate. These channel numbers are not the plan for 5 or 6 GHz.

cards.question: A printer pauses every job with a message that the requested paper type differs from the tray's configured type. Which setting is implicated?

options.label: A
options.text: The wrong network printer queue is being used.

options.label: B
options.text: The network printer is on the wrong VLAN.

options.label: C
options.text: A The default paper type has been changed.

options.label: D
options.text: The print server has outdated print drivers.

cards.answer: C. A The default paper type has been changed.
cards.why: The media mismatch causes the confirmation prompt. Align the job, tray and actual paper rather than replacing network hardware.

cards.question: A help desk technician plugged in a user's new computer to a network port After a few minutes the computer showed an APIPA address. Which of the following is the MOST likely reason this happened?

options.label: A
options.text: The WLAN is disabling the NIC card.

options.label: B
options.text: The network cable is not attached.

options.label: C
options.text: The PC is unable to contact a DHCP serve r

options.label: D
options.text: The DHCP server is using addresses in the range of 169.254.25 4.1.

cards.answer: C. The PC is unable to contact a DHCP serve r
cards.why: APIPA usually indicates unavailable DHCP on automatic IPv4 configuration. APIPA means Automatic Private IP Addressing. It permits local-link communication without a DHCP lease. Routers do not forward it. Check the cable or Wi-Fi connection and DHCP service; it does not by itself prove the server is broken.

cards.question: A PC slows under load. Its CPU temperature is excessive, and diagnostics show its CPU fan intermittently stops. Which component is failing?
cards.why: The measured fan fault supports the diagnosis. Normal automatic fan-speed changes alone do not mean failure.

cards.question: A network printer needs a manually assigned IPv4 configuration that reaches local and remote subnets. Which three IP settings are needed? (Select THREE.)
cards.answer: C. Gateway; D. Subnet mask; G. IP address
cards.why: Set a unique IP address, the correct subnet mask and the actual default gateway. Local-only printing may not need a gateway.

cards.question: A laptop's network settings show: IPv4 address 172.25.1.39; mask 255.255.255.0; DNS server 172.25.1.4; Router 172.25.1.252. Which is the default gateway?
cards.why: The field labeled Router identifies the gateway. The other entries serve different configuration roles.

cards.question: After an outage, an intranet's numeric IP is reachable and a direct service check succeeds, but its hostname lookup fails. Which service should be investigated?
cards.why: The name-resolution failure points to DNS. A ping reply alone would not prove the web application was working.

cards.question: Several VMs use a shared block-storage datastore that is full. The administrator will expand that networked storage system. Which network type is involved?
cards.why: A Storage Area Network provides storage access, commonly block-level. It is the datastore capacity that is full, not the network itself.

cards.question: Which internal connections should be inspected for motherboard power problems on a conventional ATX desktop?

options.label: D
options.text: The main ATX power and required CPU power connectors

cards.answer: D. The main ATX power and required CPU power connectors
cards.why: Both main board power and CPU auxiliary power may be required. A generic peripheral Molex connector is not a precise answer for these connections.

cards.question: A customer reports that, after a technician replaced a laptop screen, the laptop is only able to connect to a Wi-Fi network it is positioned very close to a wireless access point Which of the following should the technician verify FIRST?

options.label: B
options.text: The device has the latest OS updates.

options.label: C
options.text: The wireless device drivers are the latest version.

cards.answer: A. The internal antennas are connected.
cards.why: Screen service may disturb antenna leads routed around lid. Use the model's service manual and power-down procedure. A disconnected antenna can reduce signal greatly while the adapter still appears in the operating system.

cards.question: A laptop's service manual specifies replaceable DDR4 SODIMMs. Which listed form factor should the technician buy?
cards.why: SODIMM is a compact module used in many laptops. Some laptops have soldered RAM or different formats, so follow the actual model's specification.

cards.question: An ATX workstation's planned components require 1000 W of PSU output including headroom. The case and GPU connectors fit the listed 1200 W unit. Which replacement fits?
cards.why: The compatible 1200 W internal PSU meets the stated load. A UPS is external backup power, not the internal supply.

cards.question: At the wiring closet, a technician terminates the solid conductors from office wall runs before using short patch cords to connect the switch. Which component organizes these terminations?
cards.why: A patch panel terminates and organizes the structured cabling. The wall jack is normally at the opposite end of the run.

cards.question: A network engineer recently deployed a new application server in a cloud environment. Which of the following should be implemented to prevent a single point of failure within the system?
cards.why: Redundant instances/dependencies and failover reduce single points of failure; cloud location alone is not HA.

cards.question: A bank wants to leverage cloud computing but would like a cloud solution in which infrastructure is shared with businesses in the same industry. Which of the following cloud models would BEST address the bank's need?
cards.why: Shared industry requirements can fit community cloud. A private cloud connected with a public cloud can form a hybrid design. Community members might share mission or compliance needs. These are deployment models, not the IaaS/PaaS/SaaS service models.

cards.question: A technician is working with a user to set up scanning. The user requires the scans to be viewable on the network for the entire department. Which of the following settings on the MFP should the technician edit to BEST address the user's request?
cards.why: Scan-to-SMB writes to authorized network file share; configure credentials/permissions securely. SMB provides network file sharing. A scanner also needs a valid share path, supported SMB version, credentials and write permission. SMTP ports do not replace the SMB file-sharing port.

cards.question: A SOHO customer would like to purchase network hardware to enhance security. The hardware should perform stateful packet Inspection Which of the following would BEST address the customer's need?
cards.why: Stateful firewall tracks connection state when applying traffic policy. Rules decide which traffic may pass. If one service fails, inspect the relevant rule and logs. Disabling the whole firewall is not a permanent repair and can hide the actual misconfiguration.

cards.question: A technician is attempting to connect the wired LANs at two nearby buildings by installing a wireless point- to-point connection. Which of the following should the technician consider?
cards.answer: D. Allowable limits for transmit power
cards.why: Outdoor links must meet local band/channel/transmit-power rules and antenna limits. Do not change the country setting to bypass restrictions. Some 5 GHz channels require radar detection and channel changes. Local approval determines which 6 GHz features are allowed.

cards.question: A monitor, keyboard, mouse and headset all fail through one USB-C hub but work through a known-good compatible hub. Power and the host connection are verified. What should be replaced?

options.label: D
options.text: Reinstall the drivers for affected devices.

options.label: E
options.text: Make sure the printer is not drawing too much power.

cards.answer: C. Replace the user's USB-C hub.
cards.why: The controlled substitution identifies the original hub as the common failed path.

cards.question: Which of the following video cables can carry an audio signal?
cards.why: HDMI carries compatible digital video and audio. HDMI means High-Definition Multimedia Interface and can carry audio and video. The OS may still send sound to another output. A supported USB audio device is another sound interface, not a video-cable repair.

cards.question: A user who is facilitating a videoconference reports that the participants can be heard. However, when the user attempts to speak, none of the participants can hear the user. Which of the following is the FIRST step the technician should take?
cards.why: Verify selected microphone, mute, permissions and input level before replacing hardware. Hearing audio through the headset only proves the output path. The microphone is a separate input path. Check both the OS and meeting app's selection.

cards.question: A shared printer needs a predictable IP address while continuing to use DHCP. Which listed device is a common candidate for a reservation?
cards.why: A printer often needs a stable address for client queues. Reservations can also serve other devices; they are not exclusive to printers.

cards.question: Which listed device normally bridges wireless clients onto a wired LAN?
cards.why: A wireless access point bridges those network segments. A media converter primarily changes transmission medium.

cards.question: Which of the following BEST describes a lab environment in which virtual machines can be created, rebooted, and shut down without affecting the production network?
cards.why: Limit shared folders, clipboard, device access and network connectivity for risky testing. A VM escape is a breach from guest to host. Do not assume running malware in any VM makes it harmless.

cards.question: A new PC shuts down under load. Inspection confirms poor heatsink contact and missing thermal-interface material, and the CPU reaches its thermal limit. Which issue fits?

options.label: A
options.text: The video card was Installed in the wrong PCIe slot.

options.label: B
options.text: The CPU heat sink was attached without adequate thermal paste .

options.label: C
options.text: The SSD drives do not have enough Pagefile.

options.label: D
options.text: The system does not have enough RAM tor 4K video.

cards.answer: B. The CPU heat sink was attached without adequate thermal paste .
cards.why: The measured heat and installation fault support inadequate CPU cooling. Shutdowns alone would not prove this cause.

cards.question: A technician needs a physical device that copies network traffic to a separate analyzer. Which tool should be used?
cards.why: A network test access point (TAP) supplies a copy of traffic for analysis. A toner locates cables; it does not capture packets.

cards.question: All copies have a line, but direct prints are clean. Inspection reveals a matching scratch on the scan glass. Which issue fits?

options.label: B
options.text: A scratch on the scanning bed

cards.answer: B. A scratch on the scanning bed
cards.why: The defect belongs to the scanner path. Dirt can also cause lines, so inspect and clean as directed before replacing damaged glass.

cards.question: A user's Windows computer started running slowly after the installation of a CAD program. The computer has intermittent timeouts and often has to be rebooted to restore functionally. The computer seems to work correctly if the application is not running. Which of the following should the technician do NEXT to help troubleshoot the issue? (Select TWO).

options.label: B
options.text: Research the requirements of the application.

cards.answer: B. Research the requirements of the application.; E. Check the Event Viewer logs.
cards.why: Check vendor hardware requirements and diagnostic logs for workload-triggered faults. VRAM is Video Random Access Memory used by graphics hardware. More of one resource helps only when it addresses the workload. A CPU family label, clock speed or GPU memory size alone cannot rank whole systems reliably.

cards.question: A field technician for an airport receives a support ticket that states customers are having issues viewing a screen that displays information about departing flights. While checking the case history, the technician sees that all flight information screens were recently moved when the terminal gates were remodeled. Which of the following actions should the technician perform after verifying the screen has power?

options.label: A
options.text: Ensure the input connections to the screen are secure.

options.label: B
options.text: Swap cables with a screen that works.

options.label: C
options.text: Check to see if the device outputting the data is turned on.

options.label: D
options.text: Determine if the screen is compatible with the output device.

cards.answer: A. Ensure the input connections to the screen are secure.
cards.why: After relocation verify power, input source, signal cables and source output. The display can have power while receiving no usable signal. Test with a known-good cable or source to narrow the fault. A no-signal message alone does not prove a failed GPU.

cards.question: Under default settings, which virtual-network mode links guests with the host while providing no ordinary external-network access?
cards.why: Host-only mode fits this description. Additional guest adapters or custom host routing can defeat the intended isolation.

cards.question: A laptop has USB-C data ports but no RS-232 serial port. What is needed for a compatible serial signature pad?

options.label: B
options.text: Wi-Fi Direct without a serial interface

options.label: D
options.text: A supported active USB-to-RS-232 adapter with the correct driver and pinout

cards.answer: D. A supported active USB-to-RS-232 adapter with the correct driver and pinout
cards.why: The adapter converts the interface. A plain USB-C cable cannot convert RS-232 signaling by itself.

cards.question: A legacy accounting application must run inside a compatible older guest operating system. Which listed virtualization approach can provide that desktop environment?
cards.why: Desktop virtualization can supply the required guest. Confirm licensing, hardware dependencies and security controls.

cards.question: A user indicates that a laptop is not performing well. A technician determines the laptop has a conventional HDD and that installing a SSD will improve the laptop's performance. Which of the following lists of steps describes what the technician should do to complete the upgrade with the LEAST amount of downtime?

options.label: A
options.text: 1. Remove the HDD and install the SSD in the laptop. 2. Install the operating system and necessary applications on the SSD. 3. Connect the HDD to the laptop using a USB enclosure. 4. Copy over all of the user's data.

options.label: B
options.text: 1. Leave the HDD in place. 2. Install the SSD in an empty drive bay. 3. Leave all data intact on the HDD. 4. Confirm the SSD is accessible in the operating system.

options.label: C
options.text: 1. Connect the SSD to the laptop using a USB enclosure. 2. Clone the HDD to the SSD using cloning software. 3. Remove the HDD. 4. Install the SSD.

options.label: D
options.text: 1. Remove the HDD and install the SSD in the laptop. 2. Install the operating system and necessary applications on the SSD. 3. Install the HDD in a USB enclosure. 4. Provide the external HDD for the user to access the old data.

cards.answer: C. 1. Connect the SSD to the laptop using a USB enclosure. 2. Clone the HDD to the SSD using cloning software. 3. Remove the HDD. 4. Install the SSD.
cards.why: Backup, clone with compatible tool, replace drive and verify boot/data; preserve original until validated.

cards.question: A printer's own test page is normal, but PC jobs contain gibberish. The installed driver uses an unsupported print language. Which action addresses it?
cards.answer: C. Install the correct supported driver
cards.why: The driver must produce a language the printer understands. A working internal page helps isolate the PC-to-printer rendering path.

cards.question: A desktop has no power. Its outlet and cord work, and supported PSU diagnostics report no proper output. Which component is implicated?
cards.why: The diagnostic failure identifies the PSU. A working outlet alone would not rule out a motherboard or switch problem.

cards.question: A technician must trace an unlabeled copper network cable to its matching end in a wiring closet. Which tool is designed for this task?
cards.why: A tone generator and probe help trace a cable. Use a model and procedure appropriate for the cable and whether the circuit is active.

cards.question: A phone app has only approximate location permission, but the task requires supported precise positioning. Which setting should be checked first?
cards.answer: A. The app's supported precise-location/accuracy permissions
cards.why: Use the operating system's actual location controls. Visibility of satellite signals and the surrounding environment also affect accuracy.

cards.question: An IT technician is working on a help desk ticket concerning a user's inability to create a virtual machine. The technician has already checked the RAM and HDD space in the user's machine. Which of the following settings should the technician check NEXT to help troubleshoot the issue?
cards.why: Check supported CPU virtualization enabled in UEFI/BIOS; VT-x/AMD-V differs from multithreading. The exact label varies. Intel VT-d concerns directed I/O and is not the same switch as VT-x. Confirm the CPU and hypervisor requirements before changing settings.

cards.question: A business purchased a new multifunction printer that will be used to photocopy documents with hundreds of pages. A technician is configuring the printer. Which of the following features should the technician ensure is set up?
cards.why: ADF handles multi-page originals; verify capacity and duplex scanning support. It handles input pages. It is not the same as a printer's output duplexer. Check whether the particular ADF supports scanning both sides.

cards.question: A traveler needs internet away from Wi-Fi where a cellular provider has coverage. Which supported laptop accessory, paired with an active service plan, provides it?
cards.why: A cellular modem/card provides mobile data. GPS supplies positioning, and a Wi-Fi extender cannot create missing upstream internet.

cards.question: A department sends in a ticket to report a printer is not working. The responding technician sees paper stuck to the fuser, which is much hotter than normal. The (user was just installed a few weeks ago. as indicated by the service history. Which of the following should the technician do NEXT?

options.label: A
options.text: Disconnect the printer power for troubleshooting.

options.label: D
options.text: Replace the paper with thicker paper stock.

cards.answer: A. Disconnect the printer power for troubleshooting.
cards.why: Take the printer out of service, disconnect power as directed and let the hot fuser cool before inspecting the jam. Do not touch hot components.

cards.question: A technician needs to increase the available RAM on a virtual workstation. Which of the following should the technician do?

options.label: A
options.text: Increase the ECC memory timings in the BIOS.

options.label: B
options.text: Upgrade to the latest DDR5 modules.

options.label: C
options.text: Clear the temporary files on the workstation's boot drive.

options.label: D
options.text: Use a hypervisor to adjust the resource allocation.

cards.answer: D. Use a hypervisor to adjust the resource allocation.
cards.why: Adjust guest allocation in hypervisor within host capacity; dynamic/hot-add support varies. Allocate resources for the actual workloads. Several guests can compete for the same physical hardware. More GHz or a larger SSD alone cannot prove a machine is the best VM host.

cards.question: A company would like to take advantage of the cost savings of cloud computing by only paying for the resources used. Which of the following will BEST address this need?
cards.why: Measure usage and bill under actual service terms. Multi-tenancy means multiple customers use shared underlying infrastructure with logical separation. Keeping unnecessary capacity permanently allocated is overprovisioning, not the definition of elasticity.

cards.question: An administrator chose a shared-tenant model for a cloud deployment. Which of the following is the MOST likely reason the administrator chose this model?
cards.why: Sharing infrastructure can reduce cost; does not inherently improve security or guarantee availability.

cards.question: A supported touchscreen consistently selects a point beside the touch location. Its manual offers a calibration procedure. Which action should be tried?
cards.why: Calibration corrects the coordinate mapping on supported devices. Persistent faults may require driver or hardware diagnosis.

cards.question: A virtual file server in the cloud is configured to automatically add compute resources during times of high load on the server. Which of the following describes this cloud feature?
cards.why: Provision/release resources with changing load. Multi-tenancy means multiple customers use shared underlying infrastructure with logical separation. Keeping unnecessary capacity permanently allocated is overprovisioning, not the definition of elasticity.

cards.question: A technician is assembling crimp-style RJ45 patch cords and verifying their wire maps. Which two tools fit those tasks? (Select TWO.)
cards.why: A crimper secures compatible plugs; a cable tester checks wiring. A basic wire-map pass is not full high-speed certification.

cards.question: A laptop's trackpad and keys have risen and become hard to press. Inspection shows a swollen internal battery pressing upward. Which component explains the problem?
cards.why: The swelling can distort nearby input components. Stop charging and arrange approved battery service.

cards.question: Which of the following describes the BEST use case for a client-side hypervisor?

options.label: A
options.text: Let a developer test an application in several operating systems on one workstation.

options.label: B
options.text: Replace all resources in an exhausted data center.

options.label: C
options.text: Automatically allow multiple simultaneous users on every PC.

options.label: D
options.text: Guarantee cloud backup access during any internet outage.

cards.answer: A. Let a developer test an application in several operating systems on one workstation.
cards.why: A client-side hypervisor runs virtual machines on a workstation. Separate guest operating systems let a developer test different environments without separate physical PCs.

cards.question: A user uploads a file to a storage location that is accessible via a web browser and a client application. The user's coworkers can access the file as well. The service that the file is stored with is provided by a third party for a monthly fee. The third party's service is available to any business or consumer who would like to use the service. Which of the following BEST describes the type of service that is in use?
cards.why: Service offered for general consumer use is public cloud; data access remains controlled. Private describes exclusive use, not necessarily location or ownership. A private cloud can be run off-site by a third party. Public cloud does not mean every customer's stored files are public.

cards.question: Which listed standard is marketed as Wi-Fi 6 and supports efficient operation in 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz?
cards.why: 802.11ax is Wi-Fi 6. Its label alone does not guarantee better range or reception in every environment.

cards.question: A laptop does not have any audio output from the built-in speakers. The Windows Device Manager shows a down arrow for the audio device. Which of the following will correct this audio issue?
cards.why: Disabled audio device must be enabled if authorized; confirm selected output and driver state. A driver lets the OS communicate with hardware. Use the manufacturer or approved update source. A targeted rollback or supported update may help; replacing hardware without testing the software cause is premature.

cards.question: A user is unable to connect a mobile phone while in a car. However, a second mobile Device is able To connect in The same car, WHICH of the Following settings should the user check on the first phone?
cards.why: Check enabled Bluetooth and correct pairing/profile. Pairing establishes the relationship between devices. Check power, distance, existing connections and compatibility if discovery fails. A Bluetooth keyboard does not need a Wi-Fi internet connection.

cards.question: A laptop's BitLocker deployment requires TPM-backed protection. Setup reports that the TPM is disabled in firmware. Which setting should be checked?

options.label: A
options.text: Recorder the priority in Widows Boot Manager.

options.label: B
options.text: Check to make sure Secure Boot is turned on.

options.label: C
options.text: Ensure that the Trusted Platform Module enabled.

options.label: D
options.text: Verify that the latest updates are installed.

cards.answer: C. Ensure that the Trusted Platform Module enabled.
cards.why: Enable the supported TPM according to the deployment procedure. BitLocker configurations vary; not all require the same protection method.

cards.question: A gaming PC needs a compatible cooler. Testing shows a particular liquid-cooling kit meets its heat-load and noise targets better than the listed alternatives. Which option should be chosen?
cards.why: Use the measured, compatible cooling solution. Liquid cooling still has pumps and fans and is not automatically silent or superior.

cards.question: A RAID 5 server boots slowly. Which next step checks the array's health without assuming that drives may be removed while powered?

options.label: A
options.text: Ignore the controller because Windows started

options.label: D
options.text: Read the controller's status and event logs, using downtime only if its tools require it

cards.answer: D. Read the controller's status and event logs, using downtime only if its tools require it
cards.why: The controller identifies degraded or missing members. Lack of hot-swap support affects replacement, not every monitoring operation.

cards.question: A service technician replaced the gateway, and a user is now unable to access the SOHO wireless network. Which of the following steps should the technician take to resolve the issue?

options.label: A
options.text: Assess the network cables for damage.

options.label: D
options.text: Check if the password and SSID are correct

cards.answer: D. Check if the password and SSID are correct
cards.why: Match SSID, security mode and credentials after gateway/AP replacement. Use a strong passphrase and a separate guest network when needed. WEP and original WPA are obsolete protections. An SSID is the network name. Hiding it or filtering MAC addresses does not replace encryption and authentication.

cards.question: A RAID controller reports 'member disk missing.' What should the technician verify before choosing a replacement?

options.label: C
options.text: The identified member's status, connections and controller logs

cards.answer: C. The identified member's status, connections and controller logs
cards.why: A missing member can reflect a disk or connection problem. The summary does not by itself prove a failed controller or identify every cause.

cards.question: Which of the following handles touch-screen operation on a mobile device?
cards.why: Digitizer senses touch location. The digitizer turns touches into location data. Check supported calibration, driver and settings first. Inspect hardware and connections if appropriate. A working image does not prove the touch layer works, and not every screen supports manual calibration.

cards.question: Which of the following wireless networking protocols will support both 2.4GHz and 5GHz devices?
cards.why: 802.11ax supports 2.4/5 GHz; Wi-Fi 6E extends to 6 GHz where allowed. Wi-Fi 6 commonly operates in 2.4 and 5 GHz. A 6E connection needs a compatible AP, client and regional support. A Wi-Fi 6-only client cannot gain 6 GHz support through a new SSID name.

cards.question: Which RAID level stripes data across mirrored pairs to combine those two techniques?
cards.why: RAID 10 combines mirroring and striping. No RAID level guarantees universally maximum performance for every workload.

cards.question: Which of the following virtualization technologies allows Linux and Windows operating system to run concurrently?
cards.why: Compatible Windows and Linux guests may run concurrently on hypervisor. A driver translates print jobs into a format the printer understands. PCL means Printer Command Language. Different operating systems may need different supported drivers or driverless printing support.

cards.question: Which of the following cables should be used to terminate ST connectors on each end?
cards.why: ST is a fiber-optic connector type. LC is common on compact optical transceivers. SC uses a larger push-pull connector. Connector shape alone does not tell you the fiber mode or supported distance; match the entire link.

cards.question: A technician is working on a desktop PC and wants to verify its NIC is functional. Which of the following should the technician use?
cards.why: Supported hardware loopback tests transmit/receive path; does not prove whole LAN works. It can help isolate interface faults. It does not test the entire cable route or prove internet access. Use the correct plug and vendor-supported test for that interface.

cards.question: VoIP audio breaks up. Measurements show packet loss and highly variable arrival times. Which condition best describes that variable delay?
cards.why: Jitter is variation in packet delay. Loss and jitter can break up audio; steady latency mainly adds conversation delay.

cards.question: A technician is attempting to fix a computer that does not turn on when the power button is pressed Which of the following should the technician perform NEXT to troubleshoot the issue?

options.label: A
options.text: Verify the output voltages from the power supply unit.

options.label: B
options.text: Open the computer cabinet and replace the power button.

options.label: C
options.text: Remove and reconnect all cables that are plugged into the mot herboard

options.label: D
options.text: Reseat the power cable and confirm the outlet is providing en ergy.

cards.answer: D. Reseat the power cable and confirm the outlet is providing en ergy.
cards.why: Verify external power path before internal replacement. PSU means Power Supply Unit. Verify simple external causes before opening the chassis. A dark system can have several causes; it is not automatic proof of a failed motherboard.

cards.question: A provider hosts and maintains a complete business application. Customers use it online and configure their own accounts without managing its operating system. Which service model is this?
cards.why: Software as a Service (SaaS) supplies a complete application. The provider manages its infrastructure and application platform; customers manage their use and permitted settings.

cards.question: A new high-power GPU causes shutdowns under load. Its connectors are seated and temperatures are normal. Which listed specification should be compared with the total system demand next?

options.label: A
options.text: Confirm the power supply is grounded.

options.label: B
options.text: Check the power supply wattage rating.

options.label: C
options.text: Check whether the power supply is redundant.

options.label: D
options.text: Confirm the power cables are well connected.

cards.answer: B. Check the power supply wattage rating.
cards.why: Check the PSU's available rated output and required headroom. The new GPU may exceed the previous power budget.

cards.question: A user is requesting a headset that can be physically connected to a laptop for online conference calls. Which of the following connections should the headset use?
cards.why: Compatible USB headset carries input/output audio. HDMI means High-Definition Multimedia Interface and can carry audio and video. The OS may still send sound to another output. A supported USB audio device is another sound interface, not a video-cable repair.

cards.question: Which of the following cables should be used when connecting a cable modem to a SOHO router?
cards.why: Typical cable-modem-to-router connection is Ethernet. A home gateway may combine a router, modem, switch and access point in one box. Combined hardware does not make those functions identical.

cards.question: Which technology supplies a supported guest VM with TPM-style cryptographic key protection?
cards.why: A virtual TPM supplies that function. Network isolation is also useful hardening, but does not itself provide TPM key operations.

cards.question: A slow workstation has loud fans and intermittent shutdowns. Monitoring confirms excessive CPU temperatures and thermal throttling. Which cause fits?

options.label: A
options.text: The system is infected with malware.

cards.why: The temperature evidence supports CPU overheating. These symptoms without measurements would not exclude other causes.

cards.question: A technician is mitigating threats to web clusters. Which of the following tools is the most appropriate for a technician to use to mitigate unwanted traffic against the web clusters' public-facing interface?
cards.why: Firewall can filter unwanted traffic; form factor need not be physical. Rules decide which traffic may pass. If one service fails, inspect the relevant rule and logs. Disabling the whole firewall is not a permanent repair and can hide the actual misconfiguration.

cards.question: Which of the following explains how using a cloud infrastructure can provide rapid elasticity?

options.label: B
options.text: Customers can limit the use of a resource

options.label: C
options.text: High availability of services can be provided

options.label: D
options.text: Systems can be provisioned according to demand.

cards.answer: D. Systems can be provisioned according to demand.
cards.why: Resource capacity adjusts to demand. Multi-tenancy means multiple customers use shared underlying infrastructure with logical separation. Keeping unnecessary capacity permanently allocated is overprovisioning, not the definition of elasticity.

cards.question: Which of the following allows several websites from different companies to be housed on the same virtual server?
cards.why: Separate customers can share hosting infrastructure with logical isolation. Multi-tenancy means multiple customers use shared underlying infrastructure with logical separation. Keeping unnecessary capacity permanently allocated is overprovisioning, not the definition of elasticity.

cards.question: A new VolP solution is being implemented at a corporate office for more than 200 users. The new VolP devices do not require AC adapters at the users' desks. Which of the following network devices should a technician purchase?
cards.why: PoE switch can power many compatible phones; size per-port and total budget. The powered device receives less after cable loss: about 12.95 W or 25.5 W respectively. Match the device's standard and power demand to the port and the switch's total power budget.

cards.question: A budget PC's measured and planned power demand, including headroom, is 300 W. All listed units fit and have the correct connectors. Which listed rating is the smallest adequate choice?
cards.why: 400 W exceeds the stated 300 W requirement. A dual-core CPU label alone would not establish a safe PSU size.

cards.question: A user reports intermittent connectivity. The technician checks the network logs and sees the following output: Interface 0/1 Status Up Interface 0/1 Status Down Interface 0/1 Status Up 13:03:20 Interface 0/1 Status Down 13:04:10 Switch elected as Root bridge Interface 0/1 Status Up 13:05:40 Which of the following is the most likely reason for this issue?
cards.why: This is often called link flapping. A link light shows physical connectivity, not that DNS or internet access works. Isolate one variable at a time instead of assuming the switch is defective.

cards.question: A user can make and receive voice calls but cannot send or receive MMS text messages on a smartphone. Which of the following is the most likely cause of the issue?

options.label: A
options.text: The mobile data service is disabled.

options.label: C
options.text: The device is outside the cellular coverage area.

cards.answer: A. The mobile data service is disabled.
cards.why: MMS normally needs carrier data/APN support; voice working does not prove mobile data is enabled. Carrier support and settings matter. A messaging app may use an internet-based service instead, so a picture-message failure does not automatically prove the phone's camera is broken.

cards.question: Which of the following is the best way to protect the data of a virtual machine in the event of hardware failure?
cards.why: Independent recoverable backup protects against host/storage loss; RAID/UPS are not backups. If the underlying storage is lost, a local checkpoint can be lost too. Maintain supported independent backups and test restoration. Snapshot and checkpoint behavior varies by platform.

cards.question: A still-readable boot drive is failing, and an authorized recovery plan calls for an image onto healthy storage before repair. Which listed action preserves its data first?

options.label: A
options.text: Clone the drive to another one.

options.label: C
options.text: Download the drive manufacturer's diagnostic tool.

options.label: D
options.text: Uninstall the drive in the Device Manager.

options.label: E
options.text: Replace the drive with a new one.

cards.answer: A. Clone the drive to another one.
cards.why: Create the planned clone/image with an appropriate recovery process. Minimize unnecessary stress; severe or irreplaceable-data cases may need specialist recovery.

cards.question: A projector shows a correctly focused image, but circles appear stretched into ovals. The source resolution is supported. Which setting should be checked?

options.label: A
options.text: The projector's aspect ratio is set incorrectly.

options.label: B
options.text: The laptop's video card has failed.

options.label: C
options.text: The projector's bulb is burned out.

options.label: D
options.text: The display brightness needs to be adjusted.

cards.answer: A. The projector's aspect ratio is set incorrectly.
cards.why: An incorrect aspect ratio stretches or squeezes geometry. Keystone distortion instead changes the rectangular outline toward a trapezoid.

cards.question: A new Bluetooth headset must connect to a smartphone for the first time. Neither device supports NFC pairing. What should the user do?
cards.why: Bluetooth pairing establishes the relationship between the devices. Put the headset in pairing mode and select it in the phone's Bluetooth settings.

cards.question: A user needs more supported RAM than the current motherboard can hold. Which listed board feature, together with its maximum memory support, affects expansion room?
cards.why: More usable DIMM slots can allow additional compatible memory. Empty slots do not improve performance until the required memory is installed.

cards.question: An online retailer is working to support increased sales and boost server capacity by installing additional servers. Which of the following should be used to ensure each new server will be properly utilized?
cards.why: This can improve capacity and availability. Health checks help avoid failed servers. A load balancer does not automatically add servers; scaling must be configured separately.

cards.question: Which of the following server roles does RADIUS perform?
cards.why: RADIUS supports authentication, authorization and accounting services. AAA means Authentication, Authorization and Accounting. Knowing who someone is does not by itself decide what that person may do.

cards.question: Which of the following protocols is the most appropriate to use for inventory tracking in a small warehouse?
cards.why: RFID tags/readers support radio-based inventory identification. Passive tags draw operating energy from a reader; active tags have their own power source. Range varies greatly by system. RFID is a technology family, not one fixed frequency or distance.

cards.question: Which of the following wireless standards can operate in the 6GHz frequency range?
cards.why: 802.11ax operation in 6 GHz is marketed as Wi-Fi 6E; compatible clients/APs and local rules required.

cards.question: A previously working HDMI monitor now reports 'No signal.' Which two basic checks should come before changing interfaces or restoring the OS? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: Inspect and reseat the video connection

cards.answer: A. Inspect and reseat the video connection; B. Verify the monitor's selected input
cards.why: Check the existing signal path and input first. Then use a known-good cable or source if needed.

cards.question: A printer's service manual permits vacuum cleanup of loose toner. Which equipment should the technician use?

options.label: C
options.text: Compressed air to disperse the powder

options.label: D
options.text: Any vacuum labeled for wet spills

cards.answer: B. A manufacturer-approved toner-rated, static-safe vacuum
cards.why: The tool needs appropriate fine-toner filtration and static safety. Follow the printer's instructions and avoid blowing toner into the air.

cards.question: Which of the following internet connection types would be the most readily available for users located on unimproved land that lacks infrastructure?
cards.why: Satellite may reach areas lacking wired/cellular infrastructure with coverage/sky-view constraints. Geostationary satellites create much more propagation delay than low-Earth-orbit systems. Do not assume all satellite services have identical latency. Obstructions, weather, congestion and the provider's design also matter.

cards.question: A new GPU is correctly seated and powered, but firmware is set to onboard graphics only. Its HDMI output is inactive. Which setting should be checked?

options.label: A
options.text: Change the input source selection on the monitor.

options.label: B
options.text: Check to see whether the UEFI setting for PCle graphics is en abled.

options.label: C
options.text: Install a higher wattage power supply.

options.label: D
options.text: Test the new graphics card with an HDMI to DVI adapter.

cards.answer: B. Check to see whether the UEFI setting for PCle graphics is en abled.
cards.why: Enable/select the intended PCIe graphics path according to the firmware manual. Without this evidence, seating, power and compatibility would also need checks.

cards.question: Before installing a replacement toner cartridge, which two checks help prevent using the wrong supply or procedure? (Select TWO.)

options.label: D
options.text: Force any cartridge into the slot

cards.answer: A. Consult the model's cartridge-replacement instructions; B. Verify the cartridge's exact compatibility
cards.why: Use the correct supply and follow its installation/unsealing procedure. The exact order of mechanical steps varies by printer.

cards.question: A previously paired Bluetooth headset cannot connect to a phone. The phone's Bluetooth radio is turned off. What should the user enable?
cards.why: A paired headset still needs an active Bluetooth radio to reconnect. Wi-Fi and NFC do not replace the Bluetooth audio connection.

cards.question: An administrator needs to configure RAID for a video-rendering workstation at minimal cost. The solution should have high read/write performance and maximum drive storage utilization. Redundancy is not a concern. Which of the following RAID configurations should the administrator use?
cards.why: Striping maximizes usable member capacity without fault tolerance. RAID means Redundant Array of Independent Disks, although RAID 0 has no redundancy. If one member fails, the striped volume can be lost. RAID 0 is not a backup.

cards.question: A customer reports that a printer is only printing misaligned images. Which of the following should the technician do to correct the issue?
cards.why: Run supported alignment/calibration procedure for misregistered output. Inkjet printers spray tiny drops of ink. Cleaning consumes ink and should follow the manual. Printer calibration can improve supported color or registration problems, but it does not repair every mechanical fault.

cards.question: Which of the following network devices converts fiber network signals from light into electric signals that can be used by a Wi-Fi router?
cards.why: Optical network terminal terminates provider optical service and presents customer interfaces such as Ethernet.

cards.question: A technician needs to determine where a printer is connected on a patch panel. Which of the following is the best tool for the technician to use tolocate the port?
cards.why: Trace copper cable to unlabeled termination. The generator puts a traceable signal on the cable; the probe detects it. Use tools rated for the circuit and follow instructions for live networks. Label both ends after identification. A toner does not certify Ethernet speed.

cards.question: A laptop's large-file workload is limited by a slow HDD. RAM and CPU have adequate headroom, and a compatible SSD is an affordable upgrade. Which choice addresses the measured bottleneck?
cards.why: An SSD improves storage access in this scenario. A generic slowdown alone would not prove which component to upgrade.

cards.question: A developer wants to test experimental code in a controlled environment separated from production. What is a suitable reason to use a virtual sandbox?

options.label: A
options.text: To test the application with restricted access to production

options.label: B
options.text: To guarantee all malware is harmless

options.label: C
options.text: To eliminate all need for patches

options.label: D
options.text: To turn one CPU core into unlimited physical cores

cards.answer: A. To test the application with restricted access to production
cards.why: The sandbox provides controlled isolation for testing. Configuration and software flaws can still weaken that boundary.

cards.question: An administrator is using an RJ45 connector to terminate a network cable. Which of the following cables is the administrator terminating?
cards.why: Common modular Ethernet connector terminates compatible Cat 6 twisted pair. A straight-through cable uses the same scheme at both ends. A and B swap the orange and green pair positions. Keep each pair correctly twisted and follow the connector's wiring guide.

cards.question: A designer selects a calibrated display with verified color coverage and self-emissive pixels that turn off for deep blacks. Which listed technology uses those pixels?
cards.why: OLED is self-emissive and can offer wide viewing angles. Accurate color still depends on the particular panel and calibration.

cards.question: Which of the following controls the flow of users connecting to web server farms and prevents overutilization on any individual server?
cards.why: Distributes workload across server pool. This can improve capacity and availability. Health checks help avoid failed servers. A load balancer does not automatically add servers; scaling must be configured separately.

cards.question: A user's laptop has been slow to respond for the past few days. The user has run a virus scan, deleted temporary files, closed unnecessary programs, and rebooted the laptop, but the issue persists. Which of the following steps should the technician take next?
cards.why: Measure CPU, memory, storage and temperature behavior and compare it with the workload. Evidence should guide an upgrade or repair.

cards.question: A PC should be on 192.168.10.0/24. It is set to 192.168.10.20 with gateway 192.168.10.1, but its mask is 255.255.255.255. Which field is inconsistent with the intended LAN?
cards.why: The intended mask is 255.255.255.0. A /32 mask has valid uses elsewhere but does not match this /24 configuration.

cards.question: A network technician needs to connect into the console of a switch. Which of the following connection types should the technician most likely utilize?
cards.why: Supported serial console offers local device management independent of IP reachability. Match the cable pinout, electrical standard and terminal settings. An RJ45-shaped console port is not necessarily an Ethernet data port. USB means Universal Serial Bus.

cards.question: A server's backplane and controller require supported SAS drives for a new RAID 10 array. Which listed storage choice matches that interface?

options.label: B
options.text: Compatible SAS HDDs or SAS SSDs

cards.answer: B. Compatible SAS HDDs or SAS SSDs
cards.why: SAS identifies the interface, not whether the drive is mechanical. Use the controller's supported drives and layout.

cards.question: Which listed device can lease IP addresses when its built-in DHCP server is enabled?

options.label: D
options.text: SOHO router with a configured DHCP server

cards.answer: D. SOHO router with a configured DHCP server
cards.why: The DHCP service supplies leases. Routing hardware alone does not inherently assign client addresses.

cards.question: A laptop's Wi-Fi disconnects when a nearby interference-producing appliance runs. Signal strength is otherwise good and the access point is not overloaded. What should the technician investigate next?
cards.why: Radio-frequency interference can disrupt Wi-Fi even when signal strength appears good. Check interference sources, channel use and the available frequency bands.

cards.question: A technician is troubleshooting a burning smell on a desktop computer. The technician determines that the odor is coming from inside the device. Which of the following should the technician do first?
cards.why: Stop use and safely disconnect power; do not open energized equipment or PSU. Standby power may remain while plugged in. A loose screw can short a circuit. Never open a PSU enclosure or touch damaged capacitors; hazardous stored energy can remain. Replace or service the appropriate assembly through qualified procedures.

cards.question: Which two benefits can a supported application-virtualization deployment provide? (Select TWO.)

options.label: D
options.text: Isolation of application dependencies from the base OS

cards.answer: D. Isolation of application dependencies from the base OS; F. Simpler centralized application updates
cards.why: Isolation and centralized delivery can simplify administration. Savings and performance depend on the actual deployment.

cards.question: Which of the following best describes the primary function of a spam gateway?

options.label: C
options.text: Filter, classify and quarantine unwanted email

options.label: D
options.text: Guarantee protection from every DDoS attack

cards.answer: C. Filter, classify and quarantine unwanted email
cards.why: A spam gateway applies email policy and detection. It does not classify every kind of network traffic.

cards.question: A developer is requesting permission to utilize client-side virtualization. The developer would like to write code in a setting isolated from other infrastructure to avoid negative impacts of experimental code. Which of the following provides the best solution for the developer?
cards.why: Limit shared folders, clipboard, device access and network connectivity for risky testing. A VM escape is a breach from guest to host. Do not assume running malware in any VM makes it harmless.

cards.question: A RAID member clicks and controller diagnostics identify it as failed. Backups and the supported replacement procedure have been checked. Which repair is appropriate?

options.label: D
options.text: Run a chkdek on the drive.

cards.why: Replace the specifically identified bad member and rebuild as directed. Do not pull an arbitrary drive simply to stop noise.

cards.question: A laser printer has grinding and ghosting. Its model-specific diagnostics identify a damaged fuser assembly. Which component should be replaced?
cards.why: The diagnostic evidence identifies the fuser; generic noise and ghosting alone are not conclusive.

cards.question: A technician is unable to connect to a network device via SSH_ Which of the following cables should the technician use as an alternative connection method with a laptop?
cards.why: Supported serial console offers local device management independent of IP reachability. Match the cable pinout, electrical standard and terminal settings. An RJ45-shaped console port is not necessarily an Ethernet data port. USB means Universal Serial Bus.

cards.question: Damaged wall jacks will be replaced with compatible 110-style IDC jacks. Which tool seats their copper conductors?
cards.why: A punchdown tool terminates the new jack's contacts. It cannot repair a physically broken jack without replacing the damaged part.

cards.question: A printer displays an error message even after a paper jam is cleared. Which of the following should a technician do to fix the issue?

options.label: A
options.text: Check the paper path for a blocked sensor.

options.label: B
options.text: Verify the pickup roller is functioning.

cards.answer: A. Check the paper path for a blocked sensor.
cards.why: Inspect for scraps/blocked sensor flags using safe model-specific procedure. Pull paper in the instructed direction to avoid damage. A manual-feed prompt may instead mean the job requests another tray or size. Do not bypass a sensor to make the warning disappear.

cards.question: In which scenario is an F-type coax connector commonly used?

options.label: B
options.text: Connecting a residential cable-internet coax drop

cards.answer: B. Connecting a residential cable-internet coax drop
cards.why: F connectors commonly serve cable-provider coaxial connections. Other internet technologies use different connectors.

cards.question: A server supports two PSU modules, each rated to carry the full 500 W workload. Which arrangement reduces downtime from one PSU failing?
cards.why: A redundant arrangement lets the remaining module carry the load. It does not guarantee continuous availability against every failure.

cards.question: A laptop requires DDR3L memory at its specified low voltage. A replacement DDR3 module does not meet that requirement and the system fails POST. Which cause fits?
cards.why: The module is unsupported for the stated electrical requirement. Match generation, voltage, capacity and population rules.

cards.question: Which of the following is a characteristic of cloud computing that prioritizes reliability?
cards.why: Redundancy/failover aim to keep service available. Redundant instances and failover support availability; scaling supports changing load. The two can work together. Neither word alone guarantees zero downtime or an unlimited budget.

cards.question: An external webcam is not detected and its USB plug is visibly loose. What should the technician do first?

options.label: B
options.text: Restart the computer and run system diagnostics.

options.label: C
options.text: Reinstall the webcam software and drivers.

cards.why: Reconnect the external camera securely before reinstalling software. Also check power and privacy controls as needed.

cards.question: A user needs to connect a laptop to the internet while traveling on a train. Which of the following features should be enabled on the user's phone?
cards.why: Phone hotspot can share active cellular service where permitted. A hotspot commonly shares cellular service over Wi-Fi; tethering is the broader sharing idea. A compatible cellular modem is another option. Carrier plans, coverage and data allowances still apply.

cards.question: A projector displays 'No Source Found' after a laptop is connected. Which two settings should be checked first? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: Check the projector bulb and replace it with a new one.

options.label: B
options.text: Verify the projector settings and make sure the correct input is selected.

options.label: C
options.text: Replace the video cable and check the laptop settings.

options.label: D
options.text: Check the laptop display settings and set them to extend/dupl icate.

options.label: E
options.text: Verify the projector is turned on.

options.label: F
options.text: Check the projector settings and the laptop for the correct r esolution.

cards.answer: B. Verify the projector settings and make sure the correct input is selected.; D. Check the laptop display settings and set them to extend/dupl icate.
cards.why: Confirm the projector's selected input and the laptop's enabled external display output. The visible error already shows the projector has power.

cards.question: A laptop's liquid-contact indicators show the manufacturer's documented triggered state. What exposure do those indicators suggest?
cards.why: The indicators suggest liquid exposure. Their colors vary by model, and they do not identify every damaged part.

cards.question: A technician is configuring the settings on a multifunction printer so the device can be shared across the LAN_ Which of the following should the technician do to enable the printer to be shared across the network?
cards.why: Configure valid network address settings and authorized reachability. A reservation repeatedly offers that client the same address. A manual static address is another approach, but it must avoid addresses that DHCP may lease to someone else. MAC means Media Access Control.

cards.question: A firewall must permit both LPD and IPP printing. Which two TCP ports match those services? (Select TWO.)
cards.why: LPD uses TCP 515 and IPP TCP 631. Open only the services the deployment actually needs.

cards.question: Which connector type is commonly used on fiber-optic patch cables?
cards.why: LC is a small fiber-optic connector. RJ45 is commonly used for twisted-pair Ethernet, BNC for coaxial cable and DB9 for serial connections.

cards.question: A motherboard explicitly supports DDR5. Which listed generation should be used for its DDR5 memory slots?
cards.why: Use compatible DDR5 modules. A newer generation cannot be installed in an incompatible slot merely to increase speed.

cards.question: A workstation's manual lists supported DDR5 memory channels and recommended slot population. What should guide a performance-oriented installation?

options.label: A
options.text: Use the minimum number of modules.

cards.why: Populate the intended channels with compatible modules according to the manual. Eight slots do not necessarily mean eight channels.

cards.question: Which of the following is the purpose of an IPv4 gateway?

options.label: D
options.text: To route traffic to the next network

cards.answer: D. To route traffic to the next network
cards.why: Default gateway forwards traffic to destinations outside local subnet. With /24, the first three octets identify this subnet: 192.168.10.0. Use the actual router address on that subnet after verifying it. A default gateway forwards traffic to other networks; a DNS server does not do that job.

cards.question: A managed phone is allowed to use approved work storage, but MDM policy blocks unapproved personal external drives. What explains the home-drive restriction?

options.label: A
options.text: The pictures do not have a classification flag set.

cards.answer: C. Peripherals are managed via MDM.
cards.why: The explicit peripheral-management policy controls access. Location alone would not prove that MDM caused a failure.

cards.question: Which TCP port is the default for Secure Shell (SSH)?
cards.why: SSH uses TCP port 22 to provide encrypted remote terminal access. Telnet's default port 23 does not provide equivalent encryption.

cards.question: Which listed DNS record maps a name to an IPv4 address?
cards.why: An A record maps to IPv4. AAAA is used for IPv6; MX identifies mail exchangers.

cards.question: A compatible rechargeable active pen stops working and reports an empty battery. Which issue fits?

options.label: B
options.text: The pen software is out of date.

cards.answer: C. The pen batteries need recharging.
cards.why: Recharge the pen using its supported method. Active pens may need their own power even when finger touch works.

cards.question: Wi-Fi clients have adequate signal, but a survey shows nearby networks overlapping the active channel. What should be addressed first?
cards.why: Measured channel interference is the stated cause. Signal strength alone does not establish available throughput.

cards.question: A customer needs infrequently accessed photo storage. Among the available compatible products, the 5400 rpm HDD has the lowest quoted cost per gigabyte. Which choice meets that cost goal?
cards.why: The quoted capacity cost favors the HDD. Maintain independent backups; low cost does not provide data protection.

cards.question: A printer's internal test page is normal, but computer jobs produce symbols after installation of an incompatible print driver. Which cause fits?
cards.why: The wrong driver or page-description language can produce gibberish. Fuser faults affect physical output rather than translating document commands.

cards.question: An administrator is replacing 15.000rpm hard drives in a server. Which of the following is the interface type the drives most likely use?
cards.why: Enterprise high-rpm drives commonly use SAS; interface must match controller/backplane. SCSI means Small Computer System Interface. Many SAS controllers support suitable SATA drives, but a SATA-only controller cannot operate a SAS drive. Check the controller and enclosure support list.

cards.question: Which of the following devices would a punchdown tool most likely be utilized on?
cards.why: Compatible patch panels use insulation-displacement terminations. A patch panel organizes cable terminations; it does not switch traffic. Match the tool to the connector design. Some jacks are tool-less, and fiber needs its own connector-specific procedure.

cards.question: A PC reports 'Bootable device not found.' What should the technician verify before declaring the drive dead?

options.label: A
options.text: Drive detection, connections and the intended firmware boot entry

cards.answer: A. Drive detection, connections and the intended firmware boot entry
cards.why: A missing boot device can result from hardware, a loose connection or boot configuration. The message alone does not prove drive failure.

cards.question: Which of the following network types is used for pairing a Bluetooth device to a smartphone?
cards.why: Bluetooth personal-device link is PAN. A LAN serves a local site. A PAN links a person's nearby devices. A MAN spans a metropolitan area. A SAN provides networked storage access, commonly block storage; it is not merely a large office LAN.

cards.question: Legal-size jobs jam after a tray is loaded and configured for Letter-size paper. Which setting should be corrected to match the actual job and media?
cards.why: Set tray guides and media configuration correctly. Legal is 8.5 by 14 inches; Letter is 8.5 by 11 inches.

cards.question: A user attempts to connect a laptop to a projector but receives the following message from the projector: Out of Range. Which of the following needs to be addressed first?

options.label: B
options.text: Check the video cable and replace it if necessary.

options.label: C
options.text: Set the computer's display settings to extend/duplicate.

options.label: D
options.text: Verify that the laptop video card driver is the most up-to-da te version.

cards.why: Out-of-range indicates unsupported timing/resolution/refresh rate; choose supported mode. Resolution is the pixel grid; aspect ratio is width compared with height. Color settings and profiles affect appearance separately. Changing color depth will not fix every shape or scaling problem.

cards.question: A phone has working internet, but its maps app cannot determine its current position. Which listed function and permissions should be checked?
cards.why: Check location services/GPS permissions and signal visibility. A good data speed test does not prove location is available.

cards.question: A technician is creating a consecutive range of IP addresses that a server can select from to fulfill requests from network clients. Which of the following is the technician creating?
cards.why: Scope defines address pool and configuration for clients on a subnet. A scope is the pool of addresses for a subnet. Check utilization, stale leases and exclusions. Expand the pool only within the intended subnet and network plan; do not randomly widen the subnet mask.

cards.question: An older iPhone has a Lightning port. Which listed connection should a data-capable cable use at that phone to transfer files?
cards.why: Use the actual phone's Lightning connector and supported trust/transfer process. Other iPhone models may have USB-C.

cards.question: Which of the following display types is available for laptops?
cards.why: OLED is available in laptops and does not use separate backlight. OLED does not use a separate LCD backlight. Long-lived static content can contribute to uneven wear. Temporary image retention and permanent burn-in are not automatically the same fault.

cards.question: A docked laptop has a link-local address and no Ethernet link lights. The dock and cable work with another laptop, but this laptop is not fully seated. What should be tried next?

options.label: A
options.text: Restart the laptop in safe mode.

options.label: E
options.text: Reseat the laptop in the docking station.

cards.answer: E. Reseat the laptop in the docking station.
cards.why: Reseat the laptop in the dock to restore the physical connection. Restarting DHCP cannot fix an unseated connector.

cards.question: An M.2 replacement SSD is not detected. What must be checked before assuming a firmware toggle will fix it?

options.label: C
options.text: Drive seating and the slot's supported SATA or PCIe/NVMe interface, keying and size

cards.answer: C. Drive seating and the slot's supported SATA or PCIe/NVMe interface, keying and size
cards.why: M.2 is a physical family. A fitting card can still use an unsupported electrical interface.

cards.question: A laser printer produces solid black pages. Model-specific diagnostics identify a fault in its drum/charging assembly. Which listed part belongs to that imaging path?
cards.why: The diagnostic finding implicates the imaging drum assembly. A black page alone is not a universal replacement instruction for every printer.

cards.question: A technician is setting up a new laptop for a user who wants to be able to quickly pack up the laptop and leave if needed. The user has the following accessories: USB badge reader USB badge printer USB signature pad 3.5mm headset HDMI external monitor Mouse Which of the following is the best way to meet the user's requirement?

options.label: A
options.text: Directly connect all accessories to the laptop.

options.label: B
options.text: Provide the user with a second laptop.

options.label: C
options.text: Connect everything to a compatible docking station.

options.label: D
options.text: Provide the user with a USB hub.

cards.answer: C. Connect everything to a compatible docking station.
cards.why: Compatible dock combines peripherals for quick detach. A USB-C-shaped connector alone does not ensure video or charging support. For a failing dock network port, also check its driver and Ethernet link rather than assuming the entire laptop network is broken.

cards.question: After a motherboard replacement, a PC beeps three times and shows no image. The exact model's POST documentation identifies improperly seated RAM. What should be done after safe power isolation?
cards.why: Reseat the memory according to the service guide. The same beep count can mean something else on another model.

cards.question: Toner on a laser print smears. Which printing stage should be investigated, including its media settings?
cards.why: Fusing bonds toner to paper with heat and pressure. Incorrect media settings or failed fusing hardware can cause poor bonding.

cards.question: Which of the following is used to define a range of IP addresses available to assign using DHCP?
cards.why: Scope defines available DHCP address pool. A scope is the pool of addresses for a subnet. Check utilization, stale leases and exclusions. Expand the pool only within the intended subnet and network plan; do not randomly widen the subnet mask.

cards.question: A replacement PSU must provide sufficient electrical output and physically fit the case. Which two listed specifications directly address those requirements? (Select TWO.)
cards.why: Check wattage and form factor for these two requirements. Correct connectors, input compatibility and quality also matter.

cards.question: An application developer formats and reconfigures a development PC after every application test is complete. Which of the following is the best way to improve the efficiency of this process?
cards.why: Disposable isolated test environment can be reset between tests. Limit shared folders, clipboard, device access and network connectivity for risky testing. A VM escape is a breach from guest to host. Do not assume running malware in any VM makes it harmless.

cards.question: Before a supported hot-swap replacement in a degraded RAID 5 array, what data-protection step is appropriate?

options.label: D
options.text: Verify a usable backup and preserve recoverable data using the approved plan

cards.answer: D. Verify a usable backup and preserve recoverable data using the approved plan
cards.why: Confirm recovery protection before stressful repair work. Also identify the correct member and follow the controller procedure.

cards.question: Which of the following delivers internet over a copper medium?
cards.why: DSL delivers service over telephone copper. The modem's DSL connection must follow the provider's wiring plan. A filter is not an Ethernet adapter, and not all modern installations use a separate plug-in filter.

cards.question: A supported workload benefits from simultaneous multithreading. Which listed Intel firmware feature exposes additional logical processors per core?
cards.why: Hyper-Threading is Intel's form of SMT. It does not add physical cores or guarantee a gain for every workload.

cards.question: Which email policy checks whether a sending host is authorized for the SMTP envelope sender's domain?
cards.why: SPF evaluates the domain's published sending policy. It is not a general test that any name happens to match any IP.

cards.question: A SOHO has a coverage dead zone, and a survey identifies a suitable wired-backhaul location for another wireless radio. What should be added?
