cards.why: An access point extends wireless coverage when placed and configured correctly. Plan channels, power and backhaul capacity.

cards.question: An internet service provider is delivering service through a copper medium with shared customer bandwidth. Which of the following services has most likely been installed?
cards.why: Traditional cable broadband uses shared coax segment, often with fiber upstream. WAN means Wide Area Network; LAN means Local Area Network. An analog phone needs a working phone service or compatible voice port, not an ordinary Ethernet jack.

cards.question: A customer's storage quotes show a suitable high-capacity 5400 rpm HDD costs least per gigabyte for a large archive. Which listed option fits the stated budget goal?
cards.why: The HDD is the economical choice under the supplied prices. Optical media is not inherently cheapest per gigabyte.

cards.question: A phone reaches a known server IP, but DNS queries for website names fail. Which setting should the technician check next?
cards.why: The evidence points to DNS configuration or reachability. A local ping alone would not establish this diagnosis.

cards.question: An administrator is replacing a cable that uses a DB9 connector VVhich of the following cables is the administrator replacing?
cards.why: DE-9, commonly called DB9, commonly carries serial RS-232. Match the cable pinout, electrical standard and terminal settings. An RJ45-shaped console port is not necessarily an Ethernet data port. USB means Universal Serial Bus.

cards.question: Which of the following services allows a remote user to access network resources?
cards.why: VPN supports authorized remote private-network access. An encrypted remote-access VPN can protect traffic between a user and the VPN endpoint. It does not automatically protect traffic after that endpoint or make an unsafe device trustworthy.

cards.question: A technician wants to stress test multiple applications while maintaining the ability to easily reset those environments back to the initial state. Which of the following is the best way to accomplish this task?
cards.why: Disposable isolated test environment can be reset between tests. Limit shared folders, clipboard, device access and network connectivity for risky testing. A VM escape is a breach from guest to host. Do not assume running malware in any VM makes it harmless.

cards.question: A phone will share its cellular data over a supported Bluetooth PAN. Which sharing service should be enabled?
cards.why: Bluetooth internet sharing is tethering. A Wi-Fi hotspot is another sharing method with a different local link.

cards.question: An MFP must place scans on an authorized network file server. File-access auditing will be configured on that server. Which destination should be set on the MFP?
cards.why: Scan to an SMB share. Permissions and server auditing determine who can access files and whether access events are recorded.

cards.question: A user needs removable storage with no moving parts. Security will be provided by separately verified encryption and access controls. Which listed device fits the physical requirement?
cards.why: An SSD has no spinning disk mechanism. The SSD label alone does not mean its data is encrypted or access-controlled.

cards.question: Which listed use case benefits directly from virtual desktop infrastructure?

options.label: A
options.text: To manage shared folders by user accounts

options.label: B
options.text: To deploy software updates to user machines

options.label: C
options.text: To enhance security by centralizing all user desktops

options.label: D
options.text: To prevent users from circumventing password policies

cards.answer: C. To enhance security by centralizing all user desktops
cards.why: VDI centralizes hosted desktop management. It can support security policy, but centralization alone does not guarantee security.

cards.question: A desktop needs disk striping, all available drive capacity and no fault tolerance. Which RAID level matches these requirements?
cards.why: RAID 0 stripes data without mirroring or parity. It uses the combined capacity of equal-size drives but loses the array if one member fails.

cards.question: A PC shuts down unexpectedly. Monitoring confirms the CPU hits its thermal cutoff and the heatsink is clogged. Which cause fits?
cards.why: The observed thermal limit establishes overheating. Unexpected shutdowns by themselves have several possible causes.

cards.question: A user keeps a company-provided camera's battery charger plugged into a docking station at a desk. Company policy requires that USB devices be identified and approved by installed peripheral security software. A technician is unable to add a unique identifier to the battery charger's security software. Which of the following should the technician do?

options.label: A
options.text: Provide a USB to AC adapter for the battery charger.

options.label: B
options.text: Add a powered USB hub to the docking station.

options.label: C
options.text: Disable the peripheral security software for this user only.

options.label: D
options.text: Replace the battery charger with a USB device that has a uniq ue identifier.

cards.answer: A. Provide a USB to AC adapter for the battery charger.
cards.why: Approved wall adapter can power charging-only device without attaching it to protected data port. A properly powered hub can supply more power within its specifications. Bandwidth is shared too. A hub does not multiply the speed of the host connection.

cards.question: A technician is working with a vendor to resolve an issue that a user reported. The vendor indicates that the technician's next step is to update the firmware. Which of the following is the most important step the technician should take before proceeding?

options.label: A
options.text: Verify the device is fully charged and connected to a power s upply.

options.label: B
options.text: Ensure the device has adequate storage space for the update.

options.label: C
options.text: Verify administrative access on the device.

options.label: D
options.text: Export the users settings so they can be imported after the u pgrade

cards.answer: A. Verify the device is fully charged and connected to a power s upply.
cards.why: Use stable power and exact vendor firmware/procedure; interruption can leave device unusable. Use firmware for the exact model and follow its prerequisites and recovery instructions. Firmware is low-level code stored on the device. Do not install random firmware as a first guess for every problem.

cards.question: A company's cloud server has recently become unresponsive due to overwhelming e- commerce traffic Which of the following cloud technologies could be dynamically assigned to mitigate this issue?
cards.why: Scale capacity to demand within configured limits. Multi-tenancy means multiple customers use shared underlying infrastructure with logical separation. Keeping unnecessary capacity permanently allocated is overprovisioning, not the definition of elasticity.

cards.question: A technician needs to upgrade the power supply of a workstation that contains a high-end graphics card, 16 hyperthreaded cores, and multiple hard drives. Which of the following should the technician use to determine the appropriate power supply for the workstation?

options.label: A
options.text: The manufacturer's specifications for the components

options.label: B
options.text: The wattage of the current power supply

options.label: D
options.text: The capacity of the hard drives

cards.answer: A. The manufacturer's specifications for the components
cards.why: Use actual manufacturer component power/connector specifications and headroom. AC is alternating current; DC is direct current. Efficiency is not the percentage of labeled wattage you may use. A 750 W PSU is not reduced to 600 W merely because it is 80% efficient. Check the unit's label rather than assuming every PSU needs a manual voltage switch.

cards.question: A technician needs to test a new USB headset for videoconference calls. Audio playback is working as expected, but sound from the microphone is not being recorded. The Device Manager and Sound settings show the microphone is installed. Which of the following should the technician do next?

options.label: A
options.text: Examine the application and device mute controls.

options.label: B
options.text: Connect the headset to a different USB port.

options.label: C
options.text: Check the device's driver release date.

cards.answer: A. Examine the application and device mute controls.
cards.why: Check hardware/app mute, selected input and permissions. Hearing audio through the headset only proves the output path. The microphone is a separate input path. Check both the OS and meeting app's selection.

cards.question: Which of the following wireless technologies would a company most likely implement for inventory management?
cards.why: RFID tags/readers support inventory management. Passive tags draw operating energy from a reader; active tags have their own power source. Range varies greatly by system. RFID is a technology family, not one fixed frequency or distance.

cards.question: An ISP supplies a public IPv4 address for a router's WAN interface. Which listed address is outside the RFC 1918 private ranges and IPv4 link-local range?
cards.why: 19.45.7.28 is outside those ranges. Real ISP connections can also use provider-private addressing, so not every WAN address must be public.

cards.question: An administrator can log in to a server whose application has stopped responding. Which listed action gathers diagnostic evidence before making changes?
cards.why: Review relevant error logs and correlate their times with the outage. Log messages still require interpretation.

cards.question: A technician relocates an AP using a new crimp-terminated Ethernet patch cord and surveys radio channels. Which two listed tools match those tasks? (Select TWO.)
cards.why: A crimper assembles the compatible plugs; a Wi-Fi analyzer checks channel and signal conditions. Other termination designs may require different tools.

cards.question: A working direct-thermal printer feeds blank receipts immediately after a roll was inserted with its heat-sensitive side facing away from the head. What corrects this?

options.label: A
options.text: Update the printer driver on the computer.

options.label: C
options.text: Make sure the thermal head is heating up.

cards.answer: D. Flip the paper roll orientation.
cards.why: Install the roll in the approved orientation. Heat must reach the coated side of compatible media.

cards.question: A technician is attempting to log in to a local company portal. When the technician types the URL into the address bar, the browser is unable to resolve and display the web page. The technician tries at another workstation, and the result is the same. Other web pages are not having any issues. Which of the following should the technician check first?
cards.why: Single hostname failure across devices suggests DNS record/resolver check; verify service separately.

cards.question: A laptop's lower keys and trackpad are pushed upward. A safe inspection confirms battery swelling. Which cause fits?

options.label: D
options.text: An open bottle of rubbing alcohol fell onto the keyboard.

cards.why: The swollen battery physically obstructs the input components. Stop use and charging and arrange approved service.

cards.question: A server requires system-level memory error detection and correction. Which feature should its platform-supported modules provide?
cards.why: ECC supplies the requested protection. It can be combined with an appropriate DDR generation; the terms are not mutually exclusive.

cards.question: Which example describes Software as a Service?

options.label: B
options.text: Paying a subscription to use a provider-hosted accounting application

cards.answer: B. Paying a subscription to use a provider-hosted accounting application
cards.why: SaaS provides an application managed by the service provider. Paying for an unspecified tool does not automatically make it SaaS.

cards.question: A technician is installing the RAM for a graphs workstation. Which of the following is special purpose memory used by graphic controllers?
cards.why: Graphics memory stores framebuffers/textures and GPU working data; discrete GPU VRAM normally is not DIMM-upgradeable.

cards.question: A PC has loud fans, freezes and reboots. Temperature monitoring confirms CPU thermal throttling and overheating. Which issue fits?
cards.why: The measurements connect the symptoms to cooling. Check airflow, fans, heatsink mounting and thermal-interface material.

cards.question: Which of the following twisted pair cables supports 10GBASE-T data transmission speed?
cards.why: Cat 6A supports 10GBASE-T over compliant 328 ft channel. The full channel includes patch cords; a typical permanent link is about 295 ft. Cat 6's shorter 10-gigabit reach depends on interference and installation. Do not apply its full gigabit reach to 10-gigabit service.

cards.question: A DHCP client receives 169.254.2.2 instead of a lease from its intended 192.168.1.0/24 scope. Which service/path should be investigated?
cards.why: The client fell back to link-local addressing. Inspect the link and DHCP lease exchange rather than changing DNS first.

cards.question: A hosts-file entry points a server name to its old IP address. The server is reachable at a new address. What resolves the mismatch?

options.label: A
options.text: Correct the hosts mapping and use an approved stable address or DNS record

cards.answer: A. Correct the hosts mapping and use an approved stable address or DNS record
cards.why: A stale hosts entry can override ordinary name resolution. A reservation may stabilize addressing, but the stale mapping still needs correction.

cards.question: Which of the following is the most likely use case for client-side virtualization for a software developer?

options.label: B
options.text: Enhancing the security of physical machines

cards.answer: D. Testing on different operating systems
cards.why: Compatible guest environments support multi-OS application testing. Check guest support, licensing, hardware dependencies and security. A VM does not automatically make an old OS secure or make software for a different CPU architecture run natively.

cards.question: A technician needs to fix a computer that received a non-specific error after a scheduled computer restart. Which of the following is the best way to start troubleshooting?

options.label: B
options.text: Roll back all of the recent updates.

options.label: D
options.text: Search for the error on the internet.

cards.answer: C. Review the system event log.
cards.why: Review event/error evidence before broad updates or rollback. Compare timestamps and events across systems. Logs can show link changes or errors, but a message must be interpreted in context. Syslog is a logging protocol, not a DNS or address-assignment service.

cards.question: An active drawing pen requires a proprietary digitizer that a user's smartphone does not have. Why will the pen's active features not work?

options.label: A
options.text: The phone needs to be updated to the latest OS.

options.label: B
options.text: The drawing stylus only works with a special digitizer.

options.label: C
options.text: The stylus must be re-paired to this new device.

options.label: D
options.text: The phone's screen only supports resistive styluses.

cards.answer: B. The drawing stylus only works with a special digitizer.
cards.why: The pen and screen need compatible sensing technology. A normal finger-responsive screen need not support every active stylus.

cards.question: Every time a user tries to print a multipage document, the user is unable to print on both sides of the page. Which of the following settings will most likely resolve this issue?
cards.why: Enable two-sided printing with supported hardware/driver. Automatic duplex hardware turns or routes the page internally; manual duplex asks the user to reinsert it. Choose the correct binding edge so the back side is not upside down.

cards.question: A technician is installing a network interface card in a desktop computer. Which of the following connectors should the technician use to connect the card to the computer's motherboard?
cards.why: Desktop internal NIC commonly uses PCIe slot. A physical x16 slot may be wired for fewer lanes. Bandwidth also depends on the PCIe generation and both devices' support. Check the motherboard's lane-sharing rules.

cards.question: A user needs a technician's help connecting a laptop to a projector The projector is old and only has analog input. Which of the following cable types should the technician use to connect the laptop to the proJector?
cards.why: VGA carries analog video; digital-only laptop needs active compatible conversion. VGA means Video Graphics Array; DVI means Digital Visual Interface. A passive DVI-to-HDMI adapter does not guarantee audio or convert arbitrary analog signals to digital.

cards.question: A Windows client cannot join its domain and reports 'An attempt to resolve the hostname has failed.' Numeric-IP connectivity works, but domain DNS queries fail. Which service should be checked?
cards.why: DNS supplies domain name resolution. The text includes the needed evidence without relying on the absent exhibit.

cards.question: A users wireless laptop stopped working A technician replaced the wireless card, but the wireless range is now limited. Which of the following should the technician perform next?

options.label: B
options.text: Switch from a 2 4GHz band to a 5GHz band

options.label: C
options.text: Change the channels of the Wi-Fi card settings.

cards.why: Verify correctly attached/routed antenna leads after card service. Use the model's service manual and power-down procedure. A disconnected antenna can reduce signal greatly while the adapter still appears in the operating system.

cards.question: A technician is installing a storage solution for a computer that requires data redundancy with the fewest drives possible. Which of the following would best meet this requirement?
cards.why: Two-drive mirror provides minimum common redundant array among listed options. Usable capacity is limited to roughly one member's capacity, assuming equal drives and ignoring overhead. Mirroring also copies unwanted changes, so a separate backup is still necessary.

cards.question: A technician must distinguish drive-health evidence from filesystem consistency on a failing HDD. Which two listed checks address those different layers? (Select TWO.)

options.label: B
options.text: Made sure the replacement drive was compatible

cards.answer: A. Checked S.M.A.R.T. information; C. Ran CHKDSK
cards.why: SMART reports drive-health information; a filesystem check examines filesystem structure. Protect data first and avoid repair writes or stress tests that conflict with a recovery plan.

cards.question: A laptop runs from a powered dock but immediately turns off on battery. Diagnostics confirm the battery cannot supply power. Which action restores mobile operation?

options.label: C
options.text: Issue a peripheral set for use in the conference room.

cards.why: Replace the failed battery using the approved service process. A keyboard, monitor or mouse does not supply normal laptop battery runtime.

cards.question: Which of the following describes the difference between a DNS server and a DHCP server?

options.label: A
options.text: DNS is used for address translation, while DHCP is used for I P address assignment.

options.label: B
options.text: DNS is used for routing, while DHCP is used for name resoluti on.

options.label: C
options.text: DNS only assigns private IP addresses, while DHCP only assign s public IP addresses.

options.label: D
options.text: DNS is used to route traffic between networks, while DHCP is used to allocate subnets.

cards.answer: A. DNS is used for address translation, while DHCP is used for I P address assignment.
cards.why: DNS resolves names/records; DHCP supplies IP configuration, not name resolution itself. The client needs an address and network settings before it can communicate normally. DNS resolves names; DHCP supplies configuration. They perform different jobs even when one server runs both.

cards.question: Which of the following network devices should a technician install in order to isolate voice traffic on the network?
cards.why: Managed switch supports separate voice VLAN and appropriate traffic policy. One physical switch can contain several VLANs. A trunk can carry multiple VLANs. Routing and access rules determine whether devices in separate VLANs can reach each other.

cards.question: An unplugged laptop rattles and shuts down when moved. Before further internal inspection, what should be done under its service procedure?

options.label: A
options.text: Turn on the laptop and move it again to replicate the issue.

options.label: B
options.text: Reseat the memory modules and the SSD.

options.label: C
options.text: Remove the internal battery and look for loose parts.

options.label: D
options.text: Inspect the connections for a damaged cable.

cards.answer: C. Remove the internal battery and look for loose parts.
cards.why: Isolate the internal battery and all power, then inspect for loose conductive parts. Do not shake or test exposed energized components.

cards.question: An organization connects an on-premises private cloud with a public cloud to move supported workloads between them. Which model is this?
cards.why: Hybrid cloud combines distinct cloud infrastructures. Ordinary local storage plus an unrelated cloud account is not enough to establish it.

cards.question: After a policy forces browser connections to HTTPS, one internal web tool no longer loads. What should be checked first?

options.label: A
options.text: Ensure that the computer supports secure socket communication .

options.label: B
options.text: Report the affected user accounts to the IT department.

options.label: D
options.text: Check to see whether the website is HTTPS enabled.

cards.answer: D. Check to see whether the website is HTTPS enabled.
cards.why: Verify that the service supports HTTPS/TLS and has an appropriate certificate and endpoint. Legacy 'SSL' wording does not guarantee a working modern TLS setup.

cards.question: A technician is installing a power supply in a workstation that contains a high-end graphics card, a 3GHz processor, and two cooling fans. Which of the following specifications should the technician verify before installing the new power supply?
cards.why: Verify wattage and compatible connectors/form factor using actual component requirements. AC is alternating current; DC is direct current. Efficiency is not the percentage of labeled wattage you may use. A 750 W PSU is not reduced to 600 W merely because it is 80% efficient. Check the unit's label rather than assuming every PSU needs a manual voltage switch.

cards.question: An IT technician is troubleshooting an issue with connecting a new laptop to a company's wireless network. Which of the following diagnostic steps should the technician take first?

options.label: A
options.text: Review the network settings in the OS.

options.label: B
options.text: Install the latest firmware updates on the WAPs.

options.label: C
options.text: Increase the signal strength of the router.

options.label: D
options.text: Reset the router and reconfigure the wireless settings.

cards.answer: A. Review the network settings in the OS.
cards.why: Check client radio, SSID, security and IP settings before resetting shared AP. Use a strong passphrase and a separate guest network when needed. WEP and original WPA are obsolete protections. An SSID is the network name. Hiding it or filtering MAC addresses does not replace encryption and authentication.

cards.question: A systems administrator needs to set up a multifunction printer for the legal department. The legal department deals with sensitive documents and requires a secure method of releasing print jobs. Which of the following should the systems administrator configure to meet the department's security requirements?
cards.why: Authenticated job release protects unattended output. A PIN, badge or authenticated release can hold the job until the user arrives. This protects physical pickup; it does not automatically encrypt every network transfer or stored copy.

cards.question: A security system opens suspicious email attachments inside a restricted test environment to observe their behavior. What is this technique?
cards.why: Sandboxing uses a controlled execution environment. Merely holding an unopened attachment pending a scan is quarantine.

cards.question: A printer's internal test page has vertical lines. Its service guide identifies contamination on user-serviceable rollers and specifies cleaning first. Which action follows that guidance?
cards.why: Use the approved cleaning method. Vertical lines alone do not establish the same failed part on every model.

cards.question: After a neighboring office installs APs, a wireless survey shows new overlapping-channel interference and existing clients disconnect. Which cause fits?
cards.why: The survey identifies external radio interference. The timing alone would be only a clue.

cards.question: After replacing ink cartridges, an inkjet printer produces offset lines and doubled edges. Its maintenance guide recommends alignment for this symptom. What should the technician do first?
cards.answer: B. Run the printer's alignment process.
cards.why: Printhead alignment corrects the positioning of ink from the printheads. An inkjet does not have a laser printer's fuser assembly.

cards.question: A user is connecting to a network via a Bluetooth hot-spot. Which of the following best describes this type of network?
cards.why: Bluetooth personal-area connection can support tethering. A LAN serves a local site. A PAN links a person's nearby devices. A MAN spans a metropolitan area. A SAN provides networked storage access, commonly block storage; it is not merely a large office LAN.

cards.question: What is a tradeoff of RAID 0 striping without parity?

options.label: B
options.text: It uses combined member capacity and can improve throughput but has no redundancy

options.label: C
options.text: It stores a full mirror on each drive

cards.answer: B. It uses combined member capacity and can improve throughput but has no redundancy
cards.why: Both capacity utilization and performance can motivate RAID 0. Losing one member can lose the striped volume.

cards.question: A phone loses charge rapidly and its case grows thicker. A safe inspection confirms battery swelling. Which cause fits?
cards.why: A swollen battery is damaged. Stop use and charging and follow the manufacturer's handling procedure.

cards.question: An older laptop's built-in Wi-Fi adapter cannot use the office's required band/security mode. A supported USB Wi-Fi adapter can. Which listed addition provides a quick compatible connection?
cards.answer: A. Connect a new USB adapter.
cards.why: The compatible USB adapter adds the missing wireless capability. A new SSD or Bluetooth card does not fix the Wi-Fi mismatch.

cards.question: A user's laptop keyboard is not working properly. A technician notices that when the keys for special characters are pressed, other characters appear instead. Which of the following should the technician do first to diagnose the issue?
cards.why: Wrong locale/layout can map keys to unexpected characters; check configured layout before replacement.

cards.question: A customer's Windows tablet PC was dropped and is no longer responding to touch input on the left half of the screen. The screen protector has several scratches. but the glass is not broken. Which of the following should a technician do to diagnose the issue?
cards.why: Partial loss of touch after impact warrants digitizer/input-path testing. The digitizer turns touches into location data. Check supported calibration, driver and settings first. Inspect hardware and connections if appropriate. A working image does not prove the touch layer works, and not every screen supports manual calibration.

cards.question: A legacy application requires an older supported guest OS. Which solution provides that environment on a newer host?

options.label: B
options.text: A compatible VM running the required licensed guest OS

options.label: D
options.text: An extra Ethernet cable by itself

cards.answer: B. A compatible VM running the required licensed guest OS
cards.why: Guest virtualization can supply the needed OS environment. Hypervisor type alone does not prove application compatibility.

cards.question: Which of the following network devices is needed to direct packets to networks outside of the LAN?
cards.why: Router forwards IP packets between networks. A home gateway may combine a router, modem, switch and access point in one box. Combined hardware does not make those functions identical.

cards.question: A technician is preparing a redesigned conference room for a presentation. The presenter connects a laptop to the LCD projector, but a "No input source" error message is displayed on the LCD projector's screen. However, the presentation is working on the laptop's LCD screen when in mirroring mode on the docking station. Which of the following troubleshooting steps should the technician take first?
cards.why: Check signal cabling and selected input in changed room setup. The display can have power while receiving no usable signal. Test with a known-good cable or source to narrow the fault. A no-signal message alone does not prove a failed GPU.

cards.question: A user dropped a laptop while it was turned on. The hard drive now makes a clicking sound, and the laptop will not start up. Which of the following most likely explains this situation?

options.label: A
options.text: The hard drive bracket screws are lose.

options.label: B
options.text: The hard drive jumpers need to be reseated.

cards.answer: C. The hard drive is damaged.
cards.why: Impact plus HDD clicking suggests mechanical damage; prioritize recovery before replacement. Repeated unnecessary use can worsen some failures. Check connections too, but do not assume a filesystem repair fixes mechanical damage. A current tested backup reduces the impact.

cards.question: A company wants to add virtual servers to handle unusually high web traffic usage. Which of the following is the most efficient way?
cards.why: Scale server capacity for changing demand. Multi-tenancy means multiple customers use shared underlying infrastructure with logical separation. Keeping unnecessary capacity permanently allocated is overprovisioning, not the definition of elasticity.

cards.question: A user returns to work after a two-week vacation and cannot connect to an internal server. The remote drives were working the last time the user accessed them. Which of the following steps should the technician take next?

options.label: A
options.text: Conduct external research on the server software vendor's web site.

options.label: B
options.text: Reference the server vendor's documentation for guidance.

options.label: C
options.text: Confirm a theory and determine the next steps to resolve the issue.

options.label: D
options.text: Determine if any infrastructure changes have been made.

cards.answer: D. Determine if any infrastructure changes have been made.
cards.why: Ask about infrastructure/account/configuration changes when prior service stops working. A driver lets the OS communicate with hardware. Use the manufacturer or approved update source. A targeted rollback or supported update may help; replacing hardware without testing the software cause is premature.

cards.question: An ATX workstation's components require 400 W including headroom. Which PSU specification is suitable?

options.label: A
options.text: A compatible ATX 500 W supply with required rails and board/GPU/SATA connectors

options.label: B
options.text: An incompatible SFX unit with missing connectors

options.label: C
options.text: A DC-input device that does not match the system

options.label: D
options.text: An AC wall socket by itself

cards.answer: A. A compatible ATX 500 W supply with required rails and board/GPU/SATA connectors
cards.why: Match output capacity, rails, connectors, physical fit and input requirements. CPU/GPU labels alone cannot determine wattage.

cards.question: At their maximum standard configurations, which listed Wi-Fi generation supports the highest theoretical aggregate data rate?
cards.why: 802.11ax has the highest theoretical peak among these choices. Actual performance depends on streams, bandwidth, signal and client capability.

cards.question: A technician is setting up a home network with the following requirements: 1. Automatic distribution of IP addresses 2. Internet access Which of the following should the technician configure? (Select two).
cards.why: DHCP provides client IP settings; gateway routes off-subnet traffic, with working ISP/routing required.

cards.question: One Ethernet interface repeatedly alternates between Up and Down in switch logs. What is this behavior called?
cards.why: Port flapping describes repeated link-state changes. It is a symptom; investigate cable, port, endpoint power and configuration.

cards.question: A BYOD policy calls for authorized enrollment of personal devices so IT can apply device-level corporate settings. Which management approach fits?
cards.why: MDM manages enrolled devices. MAM focuses on applications, so the device-level requirement distinguishes the answer.

cards.question: A user reports being unable to access the network. A help desk technician notices an APIPA on the user's workstation. Which of the following services should the technician investigate first?
cards.why: Check DHCP reachability and valid lease. APIPA means Automatic Private IP Addressing. It permits local-link communication without a DHCP lease. Routers do not forward it. Check the cable or Wi-Fi connection and DHCP service; it does not by itself prove the server is broken.

cards.question: One PC repeatedly loses its date after external power is removed. Its replaceable RTC battery tests weak. Which cause fits?
cards.answer: C. The CMOS battery is discharged.
cards.why: The RTC backup battery maintains time without normal power. A single incorrect clock reading would not prove battery failure.

cards.question: An engineer needs an isolated environment for experiments that can be reset without affecting production. Which choice fits?
cards.why: A sandbox supports controlled testing. Isolation depends on its actual configuration.

cards.question: A tablet consistently selects a point inches away from a touch. Supported calibration and driver checks fail to fix it. Which input component needs further testing?
cards.why: The digitizer senses touch location. The protective glass itself does not translate touch coordinates.

cards.question: A graphics card's specification requires an 8-pin PCIe auxiliary power plug. Which cable should the technician use?
cards.why: Use the exact PSU's compatible PCIe power cable. An 8-pin CPU/EPS plug is not interchangeable just because it has eight pins.

cards.question: A technician must test a new MSI package alongside representative legacy apps before production rollout. Which environment best supports that compatibility check?
cards.why: Use an isolated virtual sandbox that mirrors the required software configuration. Application virtualization alone is not proof of compatibility.

cards.question: A user is expecting a visit from a new customer, and the company's ADSL link has suddenly gone down. Which of the following should the user do to access a smartphone's 4G internet connection from the laptop?
cards.why: Wi-Fi hotspot shares active cellular service; USB tethering also possible but mere cable insufficient.

cards.question: Which of the following provides a client device with an IP address?
cards.why: DHCP supplies client addressing parameters. The client needs an address and network settings before it can communicate normally. DNS resolves names; DHCP supplies configuration. They perform different jobs even when one server runs both.

cards.question: A desktop PC was recently moved to a new area and needs internet access RJ45 connections are not available, but access can be provided through 802.11n connections. Which of the following will need to be installed?
cards.why: Install compatible wireless NIC/USB adapter for supported WLAN. Use the model's service manual and power-down procedure. A disconnected antenna can reduce signal greatly while the adapter still appears in the operating system.

cards.question: Which device forwards packets between a small office's private LAN and the ISP network?
cards.why: A router forwards packets between IP networks. A cable modem terminates the cable service; a switch mainly connects devices within a local network.

cards.question: Before selecting a replacement power supply for a gaming PC, which listed specification should the user check?
cards.why: The supply must provide adequate wattage for the components, including the graphics card. Also verify physical fit and required connectors before purchase.

cards.question: A phone's image has discolored patches. Tests rule out a protector problem and battery swelling and identify damage within its LCD panel. Which component needs service?
cards.why: The confirmed panel damage explains the image defect. Discoloration without inspection can have other underlying causes.

cards.question: A supported system mixes DDR3-1066 and DDR3-1333 modules. Its compatibility table permits both to operate together at 1066 MT/s. Which listed rate should it use for reliable operation?
cards.why: Use their supported common 1066 MT/s setting. MT/s measures transfers per second; mixing arbitrary modules is not always supported.

cards.question: A user has already provisioned a supported mobile wallet. Which short-range phone technology enables contactless payment at a compatible terminal?
cards.why: NFC handles the close-range exchange. The wallet and payment credentials must also be valid.

cards.question: A developer needs isolated desktop environments with different browser versions on one adequately sized machine. Which listed approach best supplies those environments?
cards.answer: C. Test using a virtual desktop.
cards.why: Separate virtual desktops/VMs can host different browser versions. Verify each guest's licensing and resource requirements.

cards.question: Which default port is associated with Remote Desktop Protocol?
cards.why: RDP normally uses port 3389 and can use TCP and UDP. No port-scan exhibit is needed for this default-port question.

cards.question: After dropping a mobile device, a user reports that it no longer responds to touch/tap commands. The user has already rebooted the device, but the issue persists. Which of the following components is MOST likely causing this issue?
cards.why: Loss of touch after impact points to digitizer/input path. The digitizer turns touches into location data. Check supported calibration, driver and settings first. Inspect hardware and connections if appropriate. A working image does not prove the touch layer works, and not every screen supports manual calibration.

cards.question: A technician needs to install an NVMe drive in an old computer using a PCIe 4X card. The technician installs Windows on the drive and reboots the computer. An error message appears stating there is no bootable device found. The technician checks the BIOS but cannot select the new drive as a boot device. Which of the following is MOST likely causing the issue?

options.label: A
options.text: The boot partition is not set as active.

options.label: B
options.text: The BIOS does not have NVMe boot drivers.

options.label: C
options.text: The NVMe drive has an MBR partition.

options.label: D
options.text: The NVMe drive is out of space.

cards.answer: B. The BIOS does not have NVMe boot drivers.
cards.why: Using NVMe as data disk does not prove firmware can boot it; check UEFI/vendor support. The firmware selects the boot path. A detected disk still needs a valid boot configuration. Do not reformat a drive merely because the boot order or firmware mode is wrong.

cards.question: Which of the following is the BEST use case for client-side virtualization?
cards.why: Client virtualization can preserve compatible legacy OS/application environment. Check guest support, licensing, hardware dependencies and security. A VM does not automatically make an old OS secure or make software for a different CPU architecture run natively.

cards.question: Which listed protocol is a transport protocol whose header contains source and destination port numbers, rather than one application service with a single default port?
cards.why: TCP uses ports to distinguish application endpoints. Saying TCP operates without port numbers would be false.

cards.question: A CPU was replaced without reinstalling its required thermal-interface material. It now overheats and crashes under load. Which correction fits?
cards.why: Apply the specified thermal-interface material and mount the cooler correctly. Also verify fan connection and airflow.

cards.question: A laptop will not charge from a known-good adapter. Inspection confirms a broken charging-port contact. Which cause fits?
cards.why: The damaged port interrupts the charging path. A good adapter alone would not rule out battery or board faults.

cards.question: A business must print multipart carbonless forms whose lower sheets are created by pressure. Which printer type fits?
cards.why: An impact printer strikes the form stack. This is different from printing two ordinary copies with any printer.

cards.question: A printer vendor has released a supported firmware fix for the vulnerability involved in a breach. Which action addresses that known flaw?

options.label: C
options.text: Place all printers on a separate print server.

cards.answer: D. Update to the latest firmware.
cards.why: Apply the correct firmware update under the approved procedure. Also review access and services; an update is not every part of hardening.

cards.question: A specific printer frequently experiences paper jams. A technician inspects the printer and finds that the paper is still partially in the paper tray when the printer jams. Which of the following should the technician check FIRST?
cards.why: Failure to pull paper from tray suggests pickup/feed roller or media/guide problem. Worn or dirty parts can cause feed failures, but paper condition and loading also matter. Use the model's cleaning and replacement procedure.

cards.question: A corporate phone takes pictures normally. A data-capable USB cable works, but device policy blocks USB file transfer. What explains the inability to copy photos?

options.label: A
options.text: Settings are preventing the transfer of data from the device' s camera.

options.label: B
options.text: A technician needs to change the camera settings on the devic e.

options.label: C
options.text: The device has corrupted picture files due to an update.

options.label: D
options.text: The device needs to have the OS reinstalled.

cards.answer: A. Settings are preventing the transfer of data from the device' s camera.
cards.why: Transfer restrictions, permissions and modes can block data even when the camera works. Reinstalling the OS is not the indicated fix.

cards.question: A technician needs to provide data redundancy on a user's workstation. Which of the following RAID levels provides redundancy with the FEWEST disks?
cards.why: Two-disk mirror provides single-disk fault tolerance. Usable capacity is limited to roughly one member's capacity, assuming equal drives and ignoring overhead. Mirroring also copies unwanted changes, so a separate backup is still necessary.

cards.question: A technician is diagnosing the cause of the degraded status of a RAID 5 array of five HDDs. Which of the following steps should the technician complete first?
cards.why: Review controller logs/member status before reseating or rebuilding. Use a compatible replacement of adequate capacity. A degraded array has reduced protection; rebuilding adds workload and takes time. A summary saying 'degraded' does not identify a bay by itself.

cards.question: A user needs a pocket-sized removable USB storage device that plugs directly into a standard host port. Which choice fits?
cards.why: A USB flash drive provides portable removable storage. Price and maximum capacity depend on the actual products offered.

cards.question: Which of the following is an aspect of using client-side virtualization?
cards.why: Client virtualization can preserve compatible legacy OS/application environment. Check guest support, licensing, hardware dependencies and security. A VM does not automatically make an old OS secure or make software for a different CPU architecture run natively.

cards.question: Which of the following technologies can be used to connect a home PC to a company's network?
cards.why: VPN creates authorized remote-network connectivity. An encrypted remote-access VPN can protect traffic between a user and the VPN endpoint. It does not automatically protect traffic after that endpoint or make an unsafe device trustworthy.

cards.question: A 279 ft interbuilding link is exposed to strong electrical interference. Cable routing will follow applicable installation rules. Which medium best avoids electrical EMI in its data path?
cards.why: Optical fiber carries light rather than electrical signals. Do not assume sharing a power conduit is permitted without checking the installation requirements.

cards.question: A compatible dock requires a full-featured USB-C host connection for its display, data and charging functions. Which listed connection should be used?
cards.why: Use a properly rated USB-C cable and supported host port. A USB-C shape alone does not guarantee video or full power capability.

cards.question: A user connected a laptop to a projector. The image on the screen is very fuzzy, but the image's brightness is satisfactory. Which of the following projector settings should the user adjust first to correct the issue?
cards.why: Adjust focus for uniformly soft image. A dirty lens or excessive digital keystone correction can reduce clarity. Keystone distortion is a trapezoid-shaped image caused by projection geometry; it is different from simple blur.

cards.question: A user reports having an issue charging a laptop from home. When the user connects the USB-C adapter that is attached to the office workstation to the laptop charging port, the laptop charges correctly. When the user connects the home USB-C adapter to the laptop charging port, the laptop does not charge. Which of the following should the technician do to ensure the user can work at home and in the office?

options.label: A
options.text: Provide a UPS for the user's home office.

options.label: B
options.text: Give the user an OEM power supply for home use.

options.label: C
options.text: Replace the user's laptop with a desktop, and enable remote l og-in.

options.label: D
options.text: Instruct the user to use a USB-C hub when working at home.

cards.answer: B. Give the user an OEM power supply for home use.
cards.why: Provide compatible vendor-approved charger with required USB Power Delivery profiles and rated cable.

cards.question: A laptop keyboard has sticky keys. What cleaning approach should be used?

options.label: C
options.text: Follow the manufacturer's approved cleaning method with power removed

options.label: D
options.text: Scrape contacts using a metal tool while powered

cards.answer: C. Follow the manufacturer's approved cleaning method with power removed
cards.why: Cleaning methods depend on the model and contamination. Avoid soaking the device or pushing liquid into it.

cards.question: When a user touches or swipes across an external touch screen, the image flickers but no input is registered on the presentation laptop. A technician verifies that the external touch screen appears free from physical damage. Which of the following should the technician do next?

options.label: A
options.text: Reboot the LCD touch panel and laptop.

options.label: B
options.text: Check the cables connecting to the laptop.

options.label: C
options.text: Verify the correct input source is set on the laptop.

options.label: D
options.text: Replace the laptop with a new device that is known to work.

options.label: E
options.text: Inspect the LCD touch panel for dead pixels or burn-in.

cards.answer: B. Check the cables connecting to the laptop.
cards.why: External touch display may need separate USB data plus video; inspect both connections. The comparison helps isolate the problem but does not prove one component. Follow the service manual and power-down procedure before inspecting a display cable. Persistent physical panel damage generally requires replacement.

cards.question: Numerous vendors implemented a feature in routers and access points that allows for automatically moving wireless clients between 2.4GHz and 5.0GHz frequencies based on user density and the distance from the wireless equipment. Which of the following describes this feature?
cards.why: AP encourages capable clients toward suitable band; final association behavior is client-dependent. The client's behavior and AP implementation affect the result. It does not convert a 2.4 GHz-only adapter into a 5 GHz adapter or guarantee a particular speed.

cards.question: Users lack permission to install a new managed printer driver. Which solution preserves least privilege while enabling printing?

options.label: A
options.text: Deploy the approved driver and queue through authorized administration or management tools

options.label: C
options.text: Give every user permanent administrator rights

options.label: D
options.text: Download unsigned drivers from an unknown site

cards.answer: A. Deploy the approved driver and queue through authorized administration or management tools
cards.why: Use approved administrative deployment. Merely placing a driver on the print server may not grant non-admin installation permission under current policy.

cards.question: Which laptop display setting directly controls how bright the screen looks and can be lowered to reduce display power use?
cards.why: Lowering brightness usually reduces display power use and can extend battery life. Other hardware and workloads also affect runtime.

cards.question: Which of the following cloud models provides hardware environment equivalent components to develop a solution?
cards.why: IaaS offers compute/storage/network infrastructure with customer-managed guest software. You rent compute, storage and networking while retaining more software responsibility. The provider manages the underlying infrastructure. Renting a VM does not make the guest OS maintenance someone else's job.

cards.question: An iPhone charges with its approved cable but not a newly purchased incompatible cable. The port is undamaged. Which issue fits?

options.label: A
options.text: The cable does not meet OEM standards.

options.label: C
options.text: The iPhone logic board is defective.

cards.answer: A. The cable does not meet OEM standards.
cards.why: The new cable does not meet the device's required specifications. The controlled comparison isolates it from the phone's port and battery.

cards.question: A technician is trying to set up a computer to dual boot from both Windows and Linux. The technician believes that a setting is preventing the computer from accessing the flash drive with the OS image prior to loading the OS. Which of the following settings should the technician check?
cards.why: Check UEFI boot menu/order, USB permissions and supported media; do not blanket-disable Secure Boot.

cards.question: A frequently used projector continuously shows a message to clean the air filters. The technician checks the filters, and they are dean. Which of the following preconfigured settings is causing the projector to show the message frequently?
cards.why: Some cleaning/lamp reminders use elapsed-use counters; reset only after required service per manual.

cards.question: A newly created empty RAID logical disk is visible in Windows but has no partition or filesystem. No existing data needs preservation. What should be done next?

options.label: A
options.text: Decrease the number of drives to three.

cards.answer: B. Partition and format the volume.
cards.why: Initialize as needed, partition and format the new volume. Formatting an existing populated volume would destroy its data.

cards.question: A user reports that a software application functioned as expected the previous day, but this morning, the user is unable to launch the application. Which of the following describes what the technician should do next?

options.label: B
options.text: Identify any changes the user has made.

options.label: C
options.text: Determine which steps need to be performed.

options.label: D
options.text: Check the vendor's website for guidance.

cards.answer: B. Identify any changes the user has made.
cards.why: Identify changes since last working state before broad updates. A driver lets the OS communicate with hardware. Use the manufacturer or approved update source. A targeted rollback or supported update may help; replacing hardware without testing the software cause is premature.

cards.question: Which listed protocol provides an encrypted command-line session to a supported remote network device?
cards.why: SSH provides secure remote terminal access, commonly TCP 22. It is not by itself a whole-network VPN.

cards.question: What is the usual maximum complete copper structured-cabling channel length for supported Ethernet operation within the cable category's rating?
cards.why: The channel includes patch cords; the usual permanent-link limit is about 295 ft. Some speed/category combinations, such as Cat 6 at 10GBASE-T, have shorter limits.

cards.question: How does a PAN differ from a LAN?

options.label: A
options.text: A PAN links a person's nearby devices; a LAN serves a local site

options.label: B
options.text: A PAN is always more secure

cards.answer: A. A PAN links a person's nearby devices; a LAN serves a local site
cards.why: Personal Area Network describes the small personal-device scope. It can be wired or wireless and has no automatic speed or security advantage.

cards.question: A laptop normally uses a powered dock. After an absence, neither the laptop nor docked peripherals work, and the dock's power light is off. What should be checked first?

options.label: A
options.text: Ensure the docking station is plugged in.

options.label: B
options.text: Press and release the laptop power button.

options.label: C
options.text: Plug the laptop in and let it charge overnight.

options.label: D
options.text: Connect the laptop directly to the network.

cards.answer: A. Ensure the docking station is plugged in.
cards.why: Verify dock power and its connections before reinstalling software or replacing equipment.

cards.question: An organization integrates its private cloud with a public cloud so applications can use resources in both. Which deployment model describes this?
cards.why: Hybrid cloud joins distinct cloud environments. Simply running one local VM and one unrelated remote VM does not establish the complete model.

cards.question: A department wants to reduce the number of sheets used for multipage documents. Which printer feature directly supports that goal?
cards.why: Duplex printing uses both sides of a sheet. It does not necessarily reduce the amount of toner used for the same content.

cards.question: Vertical lines on a laser printer's internal pages match confirmed damage on its drum. Which listed part should receive service?
cards.why: The inspected defect identifies the drum. Lines alone are not a universal reason to replace it on every printer.

cards.question: A HDD performs poorly and its reallocated-sector count rises significantly. After protecting recoverable data, which listed action best addresses the failing medium?

options.label: A
options.text: Run sfc /scannow on the hard drive.

options.label: C
options.text: Run chkdsk /f on the hard drive.

cards.why: Plan drive replacement based on the health evidence. Formatting or filesystem repair cannot restore physically failing media.

cards.question: RAM and storage meet a hypervisor's requirements, but setup reports that CPU virtualization is disabled. Which area should be checked?
cards.why: Check the supported CPU virtualization setting in firmware. RAM and disk capacity also matter, but have already been verified here.

cards.question: A technician is troubleshooting poor printing quality on an inkjet printer. The pages have white lines running through the text and graphics. Which of the following is the most likely cause?
cards.why: Nozzle check and approved cleaning can clear clogged inkjet nozzles causing missing bands. Inkjet printers spray tiny drops of ink. Cleaning consumes ink and should follow the manual. Printer calibration can improve supported color or registration problems, but it does not repair every mechanical fault.

cards.question: A large office is eliminating all personal printers for VIP staff members and replacing these devices with one enterprise MFR Human resources staff members are concerned about printing confidential documents on the new device. Which of the following best addresses this concern?
cards.why: Authenticated release keeps confidential pages from unattended output tray. A PIN, badge or authenticated release can hold the job until the user arrives. This protects physical pickup; it does not automatically encrypt every network transfer or stored copy.

cards.question: A technician is upgrading a user's laptop from an HDD to an SSD. The user's laptop only has a single bay for a hard drive. Which of the following characteristics of the SSD is the most important in this scenario?
cards.why: Drive must fit bay and match connector/interface, thickness, power and firmware support. Match the electrical interface, keying and supported card length. M.2 2280 is about 0.87 by 3.15 inches; the name retains the standard's size code. A physically fitting drive may still be unsupported.

cards.question: A company is deploying tablets to all branch offices. The company needs a way to set security settings and configure which applications can be installed on the tablets. Which of the following is the best way for the company to remotely perform these tasks?
cards.why: MDM centrally applies supported device/app policies. An organization can distribute settings and apps and enforce supported policies. Capabilities depend on device ownership, platform and enrollment type. Enrollment does not mean every personal detail becomes visible to IT.

cards.question: A laptop's service manual supports the purchased M.2 SSD. Which location should the technician find for its installation?
cards.why: Use the compatible M.2 storage slot. Other laptops may instead use 2.5-inch bays or soldered storage.

cards.question: A laptop charges only when its plug is held at an angle. A known-good adapter works on another unit, and inspection finds damage at the DC jack. Which cause fits?
cards.why: The damaged jack explains the intermittent contact. Adapter testing alone would not rule out all other charging faults.

cards.question: Which of the following cloud models provides the most control?
cards.why: IaaS generally gives most guest-stack control among listed service models; provider still manages physical infrastructure.

cards.question: After printer service, color registration is incorrect. Supplies and mechanical installation check out, and the manual recommends its calibration routine. Which item should be checked?
cards.why: Calibration corrects supported color/registration alignment. The original fuser key was not established by the generic image-quality complaint.

cards.question: Which two scenarios most directly call for centrally managed remote desktops? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: Staff need approved corporate desktops from personal devices

options.label: B
options.text: A company needs only a 10 PB disk archive

options.label: C
options.text: A user needs a fully offline desktop with no connection

options.label: D
options.text: A bank wants centralized desktop administration and access controls

options.label: F
options.text: A phone needs a replacement battery

cards.answer: A. Staff need approved corporate desktops from personal devices; D. A bank wants centralized desktop administration and access controls
cards.why: VDI hosts desktops centrally and can serve authorized remote clients. Security and responsiveness depend on access policy and network quality.

cards.question: A laptop uses the correct Wi-Fi name and passphrase, but its profile selects a security mode different from the AP's required supported mode. What is wrong?

options.label: C
options.text: Insufficient power input to the AP

cards.why: The security settings must match, not just the SSID and password.

cards.question: A user purchased a retail router and would like to set up a private network. Which of the following network address ranges should the user configure?
cards.why: 172.16.0.0 through 172.31.255.255 is RFC1918 private range. The middle range runs from 172.16.0.0 through 172.31.255.255. Not every 172 address is private. These addresses are reused inside private networks and are not globally routed on the public internet.

cards.question: A user plugs in a laptop to the corporate network and the laptop is automatically assigned an IP address. Which of the following server types was used to assign the IP address?
cards.why: DHCP dynamically supplies address/settings. The client needs an address and network settings before it can communicate normally. DNS resolves names; DHCP supplies configuration. They perform different jobs even when one server runs both.

cards.question: In which model does the provider normally manage and patch the complete delivered application, such as hosted email?
cards.why: SaaS delivers the application itself. Customers still manage their accounts, access choices and data responsibilities.

cards.question: A user's smartphone repeatedly loses the connection to a home Wi-Fi network. The user has already tried restarting the smartphone, rebooting the router, and resetting the smartphone's Wi-Fi network settings. Which of the following should the user do next to resolve the issue?

options.label: D
options.text: Check the range of the router.

cards.answer: D. Check the range of the router.
cards.why: Measure signal/range and compare known-good locations/devices before replacing router. Compare another client and, if possible, a wired connection. Association with an AP proves only part of the path. Replacing the wireless adapter is not justified by this symptom alone.

cards.question: Which Windows feature uses supported fingerprint or facial-recognition hardware for sign-in?
cards.why: Windows Hello supports approved biometric sign-in methods. An ordinary webcam is not automatically compatible with secure face authentication.

cards.question: Several users launch an application hosted on a central server without installing its full executable locally. Which delivery approach describes that architecture?
cards.answer: B. Remote application hosting/virtualized application delivery
cards.why: Central application delivery describes where the program runs or is presented. It is not automatically SaaS unless the service model fits too.

cards.question: A new paper stock exceeds one printer's supported weight. It feeds poorly in that device but works in other models. What should be done?

options.label: A
options.text: Use media within that printer's specifications and select the correct tray/media profile

cards.answer: A. Use media within that printer's specifications and select the correct tray/media profile
cards.why: Media support is model-specific. Brand alone does not establish compatibility, and rollers cannot make unsupported paper appropriate.

cards.question: A low-cost laptop uses soldered flash storage with an integrated controller labeled Embedded MultiMediaCard. Which storage type is this?
cards.why: eMMC is embedded flash storage. Total laptop price and suitability still depend on capacity, performance and other components.

cards.question: Which of the following devices is designed to monitor and filter incoming and outgoing network traffic?
cards.why: Firewall filters traffic under configured policy. Rules decide which traffic may pass. If one service fails, inspect the relevant rule and logs. Disabling the whole firewall is not a permanent repair and can hide the actual misconfiguration.

cards.question: One desktop has slow wired networking after a move. A compatible known-good patch cord is available. Which listed low-impact substitution helps isolate the local physical path?
cards.why: Testing a known-good patch cable helps distinguish a cable fault before replacing the motherboard or changing office bandwidth.

cards.question: A user's computer frequently freezes and requires multiple hard restarts to recover functionality. A technician confirms the hardware components have not been recently upgraded or replaced. Which of the following should the technician do first to troubleshoot the issue?

options.label: A
options.text: Check the temperature of the CPU.

cards.why: Review crash/events and temperatures before replacing parts. Compare timestamps and events across systems. Logs can show link changes or errors, but a message must be interpreted in context. Syslog is a logging protocol, not a DNS or address-assignment service.

cards.question: A deployment requires encryption performed inside each storage drive, with properly managed authentication and recovery. Which listed technology fits?
cards.why: A self-encrypting drive performs encryption internally. Configure access protection and preserve recovery material; the label alone does not prove data is locked.

cards.question: A display permanently shows the outline of an old static sign after content changes and prescribed retention recovery fails. Which issue fits?
cards.why: Permanent residual imagery is burn-in. Temporary image retention is a related but potentially reversible condition.

cards.question: A PC repeatedly loses its clock after being unplugged, and its RTC coin cell tests weak. Which cause fits?
cards.why: The RTC backup battery is failing. Not every incorrect clock is caused by a battery.

cards.question: A manually addressed office LAN is 192.168.1.0/24. Which listed unused host address belongs to that subnet?
cards.why: 192.168.1.56 matches the stated subnet. Private address status alone would not make any address appropriate for any LAN.

cards.question: Which protocol should be enabled for encrypted remote command-line management of supported network devices?
cards.why: SSH encrypts the network management session. A directly attached serial console is a different access path.

cards.question: A user's USB backups negotiate a slower mode through one damaged cable. The same drive and files transfer normally with a known-good rated cable. What should be replaced?

options.label: A
options.text: Replace the hard drive's USB cable.

options.label: B
options.text: Defragment the user's external hard drive.

options.label: C
options.text: Update the storage drivers on the user's system.

options.label: D
options.text: Instruct the user to compress the files.

cards.answer: A. Replace the hard drive's USB cable.
cards.why: The cable substitution identifies the fault. Different source disks or file mixes can also change transfer time in other cases.

cards.question: A desktop supports NVMe and SATA storage. The selected NVMe SSD provides the highest tested throughput for the workload. Which option matches it?

options.label: A
options.text: PCIe SSD connected via NVMe interface

options.label: C
options.text: M.2 SSD connected via SATA interface

cards.answer: A. PCIe SSD connected via NVMe interface
cards.why: The PCIe/NVMe SSD matches the stated result. Interface capability and actual workload both matter.

cards.question: A network technician is working to locate an end user's Cat 6 cable within a network rack. The server rack is poorly documented, and a cable management system has not been implemented_ Which of the following would be the best tool to best identify the correct cable?
cards.why: Trace unlabeled twisted-pair cable. The generator puts a traceable signal on the cable; the probe detects it. Use tools rated for the circuit and follow instructions for live networks. Label both ends after identification. A toner does not certify Ethernet speed.

cards.question: A company wants enrolled fingerprint or supported facial sign-in in addition to its account policy. Which listed hardware adds that input capability?
cards.why: A compatible biometric scanner supplies the identifying measurement. Enrollment and approved fallback access remain necessary.

cards.question: Two Bluetooth devices enter pairing mode and request a matching PIN. What should the technician do to complete that pairing?

options.label: A
options.text: Enable and configure MFA on the smart device.

options.label: B
options.text: Synchronize all data to the cloud.

options.label: C
options.text: Enable location services on the smart device to find the spea ker.

options.label: D
options.text: Enter the appropriate PIN code on the smart device.

cards.answer: D. Enter the appropriate PIN code on the smart device.
cards.why: Enter or confirm the required PIN through the supported process. Other Bluetooth pairing methods may not use a typed PIN.

cards.question: Which of the following should the label on a network jack faceplate refer to?
cards.why: Permanent jack label should map to documented cable/patch-panel termination, not changing client or VLAN.

cards.question: An engineer discovers the reason a user is unable to access the internet on a company laptop is because the RJ45 port failed. Which of the following should the engineer do to immediately restore network connectivity?
cards.why: Authorized available Wi-Fi or compatible USB Ethernet can restore connectivity while failed port awaits repair.

cards.question: A user's Windows PC is unable to connect to the network at a new branch office that the user is visiting. A technician discovers the PC is unable to ping the local gateway. Which of the following commands should the technician use next?
cards.why: Windows ipconfig shows local IP configuration for addressing diagnosis; not a repair by itself. It displays configuration useful for comparing a failing client with a working one. Check the address, mask, gateway and lease source. Reading settings does not prove every network path works.

cards.question: Which of the following best describes metered utilization for cloud computing?

options.label: A
options.text: Cloud resources are billed to clients based on usage.

options.label: B
options.text: Cloud resources are shared with other companies conducting si milar business.

options.label: C
options.text: Cloud resources are available at a fixed amount for a fixed p rice.

options.label: D
options.text: Cloud resources are located in the on-site data center.

cards.answer: A. Cloud resources are billed to clients based on usage.
cards.why: Usage is measured and billed according to service terms. Multi-tenancy means multiple customers use shared underlying infrastructure with logical separation. Keeping unnecessary capacity permanently allocated is overprovisioning, not the definition of elasticity.

cards.question: A laser printer's internal pages have vertical lines. Its service guide and a known-good cartridge test identify the integrated toner/drum cartridge as faulty. Which action fits?
cards.why: Replace the identified cartridge. The isolated evidence, not vertical lines alone, justifies the replacement.

cards.question: A technician is troubleshooting a PC that makes grinding noises and eventually shuts down. The technician determines the PC is overheating. Which of the following is most likely failing?
cards.why: Grinding cooling fan plus measured overheating warrants fan inspection/replacement and safe shutdown.

cards.question: A projector repeatedly shuts down with a heat warning and restarts only after cooling. Its air filter is clogged. Which cause fits?

options.label: A
options.text: The video cable connecting the video source to the projector is failing.

options.label: B
options.text: The bulb in the projector is failing.

options.label: C
options.text: The projector is overheating and needs to be cleaned.

options.label: D
options.text: The outlet that the projector is plugged into is faulty.

cards.answer: C. The projector is overheating and needs to be cleaned.
cards.why: Restricted airflow causes overheating in this scenario. Follow cooling and cleaning instructions before use.

cards.question: A laptop works on wired office Ethernet, but its Wi-Fi adapter is disabled at home. Which action should be taken first?

options.label: B
options.text: Give the user a dock to use at home.

cards.why: Enable the wireless adapter and join the authorized home network. A wired office connection does not prove Wi-Fi is enabled.

cards.question: An Ethernet patch cord's latch is broken. The repair plan calls for replacing its crimp-style modular plug with a compatible new plug and then testing it. Which two listed tools prepare and secure that termination? (Select TWO.)
cards.answer: A. Cable stripper; B. Network crimper
cards.why: A cable stripper prepares the jacket and a network crimper secures the plug. Replacing the entire damaged patch cord is often simpler.

cards.question: Which of the following is considered a connectionless protocol?
cards.why: UDP is connectionless and lacks built-in delivery/order guarantees. UDP has less transport machinery, which can suit real-time traffic. Applications can add reliability on top of it. Neither protocol automatically encrypts the payload.

cards.question: A server specification requires platform-supported memory error correction. Which listed feature supplies it?
cards.why: ECC supports detection and correction of memory errors. DDR4/DDR5 and ECC describe different properties and can coexist.

cards.question: A user reports that a printer pulls multiple sheets of paper from the paper tray instead of a single sheet. Which of the following should a technician investigate to resolve this issue? (Select two).
cards.answer: C. Pickup roller; D. Separation pad
cards.why: Worn separation pad and pickup/feed rollers can cause multiple-sheet feeds; inspect media too. Worn or dirty parts can cause feed failures, but paper condition and loading also matter. Use the model's cleaning and replacement procedure.

cards.question: A legacy desktop moved away from wired Ethernet has no wireless adapter installed. Why can it not join Wi-Fi?
cards.why: It lacks the required radio/network adapter. Install a compatible supported Wi-Fi adapter.

cards.question: A technician is designing a new laptop for a local construction company. Company employees will move the laptop around frequently and are likely to drop the laptop while working. Which of the following drives should the technician install to mitigate for potential damage?
cards.why: SSD has no moving parts; rugged enclosure and backups still needed. A Hard Disk Drive often offers more capacity per dollar. Choose based on compatibility, workload, capacity and budget. Neither type eliminates the need for backups.

cards.question: A specialized application and its hardware are tested to work in a licensed legacy VM with supported passthrough. Which approach can preserve that environment during a host OS migration?

options.label: B
options.text: Use the tested legacy guest and supported device passthrough

options.label: C
options.text: Assume any new PC fixes every driver issue

cards.answer: B. Use the tested legacy guest and supported device passthrough
cards.why: The verified guest and hardware path make virtualization viable. A VM cannot guarantee compatibility with arbitrary physical hardware.

cards.question: Which of the following translates a hostname to IP addresses?
cards.why: DNS commonly resolves names to IP records. DNS means Domain Name System. It stores several kinds of records, not just website addresses. An MX record names a mail server; it does not directly contain the destination's IP address.

cards.question: A newly built PC slows and shuts down. CPU temperature reaches its limit, and inspection confirms missing required thermal paste. Which cause fits?
cards.answer: A. Thermal paste was not used.
cards.why: Poor heat transfer explains the measured overheating. Shutdown timing alone would not identify it.

cards.question: Which of the following is the primary function of a DNS service?

options.label: A
options.text: To dynamically assign network addresses to hosts

options.label: B
options.text: To translate domain names to IP addresses

options.label: C
options.text: To authenticate users to remote servers

options.label: D
options.text: To serve files over the network

cards.answer: B. To translate domain names to IP addresses
cards.why: DNS commonly resolves names to IP records. DNS means Domain Name System. It stores several kinds of records, not just website addresses. An MX record names a mail server; it does not directly contain the destination's IP address.

cards.question: A cloud design needs cross-region failover and capacity changes with demand. Which two concepts address those goals? (Select TWO.)
cards.why: High availability uses redundancy/failover; elasticity adjusts capacity. Actual failover time depends on the implemented design.

cards.question: A laptop supports an M.2 PCIe/NVMe storage slot. The chosen NVMe SSD is the fastest tested compatible option. Which two listed terms identify its form factor and protocol? (Select TWO.)
cards.answer: B. M.2 SSD; D. NVMe interface
cards.why: M.2 identifies the form factor and NVMe the storage protocol. A device described only as M.2 is not necessarily NVMe.

cards.question: Which of the following models is an example of metered utilization?
cards.why: Pay-as-you-go commonly bills measured consumption; other plans can also meter usage. Multi-tenancy means multiple customers use shared underlying infrastructure with logical separation. Keeping unnecessary capacity permanently allocated is overprovisioning, not the definition of elasticity.

cards.question: Two supported 32-bit Windows clients need a printer shared by a 64-bit Windows server. The vendor provides the required supported client drivers. What should IT deploy?

options.label: A
options.text: Approved drivers matching each client's OS and architecture, using the authorized installation method

options.label: D
options.text: No driver or supported print protocol

cards.answer: A. Approved drivers matching each client's OS and architecture, using the authorized installation method
cards.why: Client compatibility and installation policy determine the driver deployment. An older OS is not automatically 32-bit.

cards.question: Measurements show a laptop's HDD write performance is the bottleneck. Which compatible component replacement most directly addresses it?

options.label: A
