options.text: Replace RAM with the same capacity

options.label: B
options.text: Replace the HDD with a suitable SSD

cards.answer: B. Replace the HDD with a suitable SSD
cards.why: A compatible SSD addresses storage-bound writes. Verify the workload and preserve data before migration.

cards.question: Which of the following is most likely used to control door access?
cards.why: RFID/NFC credentials can support door access; authorization remains controller-side. Passive tags draw operating energy from a reader; active tags have their own power source. Range varies greatly by system. RFID is a technology family, not one fixed frequency or distance.

cards.question: An older CCFL laptop shows a faint picture. Tests confirm its lamp works but the inverter is faulty. Which diagnosis fits?
cards.why: The inverter powers the older fluorescent backlight. LED displays use a different backlight-power arrangement.

cards.question: A technician is asked to purchase and install a line-of-sight wireless system that provides a stable network connection between two buildings. Which of the following needs to be considered prior to purchasing the system?
cards.why: Check local power/band rules plus line of sight and link budget. Do not change the country setting to bypass restrictions. Some 5 GHz channels require radar detection and channel changes. Local approval determines which 6 GHz features are allowed.

cards.question: After a supported OS upgrade, a laptop's external monitor stops working. The vendor identifies a required compatible graphics-driver update. What should the technician install?

options.label: C
options.text: Restore the operating system to the previous version.

cards.answer: A. Install the latest graphics drivers.
cards.why: Use the approved graphics driver matching the OS and hardware. A random newest driver is not automatically appropriate.

cards.question: Which service can automatically supply a client with an IP address and primary and secondary DNS server addresses?
cards.why: DHCP supplies network configuration, including DNS server addresses. DNS itself resolves names; DHCP tells the client which DNS servers to use.

cards.question: Before upgrading a laptop from 4 GB to 16 GB RAM, what should be matched to its specifications?

options.label: A
options.text: Supported DDR generation, form factor, voltage, capacity and population rules

options.label: D
options.text: Any larger module that can be forced into the slot

cards.answer: A. Supported DDR generation, form factor, voltage, capacity and population rules
cards.why: Compatibility depends on the platform's complete requirements, not brand alone.

cards.question: Which of the following should a technician use in DNS to map a device to an IPv6 address?
cards.why: AAAA maps hostname to IPv6 address. DNS means Domain Name System. It stores several kinds of records, not just website addresses. An MX record names a mail server; it does not directly contain the destination's IP address.

cards.question: A 32 GB upgrade shows only 16 GB. The manual reveals one DIMM was installed in an unsupported population order. Which action addresses that finding?

options.label: B
options.text: Reseat and populate the DIMMs in the manual's prescribed slots

cards.answer: B. Reseat and populate the DIMMs in the manual's prescribed slots
cards.why: Follow the specified memory-slot arrangement. Capacity limits, seating and module health also matter if the problem continues.

cards.question: Which default TCP port carries the FTP control connection?
cards.why: FTP control uses TCP 21. Active-mode data traditionally uses TCP 20; passive mode uses server-selected data ports.

cards.question: Which of the following allows for a beam of light to transmit data through a flexible cable?
cards.why: Fiber carries modulated light; both single-mode and multimode exist. EMI means Electromagnetic Interference. Reach depends on the fiber type, transceivers, wavelength and data rate. There is no single maximum distance for all fiber links. Never look into a connected fiber end.

cards.question: Employees are concerned about sensitive data being printed on a shared multifunction printer located in a high-traffic hallway. Which of the following should a technician do to address this concern?

options.label: A
options.text: Set up a PIN for user authentication at the printer.

options.label: B
options.text: Relocate the printer to an unused office space.

options.label: C
options.text: Configure printing of sensitive data through a specific tray.

options.label: D
options.text: Schedule print jobs to be released at certain times.

cards.answer: A. Set up a PIN for user authentication at the printer.
cards.why: A PIN, badge or authenticated release can hold the job until the user arrives. This protects physical pickup; it does not automatically encrypt every network transfer or stored copy.

cards.question: A laptop panel has colored vertical lines. A known-good external display works, and panel-cable testing confirms the cable is sound. Diagnostics identify the LCD panel. Which component should be replaced?
cards.why: The added isolation evidence points to the panel. Lines alone could also result from cable or graphics faults.

cards.question: Which of the following is used to register inputs on a touch-screen monitor?
cards.why: Digitizer registers touch input. The digitizer turns touches into location data. Check supported calibration, driver and settings first. Inspect hardware and connections if appropriate. A working image does not prove the touch layer works, and not every screen supports manual calibration.

cards.question: One user's print jobs request A4, but the office uses Letter paper. The user's default document/driver paper size is wrong. Which correction fits?

options.label: A
options.text: Reinstall the printer driver on the user's computer.

options.label: B
options.text: Print to a different printer in the office.

options.label: C
options.text: Set the printer defaults in the Control Panel to print to let ter-sized paper.

options.label: D
options.text: Have the user check the page size on every print job.

cards.answer: C. Set the printer defaults in the Control Panel to print to let ter-sized paper.
cards.why: Set the intended Letter default and check any document-specific override. Reinstalling a working driver is unnecessary for a size setting.

cards.question: A PC's fans run but it fails POST. The diagnostic procedure calls for verifying supply rails before replacing parts. Which listed test fits?
cards.why: Fan movement does not prove all PSU outputs are valid. Use supported diagnostics and do not open the PSU enclosure.

cards.question: After disconnecting all power before replacing a complete desktop PSU, which listed precaution helps protect components from static discharge?
cards.answer: A. Wear an antistatic wrist strap.
cards.why: Use appropriate ESD precautions such as a correctly grounded strap. Never open the PSU's own enclosure; stored energy can remain.

cards.question: Two sites need a high-rate link beyond ordinary copper Ethernet reach. Compatible optics are available. Which listed medium is most suitable?
cards.why: Fiber can support the required distance and rate with the right optics. Fiber alone does not specify one universal speed.

cards.question: A laptop's manual specifies replaceable DDR5 SODIMMs. Which listed module type matches?
cards.why: Use compatible DDR5 SODIMMs. Not every laptop supports removable memory or that generation.

cards.question: A computer technician is investigating issues with a user's workstation. The user reports the following: 1. Loading the operating system takes much longer than usual 2. Clicking sounds are coming from inside the workstation Which of the following is the most likely cause of the issue?
cards.answer: C. The hard drive is failing.
cards.why: HDD clicking plus slow startup suggests mechanical failure; protect data. Repeated unnecessary use can worsen some failures. Check connections too, but do not assume a filesystem repair fixes mechanical damage. A current tested backup reduces the impact.

cards.question: A printer must remain a DHCP client but receive a predictable address across router restarts. Which saved DHCP configuration should be used?
cards.why: A reservation associates its client identity with a consistent address. Preserve the router's configuration and avoid conflicting assignments.

cards.question: Which of the following DNS records is used to point to a mail server?
cards.why: MX names mail exchanger; AAA is not the IPv6 AAAA record. DNS means Domain Name System. It stores several kinds of records, not just website addresses. An MX record names a mail server; it does not directly contain the destination's IP address.

cards.question: Which listed default TCP port is used for FTP control during file transfer?
cards.why: TCP 21 is FTP control. The actual file data uses a separate mode-dependent connection.

cards.question: A user complains that print jobs remain in the printer queue. A technician sends a ping command to the printer, and the printer replies successfully. The paper trays are full, and toner levels are okay. Which of the following is a reason the print jobs are getting stuck in the queue?

options.label: A
options.text: Theprinter is disconnected from the network.

options.label: B
options.text: Thefirst job in thequeue is waiting for paper inthemanual fee d tray.

options.label: C
options.text: Thepaper size forthe last job in the queue is not available.

options.label: D
options.text: Theprint queue isunable to locate the printer.

cards.answer: B. Thefirst job in thequeue is waiting for paper inthemanual fee d tray.
cards.why: Job waiting for manual feed/media can block queue; check display and job requirements. Pull paper in the instructed direction to avoid damage. A manual-feed prompt may instead mean the job requests another tray or size. Do not bypass a sensor to make the warning disappear.

cards.question: A company is testing the latest model of a laptop. After turning on the laptop, there is a noticeable burning smell. Which of the following steps should a technician take to troubleshoot the laptop issue? (Select two).

options.label: A
options.text: Turn it off and disconnect all power sources.

options.label: B
options.text: Submit an emergency request to the local facilities manager.

options.label: C
options.text: Check for foreign objects, liquid spills, and internal damage .

options.label: D
options.text: Contact the vendor and submit a return request.

options.label: E
options.text: Remove the device from the MDM.

cards.answer: A. Turn it off and disconnect all power sources.; C. Check for foreign objects, liquid spills, and internal damage .
cards.why: Safely stop/disconnect power then inspect under approved procedure; warranty/service may require vendor handling.

cards.question: An administrator must change a port's VLAN membership on a managed LAN. Which listed device holds that configuration?
cards.why: Configure the managed switch. Access between different VLANs additionally needs routing and allowed policy.

cards.question: A desktop smells burnt near its power inlet. After safely shutting it down and disconnecting all power, which listed external inspection is appropriate first?

options.label: A
options.text: Check that the power cable is not damaged.

options.label: B
options.text: Ensure the power supply is set to the correct voltage.

options.label: C
options.text: Verify the power supply is outputting adequate wattage.

options.label: D
options.text: Inspect the power supply fan for debris.

cards.answer: A. Check that the power cable is not damaged.
cards.why: Inspect the cord and inlet for damage without energizing the fault. Do not open or service the PSU's internal circuitry.

cards.question: An administrator configured multiple networked devices to store data that can be accessed as local storage. Which of the following did the administrator create?
cards.why: SAN commonly presents remote block storage as local disks to hosts. A LAN serves a local site. A PAN links a person's nearby devices. A MAN spans a metropolitan area. A SAN provides networked storage access, commonly block storage; it is not merely a large office LAN.

cards.question: Which address on a DHCP-configured PC indicates IPv4 link-local fallback rather than an ordinary office lease?
cards.why: The relevant range is 169.254.0.0/16. Merely seeing the first octet 169 is not sufficient.

cards.question: A PC can reach a known web service by its numeric IP, but DNS lookups fail and no resolver is configured. Which cause fits?

options.label: A
options.text: The user does not have permission to viewthe website.

options.label: B
options.text: The website is offline and not responding.

options.label: C
options.text: The DNS settings are not configured on theuser's device.

options.label: D
options.text: The DHCP server is not reachable from theuser's device.

cards.answer: C. The DNS settings are not configured on theuser's device.
cards.why: The missing DNS configuration explains the name failures. Raw-IP ping alone would not prove all web services work.

cards.question: A firewall must allow LPD and IPP printing. Which two TCP ports match? (Select TWO.)
cards.why: LPD uses 515 and IPP 631. Permit only required services under the deployment's security policy.

cards.question: A technician is troubleshooting a network issue. Users report that the connection keeps dropping and reconnecting every few seconds. The technician: Verifies the network configuration settings are correct on the workstation Tests the network cable from the workstation to the switch and finds no issues Uses a known-good workstation on the existing network cable and replicates the reported issue Which of the following should the technician do next?

options.label: A
options.text: Add new network hardware to reduce congestion.

options.label: B
options.text: Assign a static IP to the impacted workstations.

options.label: C
options.text: Validate the environment for external interference.

options.label: D
options.text: Check the network logs for evidence of port flapping.

cards.answer: D. Check the network logs for evidence of port flapping.
cards.why: The repeated drops warrant interface logs and port-state inspection. A known-good client reproducing the fault narrows the shared link or switch path.

cards.question: A user wants to confirm that all necessary hardware is functional for a webinar. Which of the following should the user test and configure in the webinar application prior to joining? (Select three).
cards.answer: C. Speakers; E. Camera; G. Microphone
cards.why: Test selected speakers/headphones, microphone and camera before call. Hearing audio through the headset only proves the output path. The microphone is a separate input path. Check both the OS and meeting app's selection.

cards.question: Which term describes a restricted testing environment that may be implemented using an isolated VM?
cards.why: A sandbox is the testing environment. Not every sandbox is a VM, and isolation is not an absolute safety guarantee.

cards.question: A PC is 192.168.10.5 with mask 255.255.255.0, but its gateway is 192.168.1.1. The intended LAN is 192.168.10.0/24. What is wrong?

options.label: A
options.text: Networking was not configured using DHCP.

options.label: B
options.text: IPv6 should be used instead of IPv4.

options.label: D
options.text: The workstation has the incorrect gateway.

cards.answer: D. The workstation has the incorrect gateway.
cards.why: The gateway is outside the stated local subnet. Verify the actual router address for this LAN rather than guessing a replacement value.

cards.question: A financial workstation needs four-drive striping across mirrored pairs. Which RAID level matches that design?
cards.why: RAID 10 matches the requested structure and sacrifices about half the raw capacity to mirrors. It is not a universal maximum-redundancy solution.

cards.question: Which cloud deployment model is reserved exclusively for one organization, whether hosted on-site or off-site?
cards.why: Private cloud is defined by exclusive organizational use, not by a mandatory local location.

cards.question: Scan-to-email stopped after its SMTP server was retired. What should the technician configure?

options.label: A
options.text: An approved supported SMTP relay with correct authentication, TLS and sender settings

options.label: B
options.text: An unrelated DNS A record only

options.label: D
options.text: An SMB port in place of all SMTP settings

cards.answer: A. An approved supported SMTP relay with correct authentication, TLS and sender settings
cards.why: The MFP needs a working mail-sending service. An approved on-premises or cloud relay may fit, depending on its capabilities and policy.

cards.question: A USB dock's manual says it supports data but cannot charge the host laptop. Why does the laptop not charge even though the dock has its own AC adapter?

options.label: A
options.text: The dock is not designed to provide power passthrough.

options.label: B
options.text: The dock is only connected to a USB 3.0 port.

options.label: C
options.text: Proper drivers for the dock were not installed.

options.label: D
options.text: Too many accessories are plugged into the dock.

cards.answer: A. The dock is not designed to provide power passthrough.
cards.why: The dock lacks host power-delivery capability. A USB data generation number does not promise laptop charging.

cards.question: Which of the following configurations is used to logically segregate computers that are physically connected to the same network?
cards.why: VLAN logically separates layer-2 broadcast domains. One physical switch can contain several VLANs. A trunk can carry multiple VLANs. Routing and access rules determine whether devices in separate VLANs can reach each other.

cards.question: Before internal Wi-Fi-card replacement on a laptop, what should the technician do under the service manual?

options.label: C
options.text: Shut down and isolate external power and the internal battery as directed

cards.answer: C. Shut down and isolate external power and the internal battery as directed
cards.why: Internal service needs the prescribed power isolation and ESD precautions. Switching off Wi-Fi is not electrical isolation.

cards.question: A newly installed supported GPU is using a generic display driver and lacks its normal resolutions/features. Which cause fits?

options.label: A
options.text: TheGPU is not compatible with the user's motherboard.

options.label: B
options.text: Thecomputer does not have enough RAM installed to support the GPU.

options.label: C
options.text: Theuser failed to install the appropriate OEM drivers.

options.label: D
options.text: Thecomputer does not have a supported OS installed.

cards.answer: C. Theuser failed to install the appropriate OEM drivers.
cards.why: Install the correct supported graphics driver and verify output settings. Low resolution alone does not prove insufficient RAM.

cards.question: A user is unable to get a laptop screen to display on the conference room TV. The room has an in-room computer, which is currently being displayed on the TV screen. The user has plugged the laptop into the conference room's wireless HDMI dongle, but the TV screen is still showing the in-room computer desktop. Which of the following should the user do to most likely resolve the issue?

options.label: A
options.text: Confirm that the user's Wi-Fi settings are correct.

options.label: B
options.text: Adjust the settings on the wireless HDMI base station.

options.label: C
options.text: Change the input on the conference room's TV.

options.label: D
options.text: Replace the in-room computer's HDMI cable.

cards.answer: C. Change the input on the conference room's TV.
cards.why: Select TV input connected to intended receiver/source. The display can have power while receiving no usable signal. Test with a known-good cable or source to narrow the fault. A no-signal message alone does not prove a failed GPU.

cards.question: Laser toner rubs off approved paper despite correct settings. Diagnostics confirm the fuser is defective. Which part should be replaced?
cards.why: The fuser bonds toner with heat and pressure. Correct media settings and specific diagnostics distinguish it from other causes.

cards.question: A company wants to reduce paper consumption when printing multiple copies of a multipage document. Which setting fits?
cards.why: Duplex printing uses both sides and can reduce sheets. It does not guarantee reduced toner use.

cards.question: An MFP must save confidential scans to a file server where only executives have read access and required transport protection is configured. Which destination fits?

options.label: D
options.text: An SMB share with restricted executive access

cards.answer: D. An SMB share with restricted executive access
cards.why: The authorized share and access rules protect the intended audience. A share name alone does not supply auditing or encryption.

cards.question: A VM must have no network communication with the host or other devices. Which configuration directly enforces that requirement?

options.label: C
options.text: Disable/remove its virtual network adapters and verify isolation

cards.answer: C. Disable/remove its virtual network adapters and verify isolation
cards.why: An environment label is not a network boundary. Also review other sharing paths for the intended isolation policy.

cards.question: Which of the following is used to verify if a NIC port can send and receive data?
cards.why: Compatible loopback tests local NIC send/receive path. It can help isolate interface faults. It does not test the entire cable route or prove internet access. Use the correct plug and vendor-supported test for that interface.

cards.question: A VM was set up to deny access to the host computer and any network resources. Which of the following describes this scenario?
cards.why: A restricted sandbox matches the purpose. Its network and sharing controls, not merely the name, enforce the separation.

cards.question: Which of the following servers is used to collect data and information about events from a network- connected host?
cards.why: Syslog collects event messages from networked systems. Compare timestamps and events across systems. Logs can show link changes or errors, but a message must be interpreted in context. Syslog is a logging protocol, not a DNS or address-assignment service.

cards.question: A high-power GPU installation develops a burning smell near its auxiliary power plug. After safe shutdown and power isolation, what should be inspected first?

options.label: C
options.text: The GPU power connector and cable for heat damage and correct seating/rating

cards.answer: C. The GPU power connector and cable for heat damage and correct seating/rating
cards.why: Use the exact GPU/PSU manufacturer's connector guidance. Do not keep energizing a visibly damaged power connection.

cards.question: A reachable file server's firewall permits DNS and web traffic but blocks TCP 445. Clients cannot access its modern SMB shares. What is the likely issue?

options.label: A
options.text: Applicable ports have been closed during routine hardening.

options.label: C
options.text: The server lost power during a recent storm and did not resum e operation.

options.label: D
options.text: The route was removed from the border router.

cards.answer: A. Applicable ports have been closed during routine hardening.
cards.why: Modern SMB file sharing normally uses TCP 445. The firewall's omitted service port explains the stated failure.

cards.question: A technician sets up secure print and configures an NFC device that will authenticate users for access. Which of the following will the NFC device most likely use to authenticate?
cards.why: NFC badge can identify user for authenticated print release. A PIN, badge or authenticated release can hold the job until the user arrives. This protects physical pickup; it does not automatically encrypt every network transfer or stored copy.

cards.question: Which tool terminates copper conductors on a compatible 110-style RJ45 wall jack?
cards.why: Use a punchdown tool for the IDC contacts. A modular plug may instead require crimp termination.

cards.question: A laptop's storage specification calls for an M.2 2280 PCIe/NVMe SSD. Which listed form factor should be installed?
cards.why: M.2 is the specified form factor. Match supported interface, keying and length as well.

cards.question: Which of the following is a legacy, 15-pin cable type?
cards.why: VGA commonly uses 15-pin DE-15 connector; analog video only. VGA means Video Graphics Array; DVI means Digital Visual Interface. A passive DVI-to-HDMI adapter does not guarantee audio or convert arbitrary analog signals to digital.

cards.question: A carrier confirms a user's upload speed has been reduced after the plan's high-speed data allowance was used. Which cause fits?
cards.why: The service is being throttled. Without the carrier evidence, coverage and congestion would also need investigation.

cards.question: A small-business router must automatically lease client IP addresses. Which service should the technician configure for that requirement?
cards.why: DHCP supplies automatic addressing. There is no universal first router setting for every deployment.

cards.question: A RAID 5 controller reports that it is rebuilding after a failed member was replaced. Performance is lower during the rebuild. What explains this?

options.label: A
options.text: Losing a drive caused data loss.

options.label: B
options.text: Data is being written to the new drive.

options.label: C
options.text: The array is repairing corrupt data sectors.

cards.answer: B. Data is being written to the new drive.
cards.why: Reconstruction reads surviving members and writes reconstructed data onto the replacement, consuming I/O. This is not merely repairing corrupt sectors.

cards.question: A desktop powers many conventional 5 V USB peripherals. Which listed PSU characteristic is relevant alongside the motherboard and hub power budgets?
cards.why: Available 5 V current is relevant to legacy USB loads. Per-port limits still apply; USB Power Delivery can negotiate other voltages on supported hardware.

cards.question: A car's Bluetooth pairing process requests a passkey. Which listed feature completes that confirmation?
cards.why: Use the supported PIN/passkey confirmation. Other pairing methods may work differently.

cards.question: A laptop sends video over VGA to an audiovisual system. Both support HDMI audio and video. Which change can provide audio on the same connection?
cards.why: HDMI can carry both signals; VGA does not carry audio. Select the appropriate audio output after connecting it.

cards.question: A laser printer intermittently fails to pick up approved, correctly loaded paper. The manual recommends cleaning its visibly dirty pickup rollers. What should be done next?
cards.why: Clean the pickup rollers as directed. Drivers do not repair a confirmed mechanical feed problem.

cards.question: Which of the following virtualization technologies is best suited for running microservices?
cards.why: Containers package app/dependencies and share host kernel; common fit for microservices, with isolation limits.

cards.question: A user's phone does not respond to touch. A technician inspects the phone but does not see any evidence of physical damage. The technician restarts the device, which does not fix the issue. Which of the following components should the technician examine next?
cards.why: Inspect touch sensing path after software checks. The digitizer turns touches into location data. Check supported calibration, driver and settings first. Inspect hardware and connections if appropriate. A working image does not prove the touch layer works, and not every screen supports manual calibration.

cards.question: Users have been reporting slow network traffic in a branch office, and the technician needs to determine if packet loss is occurring on the network. Which of the following would the technician most likely use to passively assess the network traffic issue?
cards.why: Tap with analyzer can observe traffic; packet-loss measurement requires suitable capture/statistics.

cards.question: A RAID array has suspected drive failure and still-readable important data without a current recovery copy. Which listed action protects that data before repair?

options.label: B
options.text: Review logs to verify the theory.

cards.answer: A. Perform a full data backup.
cards.why: Preserve recoverable data using the approved backup or recovery plan, then identify and service the correct member. Avoid unnecessary stress if professional recovery is warranted.

cards.question: A laptop plays audio through Bluetooth, but its internal speakers are muted in the selected output settings. Which change resolves the stated issue?
cards.answer: B. Toggling the laptop's mute setting
cards.why: Unmute the selected internal-speaker output and verify volume. Successful Bluetooth audio establishes only that output path.

cards.question: A previously working rendering PC now shuts down under load. Which two checks gather relevant hardware evidence before replacing parts? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: Check PSU capacity, connectors and supported power diagnostics

options.label: B
options.text: Measure CPU/GPU temperatures and inspect cooling

options.label: E
options.text: Assume a three-year-old compatible GPU suddenly changed its connector

cards.answer: A. Check PSU capacity, connectors and supported power diagnostics; B. Measure CPU/GPU temperatures and inspect cooling
cards.why: Rendering stresses graphics, cooling and power. Test these paths rather than guessing from unspecified POST beeps.

cards.question: A Windows PC configured for automatic IPv4 addressing receives no DHCP lease. Which fallback feature may assign a 169.254.x.x address?
cards.why: APIPA supplies a link-local address. It does not repair a disconnected cable or provide ordinary routed internet access.

cards.question: A printer repeatedly jams because its documented feed rollers are worn. The vendor's maintenance kit contains the needed replacement parts. Which action fits?
cards.why: Install the supported maintenance kit following the model's procedure. Repeated jams alone would not prove a kit is required.

cards.question: A user tries to connect a monitor to a laptop to have an additional screen for work, but both screens show the same content. Which of the following should the user do to resolve the issue?

options.label: A
options.text: Use the Add New Hardware assistant to add the monitor and set up the required settings.

options.label: B
options.text: Purchase a docking station to connect both the laptop and the monitor.

options.label: C
options.text: Configure the Windows tiling feature to display multiple wind ows.

options.label: D
options.text: Go to the Display settings and configure the external monitor as extended.

cards.answer: D. Go to the Display settings and configure the external monitor as extended.
cards.why: Extend gives separate desktop space; duplicate mirrors content. The comparison helps isolate the problem but does not prove one component. Follow the service manual and power-down procedure before inspecting a display cable. Persistent physical panel damage generally requires replacement.

cards.question: All office printers support Wi-Fi, but some lack Ethernet jacks. Which shared connection method can attach them to the approved wireless LAN?
cards.why: Enable and securely configure their supported wireless networking. Printers without Wi-Fi would need a different supported solution.

cards.question: A user is testing a new operating system that is contained on a USB drive. The user wants the new OS to load automatically when the computer is powered on. Which of the following should the user configure?
cards.why: Select supported boot device/order in UEFI; preserve security policy. The firmware selects the boot path. A detected disk still needs a valid boot configuration. Do not reformat a drive merely because the boot order or firmware mode is wrong.

cards.question: A full-size SD card can be read but not written after replacement. Which physical control should be checked first?

options.label: B
options.text: The card is a storage device.

cards.answer: C. The card is not locked.
cards.why: Check its write-protect slider. A bare microSD card has no such slider, though its full-size adapter may.

cards.question: A user reports that a laptop's display is too dim. Which of the following should a technician try first to troubleshoot the issue?

options.label: A
options.text: Check the refresh rate of the laptop display and adjust it if necessary.

options.label: B
options.text: Make sure the correct cables are being used for the connectio n.

options.label: C
options.text: Check the settings of the laptop display.

options.label: D
options.text: Make sure the video card driver is updated.

options.label: E
options.text: Check the resolution of the laptop display.

cards.answer: C. Check the settings of the laptop display.
cards.why: Check brightness/adaptive/power settings before hardware replacement. LCD means Liquid Crystal Display. Many current LCDs use LED backlighting; some older CCFL-backlit displays use an inverter. Do not prescribe an inverter replacement for every dim modern screen. Check brightness settings too.

cards.question: A phone and conference badges support tapping compatible NFC tags to import small contact records. Which connection method fits?
cards.why: NFC can exchange a small payload at very short range. Contact sharing requires compatible tags and apps; it is not universal phone-to-phone behavior.

cards.question: A PC runs many applications and monitoring shows heavy paging due to insufficient RAM. Which supported upgrade can reduce that paging workload?

options.label: A
options.text: Increase the amount of virtual memory in the OS.

options.label: D
options.text: Upgrade the amount of RAM in the computer.

cards.answer: D. Upgrade the amount of RAM in the computer.
cards.why: More RAM can reduce paging when memory is the bottleneck. This does not promise to prevent all SSD failures.

cards.question: A TV is displaying its built-in logo while a laptop sends a verified HDMI signal into a different input. Which issue most likely prevents mirroring?

options.label: A
options.text: The user's laptop does not support screen mirroring.

options.label: B
options.text: The television does not support screen mirroring.

options.label: C
options.text: The wrong input is selected on the television.

options.label: D
options.text: The user does not have Bluetooth enabled on the laptop.

options.label: E
options.text: The television has a defective A/C adapter cable.

cards.answer: C. The wrong input is selected on the television.
cards.why: Select the TV input receiving the laptop's HDMI signal. Bluetooth is not required for this wired connection.

cards.question: A user's phone overheated earlier in the day, causing the battery to expand in the case. Which of the following should the technician advise the user to do first?
cards.why: Stop use/charging and shut down safely; arrange approved battery service. Do not puncture, crush or force the battery out. Swelling can damage nearby parts. Follow the maker's handling and disposal process instead of continuing to charge it.

cards.question: A phone displays a normal image but does not detect touch. A restart does not help, and service diagnostics identify a failed touch-sensing layer. Which part is damaged?
cards.why: The digitizer senses touch input. Its failure can prevent touch responses even when the display still shows an image.

cards.question: A phone must tap a terminal to make a payment using a 13.56 MHz short-range exchange. Which technology fits?
cards.why: NFC means Near Field Communication. The supplied matching exercise reversed NFC and infrared labels; this text question supplies a clear use case.

cards.question: A phone plays audio through a nearby paired wireless speaker after a supported NFC tap starts setup. Which radio normally carries the continuing audio stream?
cards.why: NFC can initiate pairing, while Bluetooth carries the ongoing audio. The two functions are not interchangeable.

cards.question: A laser printer's toner smears, and oversized paper jams before printing. Which plan correctly separates the two symptoms?

options.label: A
options.text: Check supported media/settings and the fusing process for smearing; check size, guides and paper path for jams

options.label: B
options.text: Replace the network switch for both symptoms

options.label: C
options.text: Assume every jam proves bad RAM

cards.answer: A. Check supported media/settings and the fusing process for smearing; check size, guides and paper path for jams
cards.why: Poor toner bonding concerns fusing or media conditions. Feeding oversized unsupported paper is a separate mechanical/media issue.

cards.question: A secondary storage array must provide 600 GB usable space before overhead and tolerate one drive failure using the fewest drives. Which layout meets both requirements?
cards.answer: C. Two 600 GB drives in RAID 1
cards.why: Two mirrored 600 GB drives supply about 600 GB usable and survive one member failure. RAID 0 lacks the required redundancy.

cards.question: A workstation boots from a separate M.2 SSD. Four 1 TB drives will form a standard RAID 10 data array. What is its usable capacity before overhead, and what can a fifth compatible drive do?

options.label: A
options.text: 4 TB; the fifth adds another 1 TB active stripe

options.label: B
options.text: 2 TB; the fifth may be a configured spare

options.label: C
options.text: 1 TB; the fifth is always required for parity

options.label: D
options.text: 5 TB; all five are standard active mirror-pair members

cards.answer: B. 2 TB; the fifth may be a configured spare
cards.why: Half of the four drives' raw capacity holds mirrored copies. A supported spare does not add usable capacity or become an unpaired fifth active member.

cards.question: A projector image is shaped like a trapezoid rather than a rectangle, while individual letters are sharp. Which adjustment addresses the geometry?

options.label: B
options.text: Correct projector placement/alignment and use supported keystone adjustment if needed

cards.answer: B. Correct projector placement/alignment and use supported keystone adjustment if needed
cards.why: Keystone distortion concerns projection angle and shape. Focus addresses blur, not the same geometric problem.

cards.question: A home has a separate cable modem, router, PC and analog telephone service port. Which connection plan is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: Coax with F connectors to the modem; Ethernet modem-to-router WAN and router LAN-to-PC; a compatible phone cord to the analog voice port

options.label: B
options.text: VGA from modem to router and HDMI to the phone

options.label: C
options.text: An ordinary Ethernet LAN port directly supplies analog dial tone

options.label: D
options.text: A fiber connector fits every copper phone jack

cards.answer: A. Coax with F connectors to the modem; Ethernet modem-to-router WAN and router LAN-to-PC; a compatible phone cord to the analog voice port
cards.why: Each interface has a distinct role. RJ11-style phone connections need actual telephone service; Ethernet does not inherently supply analog dial tone.

cards.question: An AP cable run ends at a 110-style copper patch panel, and a separate patch cord uses crimp-style modular plugs. Which tool pairing is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: Punchdown for the patch-panel IDC contacts; a compatible crimper for the modular plugs

options.label: B
options.text: Use an optical-fiber crimper on every copper jack

options.label: C
options.text: Use a toner to permanently attach both connectors

options.label: D
options.text: Use a loopback plug to cut cable jackets

cards.answer: A. Punchdown for the patch-panel IDC contacts; a compatible crimper for the modular plugs
cards.why: The connector design determines the tool. Patch-panel termination and plug crimping are different operations.

cards.question: A server's RAID summary says 'degraded' but does not identify the failed bay. What should the technician do before selecting and removing a drive?

options.label: A
options.text: Pull the first drive with the largest capacity

options.label: B
options.text: Read controller member status and logs, identify the failed or missing member, and follow the replacement procedure

options.label: C
options.text: Treat stripe size as the replacement drive's physical size

cards.answer: B. Read controller member status and logs, identify the failed or missing member, and follow the replacement procedure
cards.why: A summary status does not identify a bay. Drive interface/capacity compatibility differs from controller settings such as stripe size and cache policy.
